words.tr: v. 完成；结束；“finish”的现在分词； n. 结尾；结束；完成； adj. 最后的；完工的；
words.ex: He is finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在完成他的作业。
words.en: The act of completing something or the final touches added to something.

words.ex: The bookcase is full of storybooks.
words.ex_cn: 书架上放满了故事书。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: He took all the old furniture to the dumps.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的旧家具都带到了垃圾场。
words.en: A place where waste or garbage is left; a state of depression or unhappiness.

words.tr:
n. 检查；支票；制止；
v. 检查；
words.ex: The doctor did a final check before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前做了最后的检查。
words.en: Means to examine or inspect something for accuracy or quality; also, a written order for payment.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天步行去学校。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.tr: adj. 更接近的；更亲密的；“close”的比较级； adv. 更接近地；“close”的比较级；
words.ex: This chair is closer to the window.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子离窗户更近。
words.en: A closer is a person or thing that closes or finalizes something.

words.tr: v. 进行（go的第三人称单数）；去；进展；
words.ex: The meeting goes well every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 会议每周一进行得很顺利。
words.en: To move from one place to another; to proceed or move along in a specified manner.

words.ex: He sits on the sofa every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都坐在沙发上。
words.en: A sofa is a long, comfortable seat with a back and usually with arms, which two or three people can sit on.

words.ex: I went shopping for groceries yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天去购物买杂货了。
words.en: The activity of buying things from shops.

words.tr: v. 推，推动( push的第三人称单数 ); 对…施加压力; 逼迫; 按
words.ex: He pushes the cart every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上推小车。
words.en: To press against something with steady force in order to move it away.

words.tr: v. 用力踩踏；跺脚（第三人称单数）
words.ex: He stomps his feet when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时跺脚。
words.en: Walks heavily and noisily, often with a deliberate, forceful step.

words.tr: adj. 看不见的；未被发现的；即席的
words.ex: The unseen danger scared the children.
words.ex_cn: 那看不见的危险吓到了孩子们。
words.en: If something is unseen, it is not seen or noticed by anyone.

words.tr:
pron. 这个；
adj. 这；
adv. 这样；这个；这么；
words.ex: This is my book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: You use 'this' to refer to a person or thing that is near you, especially when you touch them or point to them.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.tr: v. 显示；表现；展示；“show”的过去分词；
words.ex: The screen shown the results clearly.
words.ex_cn: 屏幕显示了清晰的结果。
words.en: Past participle of show; to make something clear or visible to someone by looking at it or explaining it.

words.ex: He worked here previously.
words.ex_cn: 他以前在这里工作。
words.en: At an earlier time or before.

words.ex: The car has many parts.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有很多部分。
words.en: Parts refer to pieces or segments of something larger, components of a machine or device, roles in a performance, areas or regions, or talents or abilities.

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.ex: The book is in the bag.
words.ex_cn: 书在包里。
words.en: Used to indicate location or position within something.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.ex: They are happy.
words.ex_cn: 他们很高兴。
words.en: Are is the second person singular and plural, and first and third person plural of the present tense of 'be'.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: Rachel is reading a book in the park.
words.ex_cn: 雷切尔正在公园里看书。
words.en: A given name, notably associated with Rachel, a common female name in English-speaking countries.

words.ex: He enters the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place or to become a member of a group or organization.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.tr: v. 留下；离开；离去；“leave”的现在分词； n. 离开；
words.ex: He is leaving his coat on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他把外套留在椅子上。
words.en: The act of going away from a place or person.

words.ex: His book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他的书在桌子上。
words.en: Used to refer to a male person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr: n. 手势；姿态；姿势；手势( gesture的名词复数 ) v. 做手势( gesture的；
words.ex: He used hand gestures to explain the idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用手势来解释这个想法。
words.en: Physical movements of the hands, head, or body used to express meaning or feeling.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.ex: He finishes his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.tr: v. 推，推动； adj. 没有空的，忙碌的 v. 推，推动( push的过去式和过；
words.ex: He pushed the cart to the store.
words.ex_cn: 他把购物车推到了商店。
words.en: To exert force against (someone or something) in order to move them away from oneself or the origin of the force.

words.tr: n. 欢呼声；激励；“cheer”的复数；
words.ex: The crowd gave cheers when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: used to express good wishes before drinking; used to express thanks or goodbye

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: The buzzer sounds when the door opens.
words.ex_cn: 门打开时蜂鸣器会响。
words.en: A buzzer is an electrical device that makes a buzzing noise and is used for signaling.

words.ex: There are 31 women in the meeting room.
words.ex_cn: 会议室里有31名女性。
words.en: Women are adult human females.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr: v. 抓住；持有；举行；容纳；保存；“hold”的现在分词； n. 土地；
words.ex: He is holding the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他正紧紧地抓住绳子。
words.en: A holding is a piece of land that is owned by someone or the shares that someone owns in a company.

words.ex: She combs her hair every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上梳头发。
words.en: Hair is the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans and animals, or the mass of such strands growing from the skin of a person's head.

words.tr: v. 变化；“change”的过去式与过去分词； adj. 改变的；
words.ex: The weather changed quickly.
words.ex_cn: 天气很快变了。
words.en: If something has changed, it has become different.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: They are playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里踢足球。
words.en: You use they to refer to a group of people, animals, or things.

words.ex: He stared at the moon all night.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚凝视着月亮。
words.en: To look fixedly or intently at someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 困惑的；发呆的
v. 使困惑；使茫然；“bemuse”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He looked bemused when the teacher asked a strange question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问了一个奇怪的问题时，他看起来很困惑。
words.en: If you are bemused, you are puzzled or confused.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.ex: The village sits near a quiet lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄坐落于一个宁静的湖边。
words.en: To be in a position in which your bottom is resting on a chair, the ground, etc., with the upper part of your body upright, or to put someone in this position.

words.ex: There was silence after the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 坏消息传来后，一片沉默。
words.en: The absence of sound; complete quiet.

words.ex: The store opens at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 商店早上8点开始营业。
words.en: If someone opens something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, its position is changed so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他等了一会儿才开口。
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.tr: v. （按时间、顺序等）接着；跟随，接着；继承；
words.ex: Spring follows winter.
words.ex_cn: 春天接着冬天到来。
words.en: If you follow someone who is going somewhere, you move along behind them because you want to go to the same place.

words.ex: Can you explain this math problem?
words.ex_cn: 你能解释一下这个数学问题吗？
words.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.

words.ex: I expect a gift on my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我期待在生日时收到一份礼物。
words.en: If you expect something, you believe that it is likely to happen or that it will be the case.

words.tr:
n. 击败；失败；挫折
v. 击败；战胜；使受挫；“defeat”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was defeated in the chess match.
words.ex_cn: 他在国际象棋比赛中被击败。
words.en: Having been beaten in a battle or other contest.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样快。
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.tr: v. 凝视，瞪视； adj. （毛发）竖立的 v. 凝视，瞪视( stare的现在分词；
words.ex: He was staring at the sky without moving.
words.ex_cn: 他凝视着天空，一动不动。
words.en: The act of looking fixedly or intently at something or someone.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.tr: n. 饮食；吃； v. 吃；“eat”的现在分词；
words.ex: His eating habits are very healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他的饮食习惯非常健康。
words.en: Eating is the act of consuming food to provide nutritional support for the body.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一本书。
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.ex: The phoebe perched on the fence and sang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 菲比霸鹟停在围栏上大声鸣叫。
words.en: Phoebe is a female given name, originally from the Greek 'Phoibe', which means 'bright, pure'. It is also the name of a moon of Saturn.

words.ex: Free lunch is a perk of this job.
words.ex_cn: 免费午餐是这份工作的一个额外补贴。
words.en: If someone perks up or if something perks them up, they become more cheerful or lively.

words.ex: Joey is my best friend since childhood.
words.ex_cn: 乔伊是我从小到最好的朋友。
words.en: A joey is a young kangaroo or other marsupial.

words.tr: n. 蜡烛商，杂货店; n. （Chandler）人名；（英）钱德勒
words.ex: The chandler sold candles and basic goods in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这位蜡烛商在村里卖蜡烛和基本用品。
words.en: A chandler is a person who makes or sells candles and sometimes other items of household goods.

words.ex: The central park is in the middle of the city.
words.ex_cn: 中央公园位于城市中心。
words.en: Something that is central is of key or fundamental importance.

words.ex: I like apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

words.ex: Iridium is a rare and highly corrosion-resistant transition metal.
words.ex_cn: 铱是一种稀有且高度耐腐蚀的过渡金属。
words.en: Iridium is a hard, brittle, lustrous, dense, transition metal of the platinum family, iridium is one of the rarest elements in the Earth's crust.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.ex: She cut the paper with scissors.
words.ex_cn: 她用剪刀剪了纸。
words.en: Scissors are a tool used for cutting paper, cloth, hair, etc., consisting of two sharp blades fastened together in the middle so that the sharp edges slide against each other.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一双鞋。
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: He is holding three cards in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着三张牌。
words.en: Cards are pieces of stiff paper or thin cardboard, often with a picture on one side, which are used for playing games or for sending messages.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着河走。
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.tr: v. 爱，热爱；喜欢；喜爱；喜好；
words.ex: She loves her dog very much.
words.ex_cn: 她非常爱她的狗。
words.en: To feel a deep romantic or sexual attachment to (someone).

words.ex: Joanne walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 乔安每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: Joanne is a female given name, derived from the name Joanna, which itself comes from the Hebrew name יוֹחָנָן (Yochanan) meaning 'God is gracious'.

words.ex: Hey guys, let's go play soccer.
words.ex_cn: 嘿，伙计们，我们去踢足球吧。
words.en: Guys is a term used to refer to a group of people, typically men, but can also be used for mixed groups. It's a casual way to address friends or acquaintances.

words.ex: He is assembling a toy car for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为儿子装配一辆玩具车。
words.en: The act of gathering together or fitting parts together.

words.tr: v. 坐；“sit”的现在分词； n. 坐着活动的一段时间；一次用餐时间；
words.ex: He is sitting on a chair.
words.ex_cn: 他正坐在椅子上。
words.en: The act of being in a seated position.

words.tr: v. 工作；劳动；“work”的现在分词； adj. 工作的；劳动的；
words.ex: He is working in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工厂工作。
words.en: Engaged in work, especially as one's regular occupation; functioning or able to function.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.ex: I take the subway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天坐地铁去上班。
words.en: An underground railway system in a city, usually operated by electricity, which provides a rapid means of transportation.

words.tr: n. 唱歌； adj. 唱歌的； v. “sing”的现在分词；
words.ex: Singing is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 唱歌是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of producing musical sounds with the voice, often in a structured and continuous manner.

words.tr: v. 玩；进行比赛；演奏；扮演；“play”的现在分词；
words.ex: The children are playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在玩玩具。
words.en: The act of engaging in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: The national flag flies high every morning.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上国旗都高高飘扬。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of a nation; common to a whole nation

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.tr:
n. 广播节目；电视节目；
v. 广播；播送；
words.ex: I listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听了早上的广播节目。
words.en: To broadcast is to transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.tr: n. 国家或组织的法定歌曲
words.ex: The team sang the national anthem before the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛前，球队唱了国歌。
words.en: An anthem is a song that is used to represent a particular nation, society, or group and that is sung on special occasions.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.ex: The cat jumped into the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳进了盒子里。
words.en: If you go into a place or thing, you move from the outside to the inside of it.

words.ex: She put the apples in a bag.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果装进了一个袋子里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: Ross is my best friend since childhood.
words.ex_cn: 罗斯是我从小最好的朋友。
words.en: Ross is a male given name of Scottish origin, derived from the Gaelic word 'ros', meaning 'headland' or 'promontory'.

words.ex: She has a red book.
words.ex_cn: 她有一本红色的书。
words.en: Used with the third person singular present tense of 'have'.

words.tr: v. 进入；参加；登记；进入( enter的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He entered the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入了房间。
words.en: Gone or moved into a place or situation.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.ex: His lapse in judgment caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: A lapse is a temporary failure or a slight error, or the process by which something gradually passes into a different state, especially a worse one.

words.tr: v. 抄写；（用不同的录音手段）转录( transcribe的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is transcribing the old letters by hand.
words.ex_cn: 他正在手抄这些旧信件。
words.en: To transcribe something means to make a written or typed copy of it, especially from a recording or a speech.

words.ex: Eric plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 埃里克每周末踢足球。
words.en: A common male given name, often used as a standalone reference or in contexts like 'Eric the Red' (historical figure).

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: If people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

words.ex: I drink coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早晨喝咖啡。
words.en: The morning is the part of each day between the time that people usually wake up and the time they start work or school, or the part of the day before noon.

words.ex: Do you like pizza? Yeah.
words.ex_cn: 你喜欢披萨吗？是。
words.en: used to give an affirmative response

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我知道他明天会来。
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.tr: v. 有；吃；“have”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She had a book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她桌上有一本书。
words.en: Had is the past tense and past participle of have.

words.tr:
n. 梦；梦想；
v. 梦想；做梦；
words.ex: I had a strange dream last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。
words.en: A dream is a series of thoughts, images, and sensations occurring in a person's mind during sleep. It can also refer to a cherished aspiration, ambition, or ideal.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.ex_cn: 他从杯子里喝水。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.tr:
num. 一千；
n. 千；千个；
words.ex: There are a thousand stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有一千颗星星。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten; 1,000.

words.ex: The child screamed when she saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当那个孩子看到狗时，她尖叫了起来。
words.en: If you scream, you shout or cry in a loud high-pitched voice, usually because you are in pain or are very frightened.

words.ex: The retailers sell clothes at low prices.
words.ex_cn: 这些零售商以低价出售衣服。
words.en: Retailers are businesses that sell goods directly to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.tr: n. 切割；剪辑； v. 削减；切；割；“cut”的现在分词； adj. 锐利的；
words.ex: The cutting of the tree took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 砍树的切割只用了五分钟。
words.en: The act or process of cutting something; a piece cut off from something, especially a plant.

words.ex: He watched the game closely.
words.ex_cn: 他紧密地观看了比赛。
words.en: In a way that is very near in space or time; with little or no space or time in between.

words.tr: adj. 兴奋的； v. 使兴奋；使激动；“excite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children were excited about the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对派对感到兴奋。
words.en: If you are excited, you are so happy that you cannot relax, usually because you are thinking about something pleasant that you are going to do or experience.

words.tr: adj. 无表情的（面孔）；表情冷淡的
words.ex: He delivered the punchline with a deadpan expression.
words.ex_cn: 他用面无表情的表情说出了笑点。
words.en: If you describe someone as deadpan, you mean that they appear serious and do not show emotion in their face or voice, even when they are joking or teasing.

words.ex: He eats tuna for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃金枪鱼。
words.en: A tuna is a large fish that lives in warm seas and is caught for food.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.tr: v. 模仿( imitate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The child is imitating his father's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子正在模仿他父亲的声音。
words.en: To copy someone's speech or behavior, or to copy something because you admire it.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.ex: He decides to go home early.
words.ex_cn: 他决定早点回家。
words.en: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

words.ex: The characters in the story are very funny.
words.ex_cn: 故事中的角色非常有趣。
words.en: If you describe someone's character, you are describing their personality and the way they behave. If something has a particular character, it has a particular quality or feature.

words.ex: He is wearing a blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件蓝色的衬衫。
words.en: Having something on your body as clothing, decoration, or protection.

words.tr: pron. 那些；“that”的复数； adj. 那些的；
words.ex: Those books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 那些书在桌子上。
words.en: You use those to refer to people or things which have already been mentioned or which are already known about.

words.ex: Rhenium, or Re, is a rare metal used in jet engines.
words.ex_cn: 铼，符号为Re，是一种用于喷气发动机的稀有金属。
words.en: With reference to; concerning.

words.tr:
n. 长裤子；短内裤； “pant”的复数
v. 喘气；喘息；“pant”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He is wearing blue pants.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Pants are a piece of clothing that covers the body from the waist to the ankles and divides into two parts to cover each leg separately.

words.tr: v. 完成；“finish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 完成的；完蛋的；
words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: Having completed or concluded an activity, task, or work.

words.ex: There was a sudden noise in the night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里突然传来一阵响声。
words.en: If something is sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: v. 出发；开始；起动；开办；
words.ex: He starts at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点出发。
words.en: To begin something or to cause something to begin.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: I am eating now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在正在吃饭。
words.en: at the present time or moment

words.tr: v. 看；“look”的现在分词； adj. 有...样子的；
words.ex: He is looking at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他正在看天空。
words.en: If you are looking for something, you are trying to find it or obtain it.

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上做作业。
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: He threw the ball at the window.
words.ex_cn: 他把球朝窗户扔去。
words.en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后非常累。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；美好的；
words.ex: The weather today is nice.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: If you say that something is nice, you mean that you find it attractive, pleasant, or enjoyable.

words.tr:
n. （驼）峰；驼背；小土丘
v. 背负（重物）；弓起
words.ex: The camel has a big hump on its back.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼的背上有一个大驼峰。
words.en: A hump is a rounded protuberance or bulge, especially on the back of a camel or other animal, or on a person's back. As a verb, it means to form into a hump or to carry something with difficulty.

words.ex: He is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的兄弟。
words.en: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal previously mentioned or easily identified

words.ex: I have a book.
words.ex_cn: 我有一本书。
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.ex: She wore a hairpiece to cover her baldness.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一顶假发来遮盖秃顶。
words.en: A hairpiece is a piece of false hair that some people wear on their head if they are bald or if they want to make their own hair seem longer or thicker.

words.ex: He does his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上做作业。
words.en: Does is the third person singular in the present tense of 'do'. It is used to refer to an action or activity performed by someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: He wrote down the numbers on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他把数字写在了纸上。
words.en: Numbers are symbols or words used to represent quantities or values in mathematics, counting, or identification.

words.ex: The kids are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children or young people.

words.tr:
n. 输入；
v. 输入；
words.ex: The computer needs user input to work.
words.ex_cn: 计算机需要用户输入才能工作。
words.en: Input is information that is put into a system or machine so that it can operate.

words.ex: I totally agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我完全同意你的观点。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.tr: v. “stand”的现在分词；站立； adj. 直立的；常设的； n. 地位；
words.ex: He is standing by the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正站在门边。
words.en: Your standing is your status or reputation.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: He finally realize his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: If you realize that something is true, you become aware of that fact or understand it.

words.ex: The child was naked in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在浴缸里是裸体的。
words.en: If something is naked, it is not covered by anything such as clothes or paint.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放回了书架。
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.tr:
v. 是；动词be的第一人称单数现在式
abbr. 上午；“ante meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: I am happy today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天很开心。
words.en: first person singular present of be

words.tr:
adv. 好吧；没问题；
adj. 好的；
words.ex: Alright, let's go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 好吧，我们去公园吧。
words.en: used to indicate that one agrees to do something or that one accepts a situation

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他挥挥手打招呼。
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.ex: The road extends to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条路延伸到山脉。
words.en: To make something longer or larger in space or time.

words.ex: He has five dollars in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有五美元。
words.en: The basic monetary unit of the United States, Canada, Australia, and certain countries in the Pacific, Caribbean, Southeast Asia, Africa, and South America.

words.tr:
adv. 还；然而；
conj. 然而；
words.ex: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.

words.ex: He is upbeat about his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他对新工作感到乐观。
words.en: If people or their opinions are upbeat, they are cheerful and full of hope.

words.tr: adv. 令人惊讶地；出乎意料地；
words.ex: Surprisingly, he passed the test without studying.
words.ex_cn: 令人惊讶的是，他没学习就通过了考试。
words.en: In a manner that causes surprise because it is unexpected or unusual.

words.tr: n. 尖叫的人或物；引人注目的事物
words.ex: The child was a real screamer when he didn't get his way.
words.ex_cn: 那个孩子不如意时真是个尖叫者。
words.en: A person or thing that screams; something that is very noticeable or outstanding.

words.ex: The cats are sleeping on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫们正在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: Plural form of cat, a small domesticated carnivorous mammal with soft fur, a short snout, and retractable claws.

words.ex: She ate a cookie after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她在午饭后吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A cookie is a small sweet cake, typically round and flat, that is baked and often served as a snack.

words.tr: v. 服务；接待；供职；服役；“serve”的现在分词； n. 一份；上菜；服务；接待；
words.ex: He is serving food at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他正在餐厅提供食物。
words.en: A serving is an amount of food that is given to one person at a meal.

words.tr:
pron. 哪个；
adj. 哪个的；
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?
words.ex_cn: 你想读哪本书？
words.en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

words.ex: He wore a weird hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶怪异的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as weird, you mean that they are strange, unusual, or mysterious.

words.tr:
adv. 非常；很；
adj. 恰好是；正是；
words.ex: He is very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

words.ex: The turns of the wheel made the car move.
words.ex_cn: 车轮的转动使车前进。
words.en: Actions or movements that change direction or position, or opportunities to act in a sequence.

words.ex: She is reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 她正在读书。
words.en: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: My book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我的书在桌子上。
words.en: Used to refer to oneself as the possessor of something.

words.ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: It is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 它在桌子上。
words.en: used to refer to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr: v. 叫；打电话； n. 打电话；“call”的复数；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: To call someone means to telephone them. To call something means to give it a particular name or description.

words.tr: adj. 更好的；更优秀的；“good”的比较级； adv. 更好地；“well”的比较级； v. 胜过；使更佳；
words.ex: This shirt is better than the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫比那件更好。
words.en: If something is better, it is of a higher standard, quality, or level than something else, or than it was before.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.tr: v. 塑造；使成形；“shape”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 具有（或呈）…形状的；
words.ex: The teacher shaped the students' thinking with kind words.
words.ex_cn: 老师用温和的话语塑造了学生的思维方式。
words.en: Having a particular shape or form.

words.ex: He moved up to a higher bracket after his promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他升职后进入了更高的等级。
words.en: A bracket is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is fastened to a wall in order to support something such as a shelf. In writing, brackets are symbols that are used to separate words or numbers.

words.ex: He traveled to Poland last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了波兰。
words.en: Poland is a country in Central Europe, known for its rich history, culture, and the resilience of its people.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.ex: She is a beautiful girl.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个美丽的女孩。
words.en: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.tr: n. （Vegas）拉斯维加斯（美国城市Las Vegas的简称）; n. （Vegas）（美）维加...
words.ex: He went to Vegas for a weekend trip.
words.ex_cn: 他去拉斯维加斯度了个周末假。
words.en: A city in Nevada, USA, famous for its casinos and entertainment venues.

words.ex: The doctor used a laser to remove the tumor.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用激光切除了肿瘤。
words.en: A device that generates an intense beam of coherent monochromatic light (or other electromagnetic radiation) by stimulated emission of photons from excited atoms or molecules.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.tr: 短语，表示“一年或两年”，用于描述时间长度
words.ex: The building is 200 years old.
words.ex_cn: 这个建筑有200年历史。
words.en: A period of time equal to 365 days (or 366 in a leap year), used as a standard unit for measuring time and age.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: v. 共享；分享；“share”的现在分词；
words.ex: They are sharing their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在和朋友分享食物。
words.en: The act of allowing others to use or enjoy something that you possess.

words.tr:
adj. 喝醉的；有明显的肌肉线条的
v. 撕裂；扯下；“rip”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was ripped after drinking too much beer.
words.ex_cn: 他喝太多啤酒后醉了。
words.en: Having a well-developed muscular physique; torn or split apart.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: adv. 更长久地；“long”的比较级； adj. 更长的；更长时间的；“long”的比较级；
words.ex: He stayed longer to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他多待了一会儿来完成作业。
words.en: Comparative form of long: extending for a greater distance or time.

words.ex: The rain lasted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整天。
words.en: To continue in time; go on.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.tr: n. 亲密；接近；密闭；狭窄
words.ex: The closeness of the two friends is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 这两位朋友之间的亲密显而易见。
words.en: The state of being close in space or time; intimacy or familiarity.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: Liza is singing a song.
words.ex_cn: 莉莎正在唱一首歌。
words.en: A female given name, a common diminutive of Elizabeth.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都写日记。
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.ex_cn: 请把盐递给我。
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.ex: The movie was horrible and made me scared.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很恐怖，让我害怕。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as horrible, you mean they are very unpleasant or bad.

words.tr:
v. 祝愿；希望；
n. 祝福；愿望；
words.ex: I wish you a happy birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我祝愿你生日快乐。
words.en: If you wish to do something or you wish to have it done for you, you want to do it or have it done.

words.ex: I sometimes walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我有时走路去学校。
words.en: At times; occasionally.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都说你好。
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.tr:
adj. 响亮的；大声的；
adv. 大声地；
words.ex: The music was too loud at the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对上的音乐太响了。
words.en: If a noise is loud, the level of sound is very high and it can be easily heard.

words.ex: He did his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后做了作业。
words.en: Did is the past tense of do.

words.ex: The sounds of birds wake me up every morning.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿的声音每天早上把我叫醒。
words.en: Sounds can refer to vibrations that travel through the air or another medium and can be heard when they reach a person's or animal's ear. It can also mean to convey a specified impression when heard.

words.ex: He gave the book to me.
words.ex_cn: 他把书给了我。
words.en: Me is the object pronoun used to refer to oneself as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: She put the ice cream in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 她把冰淇淋放进冷冻柜里。
words.en: A freezer is a device that is used to store food at very low temperatures in order to preserve it.

words.tr:
adv. 然后；接下来；那时；
adj. 当时的；那时的；
words.ex: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了早餐，然后去了学校。
words.en: At that time; next in order of time; in that case.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看着天空。
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
words.ex_cn: 和朋友一起玩游戏很有趣。
words.en: If you say that someone is fun or that they are fun to be with, you mean that you enjoy being with them because they make you feel happy and amused.

words.tr:
auxv. 必须；一定要；
n. 必须做的事；必不可少的事物；
words.ex: You must finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is very likely or certain to be true or to happen.

words.ex: The song became a big hit after it appeared on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在登上电视后成了引人注意的东西。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.ex: The old building collapses during the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧建筑在地震中倒塌了。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.ex: He sings a happy song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上唱一首快乐的歌。
words.en: A song is a piece of music with words that is sung.

words.tr:
conj. 一旦；一…便；
adv. 曾经；一次；
words.ex: Once you finish your homework, you can play.
words.ex_cn: 一旦你完成作业，就可以玩了。
words.en: At one time in the past; formerly.

words.ex: The children perform dances at the school festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校节日上表演舞蹈。
words.en: To move rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.tr:
v. 爆裂；突然而起；
n. 爆裂；突然而起；
words.ex: The balloon burst when he blew too much air.
words.ex_cn: 当他吹入太多空气时，气球爆裂了。
words.en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out; used especially to describe the sound of something breaking open.

words.tr: v. 关闭；使接近；“close”的现在分词； n. 关闭；倒闭；
words.ex: He is closing the door slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在慢慢关上门。
words.en: The act of shutting or finishing something.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.tr:
v. 错过；想念；漏掉；
n. 小姐；
words.ex: I missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: To fail to hit, reach, catch, or otherwise make contact with something; to feel the absence or loss of someone or something.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: The turtle walks slowly on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟在沙子上慢慢走。
words.en: A turtle is a reptile with a hard shell that lives in the sea or on land.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.tr: v. 哄骗；开玩笑；“kid”的现在分词
words.ex: He is kidding about the test score.
words.ex_cn: 他关于考试分数是在开玩笑。
words.en: If you say that someone is kidding, you mean that they are saying something that is not true, as a joke or in order to tease you.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰（法语词，英语中常用于人名或品牌名）
words.ex: He roz every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: A proper noun, likely a person's name or a nickname.

words.tr: v. 推；逼迫；按；“push”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is pushing the cart down the street.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把购物车推下街道。
words.en: Pushing is used to describe someone who is determined to get what they want, often in a way that other people find annoying.

words.ex: The parrot can say hello.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹦鹉会说你好。
words.en: A parrot is a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly colored feathers. Parrots are often kept as pets because they can be taught to copy human speech.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.ex: The fireworks made bright bursts in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在夜空中发出明亮的爆炸。
words.en: 1. If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out. 2. If a place is bursting with people or things, it is full of them.

words.ex: I believe you are telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你在说真话。
words.en: If you believe in something, you think that it is true, or that it exists.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.ex: Hey, can you help me with this?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你能帮我一下吗？
words.en: used to attract attention or to express surprise, interest, or annoyance

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.tr:
adj. 令人安慰的
v. 安慰；“comfort”的现在分词
words.ex: The news was comforting to those who had been worried.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息对那些一直担心的人来说是一种安慰。
words.en: Making you feel less sad or worried; giving comfort.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请明天来我家。
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他远离了房子。
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr: v. 挑选；采摘；“pick”的现在分词； n. 采摘；选择；
words.ex: He is picking apples from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他正在从树上挑选苹果。
words.en: The act of selecting or choosing something, or the act of stealing from someone's pocket.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.tr:
adj. 剩余的；
n. 残留物；
words.ex: We ate the leftover food for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我们早餐吃了剩下的食物。
words.en: Remaining after the rest has been used, consumed, or dealt with.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.tr: v. 使受伤；弄痛( hurt的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The fall was hurting his leg.
words.ex_cn: 摔倒使他的腿受伤了。
words.en: If you are hurting, you are feeling pain, either physically or emotionally.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我感觉明天会下雨。
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 我能够游得很好。
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.ex: He became angry when his phone broke.
words.ex_cn: 当他手机坏了时，他生气了。
words.en: Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility; full of anger.

words.tr: v. 是；存在；成为；“am”的过去式；“is”的过去式；
words.ex: He was happy yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天很开心。
words.en: the past tense of be for the first and third person singular

words.tr:
n. 女同性恋者
adj. 女同性恋的
words.ex: She is a lesbian and loves her partner.
words.ex_cn: 她是一名女同性恋者，深爱着她的伴侣。
words.en: A lesbian is a woman who is sexually attracted to other women.

words.tr: v. 知道；认识；“know”的过去式；
words.ex: I knew the answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 我知道这个问题的答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: I need something to eat.
words.ex_cn: 我需要吃点东西。
words.en: Some thing or things that are not specified or known.

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.ex_cn: 他走出了房间。
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.ex: I saw him yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天看见他了。
words.en: You use him to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified.

words.ex: I gotta finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我得在晚饭前做完作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that someone must do something or that something must happen, especially in informal speech.

words.tr: v. 离开；进行；“go”的现在分词； adj. 现有的； n. 离去；进展；
words.ex: He is going home after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后要离开回家。
words.en: The act of moving or proceeding; the condition of roads or weather for traveling; the act of leaving a place.

words.ex: He is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名老师。
words.en: Used to indicate the identity, qualities, or condition of someone or something.

words.ex: Congratulations on your graduation!
words.ex_cn: 祝贺你毕业！
words.en: An expression of pleasure or joy in the success or good fortune of another.

words.tr: v. 完成；“do”的过去分词； adj. 已完成的；
words.ex: I done my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我完成了我的作业。
words.en: If something is done, it has been completed or finished.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.tr:
n. 男人；人；
v. 操作；
words.ex: The man is walking his dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A man is an adult human male.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.ex_cn: 这是一部极好的电影！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.ex: Angela likes to draw pictures after school.
words.ex_cn: 安吉拉喜欢放学后画画。
words.en: A female given name.

words.ex: Andrea is coming to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 安德烈娅今晚要来参加派对。
words.en: Andrea is a female given name of Greek origin, meaning 'manly' or 'brave'.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.ex: The tip of the pencil broke off.
words.ex_cn: 铅笔的尖端断了。
words.en: The end of a pointed or projecting object; a sum of money given to someone as a reward for their services; to give someone a small amount of money as a reward for their services.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果是红的。
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里剩下的水很少。
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.tr:
v. 喜欢；
n. 爱好；喜欢的东西；
words.ex: She likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Finds something agreeable or enjoyable; has a preference for.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他以喝咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.tr: n. 听力；听觉； v. 听；听见；“hear”的现在分词；
words.ex: His hearing is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的听力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: The ability to perceive sounds; a session in which evidence and arguments are presented to a court or committee.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.ex: He is mostly late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他主要迟到上课。
words.en: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about most of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most situations.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.ex: He walked up the stairs to his bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去他的卧室。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.tr:
v. 逼迫；推；
n. 推；奋力；
words.ex: The teacher pushed the student to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师逼迫学生完成作业。
words.en: To exert force against (someone or something) in order to move them away from oneself or the origin of the force.

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.tr: v. 想；认为；“think”的现在分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I am thinking about my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我正在想我的作业。
words.en: The process of using your mind to consider something carefully.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.tr:
v. 滚动；
n. 滚动；卷形物；
words.ex: The ball roll down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 球从山上滚下来。
words.en: To move somewhere by turning over and over, or to make something move in this way.

words.ex: He poured water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进杯子里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.ex: She poured tea from the pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A pot is a deep round container used for cooking.

words.ex: He made an omelet for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐做了一个煎蛋卷。
words.en: An omelet is a dish made by beating eggs and cooking them in a frying pan, often with other ingredients such as cheese, vegetables, or meat folded inside.

words.ex: He grimaced when he tasted the bitter medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他喝下苦涩的药时皱起了脸。
words.en: A grimace is an ugly, twisted expression on a person's face, usually because they are experiencing pain or strong feelings.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他从未去过日本。
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.tr: n. 少许；小块；片刻； v. “bite”的过去式；
words.ex: Can you give me a bit of sugar?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我一点点糖吗？
words.en: A bit is a small piece or quantity of something.

words.ex: We will go to the beach in June.
words.ex_cn: 我们将在六月去海滩。
words.en: the sixth month of the year, in the northern hemisphere usually considered the first month of summer

words.ex: The exits are near the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 出口在楼梯附近。
words.en: An exit is a way out of a place, especially a building or room. To exit means to go out of or leave a place.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.tr:
n. 问题；疑问；
v. 怀疑；询问；
words.ex: He asked a simple question in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上问了一个简单的问题。
words.en: A sentence or phrase used to find out information.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.tr: adj. 单一的；单独的；单身的；
words.ex: He bought a single ticket for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张单程公交车票。
words.en: Only one in number; one only; not married or not involved in a stable romantic relationship.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 激素控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: Hormones are chemicals produced by the body that regulate the activity of cells or organs. They play a key role in many body processes, including growth, metabolism, and reproduction.

words.tr: abbr. 想要；“want to”的缩写（美俚）
words.ex: I wanna go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我想去公园。
words.en: Wanna is used in written English to represent the words 'want to' when they are pronounced informally.

words.ex: He says he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他说他累了。
words.en: If someone says something, they express it in words.

words.ex: I did it myself.
words.ex_cn: 我自己做的。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of a verb or preposition when he or she is the subject of the clause.

words.ex: The lion killed a deer in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在森林里杀死了一只鹿。
words.en: To kill someone or something means to cause their death.

words.tr:
int. 喂；哈喽；
n. “喂”的招呼声或问候声；
words.ex: Hello, can you hear me?
words.ex_cn: 喂，你能听到我吗？
words.en: used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.tr: v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动；“whip”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The cruel man whipped the horse.
words.ex_cn: 那个残忍的人鞭打了马。
words.en: Whipped is the past tense and past participle of whip. It can also describe someone who is completely controlled by someone else, especially in a romantic relationship.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.tr:
n. 香草；香草精
adj. 香草味的；寻常的；无特色的
words.ex: He likes vanilla ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢香草冰淇淋。
words.en: Vanilla is a flavoring derived from orchids of the genus Vanilla, primarily from the Mexican species, flat-leaved vanilla (V. planifolia). The word vanilla, derived from the diminutive of the Spanish word vaina (vaina itself meaning sheath or pod), is translated simply as 'little pod'.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: The rocky path made hiking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 多岩石的小路让徒步变得困难。
words.en: A rocky area is covered with rocks or consists of large areas of rock and has nothing growing on it.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: He eats nuts every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃坚果当早餐。
words.en: If you say that someone is nuts, you mean that they are crazy. Nuts are hard-shelled fruits of some trees.

words.tr: n. 大量；许多；命运（lot 的复数）；
words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有大量的书。
words.en: A large number or amount; a great deal.

words.tr: v. 让我（let me 的口语缩略形式）
words.ex: Lemme know if you need help.
words.ex_cn: 如果你需要帮助，告诉我一声。
words.en: A colloquial contraction of 'let me', used to introduce a suggestion or request.

words.tr: n. 装饰用的糖珠（常用于蛋糕或饼干上）
words.ex: He put jimmies on his ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他在冰淇淋上撒了彩色糖粒。
words.en: Sprinkles or small pieces of chocolate or candy used as a topping for desserts.

words.ex: The lake is covered with ice in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天湖面结满了冰。
words.en: Ice is frozen water. It is a solid state of water that occurs when water freezes at or below 0 degrees Celsius.

words.tr: v. 出现；碰巧；发生（ happen的过去式和过去分词 ）；
words.ex: A strange noise happened last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚出现了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.tr: n. 风味调料（flavor 复数）; v. 添加味道（flavor 的三单形式）
words.ex: The ice cream has many flavors.
words.ex_cn: 这种冰淇淋有很多口味。
words.en: Flavors refers to the distinctive taste of a food or drink.

words.ex: He has eight apples in his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他包里有八个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of two and four; one more than seven, or two less than ten; 8.

words.ex: He kneaded the dough for bread.
words.ex_cn: 他揉了做面包的生面团。
words.en: Dough is a thick, malleable mixture of flour and liquid, used for baking into bread or pastry. It can also informally refer to money.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: He ate a cherry from the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃了一颗樱桃。
words.en: A cherry is a small, round fruit that is typically bright or dark red. It is often eaten fresh or used in cooking and baking.

words.tr: n. 必应（微软公司推出的搜索引擎）
words.ex: I use bing to search for weather updates.
words.ex_cn: 我用必应搜索天气信息。
words.en: Bing is a web search engine owned and operated by Microsoft.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr: adj. 1. 用螺丝固定的 2. 陷入困境的
words.ex: The table was screwed to the floor.
words.ex_cn: 桌子用螺丝固定在地板上。
words.en: If you say that someone is screwed, you mean that they are in a very difficult situation and that there is no obvious way out of it.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后给你打电话。
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午去图书馆。
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: She cleaned the room herself.
words.ex_cn: 她自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when the female subject of the verb is also the object.

words.tr: v. 进入；加入；“enter”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is entering the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他正悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To come or go into a place; to begin to be involved in an activity or a situation.

words.tr:
adv. 在今天；当今；
n. 今天；当今；
words.ex: I will finish my homework today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天会完成我的作业。
words.en: This day, as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: He helped others without asking for anything.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助别人，没有要求任何回报。
words.en: Used to refer to additional people or things of the same type as those already mentioned or known about.

words.tr: v. 移动；搬家；搬动；行动；进展； adj. 受感动的；受感动的 v. 移动，搬动( move的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He moved the chair to the window.
words.ex_cn: 他把椅子移到了窗边。
words.en: If you are moved by something, it makes you feel strongly emotional, often causing you to want to help or show sympathy. As a verb, it refers to the action of changing position or causing something to change position.

words.ex: He is explaining the math problem to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向弟弟解释这道数学题。
words.en: to make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it

words.tr: n. 颂歌；赞美诗；欢乐之歌；
words.ex: The children sang a Christmas carol at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上唱了一首圣诞颂歌。
words.en: A carol is a religious song or popular hymn, particularly one associated with Christmas.

words.tr:
adj. 惊悸的；惊骇的
v. 使恐怖；使震惊；“horrify”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She was horrified when she saw the accident.
words.ex_cn: 她看到那场事故时吓坏了。
words.en: Filled with horror; extremely shocked.

words.tr:
n. 暂停；停顿；
v. 暂停；停顿；
words.ex: There was a short pause before he answered.
words.ex_cn: 他回答之前停顿了一下。
words.en: To pause means to stop what you are doing for a short time before continuing.

words.ex: The survivor walked out of the forest after three days.
words.ex_cn: 幸存者在三天后走出了森林。
words.en: A survivor is someone who continues to live after an event in which others have died, or someone who manages to continue living their life successfully despite difficulties.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.tr: n. 勾缝; 弄尖，指示; 磨尖
words.ex: The mason carefully applied the pointing to the brickwork.
words.ex_cn: 泥瓦匠仔细地在砖缝中勾缝。
words.en: The act of directing someone's attention to something by extending a finger or other object towards it.

words.tr: n. 林肯(美国城市名；男子名)
words.ex: We visited Lincoln last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天去了林肯市。
words.en: Lincoln: A city in the U.S. state of Nebraska, serving as its capital; also a common male given name.

words.tr: n. 来自（用于人名中表示籍贯）; abbr. 德国（Germany）; n. （De）（丹、越）大...
words.ex: Marie de France is a famous writer.
words.ex_cn: 玛丽·德·法兰西是一位著名作家。
words.en: Abbreviation for 'department'.

words.ex: He drinks a cup of caff every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯caff。
words.en: Caff is a British informal term for a café or a casual eating place, often serving simple, inexpensive meals.

words.ex: My brother plays soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: A brother is a man or boy in relation to other sons and daughters of his parents.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我需要又一杯茶。
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
n. 啐唾沫；吐痰
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水；下小雨；“spit”的现在分词
words.ex: He got angry and started spitting at the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他生气了，开始朝墙上啐唾沫。
words.en: the act of forcing saliva or other substances out of the mouth

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 让我帮你做作业。
words.en: To allow or permit something to happen or someone to do something.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.ex: She was yelling at the kids to come inside.
words.ex_cn: 她正在喊孩子们进来。
words.en: To shout or cry out loudly and often in anger, pain, or excitement.

words.ex: Please shut the door.
words.ex_cn: 请关上门。
words.en: To shut something means to move it so that it fills an opening or to move it so that it is no longer open.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.ex_cn: 我准备好考试了。
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.ex: You are my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 你是我最好的朋友。
words.en: Used to refer to the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: They weren't at the party last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚没在派对上。
words.en: Were not; used to indicate the negative form of 'were'.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.tr:
v. 支付；付出代价；
n. 工资；
words.ex: He will pay for the food tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会支付饭钱。
words.en: If you pay for something which you buy or for a service which you use, you give money to the person who is selling it or providing it.

words.tr: n. 亲爱的人；甜心；宝贝
words.ex: He called her sweetie with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着叫她甜心。
words.en: A term of endearment used to address someone you love or care about.

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.
