words.ex: The children shows a magic show at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校表演魔术。
words.en: If you show something to someone, you let them see it or give it to them. If you show someone how to do something, you do it yourself so that they can watch you and learn how to do it.

words.ex: He ran 100 meters in 9 seconds.
words.ex_cn: 他用9秒跑完了100米。
words.en: A second is one of the sixty parts that a minute is divided into. People often say 'a second' to mean a very short time.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr: n. 佛罗里达（美国东南部的一个州）
words.ex: He moved to Florida last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年搬到了佛罗里达。
words.en: A state in the southeastern region of the United States, known for its warm climate and beaches.

words.ex: The balloon went up into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 气球升上了天空。
words.en: toward a higher place or position

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.tr: v. 加衬里；排队；“line”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The jacket was lined with soft wool.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克内衬了柔软的羊毛。
words.en: Having a lining or linings; marked with lines.

words.ex: The men are working in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这些男人正在花园里干活。
words.en: Men are adult human males. The term is used to distinguish them from women or boys.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.ex: He wore a tony suit to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套豪华的西装去参加派对。
words.en: Tony is a male given name, derived from the Roman family name Antonius, which is of unknown Etruscan origin.

words.tr: n. 烟蒂；屁股；枪托；笑柄
words.ex: He picked up the butt from the ground and threw it in the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起烟蒂，扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: The end of a cigarette that is left after smoking; the part of the body that a person sits on; a person or thing that is a target for ridicule or criticism; to hit or push someone or something with the head or horns.

words.tr: n. 自己；自我；本性；“self”的复数
words.ex: They taught themselves how to play the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他们自学了如何弹吉他。
words.en: The reflexive form of 'self', used to refer back to the subject of the clause.

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了工作。
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.ex: He has many problems with math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上有很多问题。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.ex: The dogs bark loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 狗在晚上大声吠叫。
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.ex: The beacon shines at night to guide ships.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔在夜晚发光以引导船只。
words.en: A beacon is a light or a fire, usually on a hill or tower, which acts as a signal or a warning.

words.tr: v. 碰撞；打；击；“hit”的现在分词；
words.ex: The car was hitting a tree.
words.ex_cn: 汽车正在撞上一棵树。
words.en: The act of coming into contact with something quickly and forcefully.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.ex_cn: 我明天见你。
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.ex: I will try to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我将尝试每天早上跑步。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这是个好主意。
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: I bought some things at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一些东西。
words.en: Objects, items, or matters that are not specifically named.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我们今晚一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；真正的；
words.ex: This is a real diamond, not fake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是假的。
words.en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.tr:
n. 管子；管道；烟斗；
v. 吹笛；以管输送；
words.ex: The plumber fixed the broken pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了坏掉的管子。
words.en: A pipe is a long, round, hollow object, usually made of metal or plastic, through which a liquid or gas can flow.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: I am guessing the answer is 5.
words.ex_cn: 我正在猜答案是5。
words.en: the act of estimating or supposing without sufficient information

words.tr: v. 买；“buy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I bought a book yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天买了一本书。
words.en: The past tense and past participle of buy, meaning to acquire something by paying for it.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.tr: v. 哭泣；啜泣； adj. <主方>湿透的 v. 哭泣，啜泣( sob的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The child was sobbing after losing her toy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在丢了玩具后哭了起来。
words.en: Sobbing is the act of crying noisily, taking sudden, sharp breaths.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.tr: n. 米（长度单位）；毫（千分之一）；字母M
words.ex: The table is two m long.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子两米长。
words.en: The thirteenth letter of the English alphabet, often used as an abbreviation for 'metre' or 'million'.

words.tr: adj. 歇斯底里的；异常激动的
words.ex: She became hysterical when she lost her wallet.
words.ex_cn: 她丢了钱包时变得歇斯底里。
words.en: If someone is hysterical, they are in a state of uncontrolled excitement, anger, or panic, often because of a shock or a very upsetting experience.

words.tr: n. 孙子；孙女；外孙；外孙女；“grandchild”的复数
words.ex: My grandma loves playing with her grandchildren.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶喜欢和她的孙子们一起玩。
words.en: Someone's grandchildren are the children of their son or daughter.

words.tr: v. 得到；明白；获得；“get”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I got a gift from my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我从朋友那里得到了一份礼物。
words.en: Got is the past tense and past participle of get, which means to come into possession of something, to receive something, or to obtain something.

words.ex: He walks from school to home.
words.ex_cn: 他从学校走回家。
words.en: Indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: The factory increases its production every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每年都在增加生产。
words.en: Production refers to the process of manufacturing or growing something in large quantities, or the amount of something that is manufactured or grown.

words.tr: n. 匹诺曹（童话木偶的名字）
words.ex: Pinocchio tells a lie and his nose grows.
words.ex_cn: 皮诺曹说了一个谎，他的鼻子变长了。
words.en: Pinocchio is the name of a fictional character and the protagonist of the children's novel 'The Adventures of Pinocchio' by Carlo Collodi. Pinocchio is a wooden puppet who gains wisdom through a series of misadventures that lead him to become a real boy.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.ex: I have two apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有两个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and one; one less than three.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.ex: He listens to music to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.tr:
adv. 好的；可以；
adj. 好的；
words.ex: Okay, I will do it now.
words.ex_cn: 好的，我现在就做。
words.en: Used to express agreement or acceptance.

words.ex: He is not happy.
words.ex_cn: 他不开心。
words.en: Used to make a negative statement or to negate a verb, adjective, or other adverb.

words.ex: It's raining outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面在下雨。
words.en: Contraction of 'it is' or 'it has', used to indicate possession or a state of being.

words.ex: She is happy.
words.ex_cn: 她很高兴。
words.en: Used with a third person singular subject to indicate identity, condition, or existence.

words.tr: v. 有；买到； n. 所有，持有 v. 有( have的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is having a big dinner with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和家人吃一顿丰盛的晚餐。
words.en: The present participle of have, which means to possess, own, or hold.

words.ex: Everybody likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Every person; everyone.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: This thing is very useful.
words.ex_cn: 这个东西很有用。
words.en: An object, fact, affair, circumstance, or concept considered as being a separate entity.

words.tr: v. 接受；拿(走)；带领；乘坐；费时；吃；“take”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is taking the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受这份工作邀请。
words.en: The act of taking something, especially by force or by a legal process.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: The country gained independence in 1960.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在1960年获得了独立。
words.en: Independence is the freedom from control or influence of others, allowing one to make decisions and act on one's own.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr:
adj. 最好的；
adv. 最好地；
n. 最佳物；佼佼者；最高水平；
words.ex: He is the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Of the most excellent, effective, or desirable type or quality.

words.ex: Ah, I see what you mean.
words.ex_cn: 啊，我明白你的意思了。
words.en: used to express surprise, pleasure, or sympathy

words.ex: He will cancel the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会取消会议。
words.en: If you cancel something that has been arranged, you stop it from happening. If you cancel an order for goods or services, you tell the person or organization supplying them that you no longer wish to receive them.

words.ex: Ya, I understand.
words.ex_cn: 是的，我明白了。
words.en: Yes; used to express agreement or affirmation, often in informal contexts.

words.ex: He was smiling at the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他正对着婴儿微笑。
words.en: A smiling face or a smiling person has a smile on their face.

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.ex: We are eating lunch now.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在吃午饭。
words.en: We is the first person plural pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to themselves and one or more other people considered together.

words.tr: v. 等待；等候；“wait”的现在分词； n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: He is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他正在等公交车。
words.en: the act of staying in one place or remaining inactive in expectation of something

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: I like tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶或者咖啡。
words.en: You use or to link two or more alternatives.

words.ex: I have four apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有四个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of three and one; one more than three.

words.tr:
prep. 为；因为；给；
conj. 因为；由于；
words.ex: I bought this gift for my mother.
words.ex_cn: 我为我妈妈买了这份礼物。
words.en: If something is for a particular person, group, or purpose, it is intended to be used by that person or group or for that purpose.

words.tr: n. （新娘的）伴娘（bride 的复数形式）
words.ex: The bridesmaids wore pink dresses at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼上，伴娘们穿着粉色的裙子。
words.en: The women who attend a bride at her wedding, typically close friends or relatives.

words.ex: He says goodnight to his sister before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前对妹妹说晚安。
words.en: An expression used to wish someone a good night's sleep or to say goodbye at the end of the evening.

words.tr: v. 说话；交谈；“talk”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is talking to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和朋友说话。
words.en: The act of speaking or discussing something with someone.

words.tr: v. 踱步于，走动( pace的现在分词 ); 调整自己的工作（或活动）节奏; 领先于; 为…定步速
words.ex: He was pacing in the room while waiting for the results.
words.ex_cn: 他在房间里踱步，等待结果。
words.en: The speed or rhythm at which something progresses or is done.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: She went to the park with her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.ex: I want to go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我想去公园。
words.en: Used to indicate the direction, destination, or position of something in relation to something else.

words.ex: There's a book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一本书。
words.en: A contraction of 'there is' or 'there are', used to indicate the existence of something.

words.ex: He told me the news.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉了我这个消息。
words.en: If you tell someone something, you give them information.

words.tr:
adj. 一些；某些；
pron. 有些；若干；
words.ex: I need some water.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一些水。
words.en: used to refer to an unspecified amount or number of something

words.tr:
pron. 没有什么；
n. 无关紧要的事；
words.ex: I have nothing to say.
words.ex_cn: 我没什么可说的。
words.en: Nothing means not anything or no single thing.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr:
pron. 我（主语）
n. 碘（元素iodine的符号）
words.ex: I am going to the store.
words.ex_cn: 我要去商店。
words.en: The first person singular pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to himself or herself.

words.ex: That guy is waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙正在等公交车。
words.en: A guy is a man or boy. You can refer to a group of people, especially men or boys, as guys.

words.ex: The vacuum cleaner sucks up the dust.
words.ex_cn: 吸尘器吸走灰尘。
words.en: To draw into the mouth by contracting the muscles of the lips and mouth to make a partial vacuum; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.tr: v. 停留；继续处于某种状态； n. 撑（法） v. 停留，停止( stay的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is staying at home today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天待在家里。
words.en: The act of remaining in a place or condition for a period of time.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.tr: v. 建立；确立；制订；使被安排好；“establish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 已确立的；
words.ex: They established a school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所学校。
words.en: If you use established to describe something such as an organization, you mean that it is officially recognized or generally approved of because it has existed for a long time.

words.ex: He ignored her feelings and left without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了她的情感，没有说再见就离开了。
words.en: Feelings are the emotions that you have, such as joy, sadness, or anger.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.ex: He wasn't at school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天不在学校。
words.en: Wasn't is the usual spoken form of 'was not'.

words.tr: v. 邀请；“invite”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He invited his friends to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他邀请了他的朋友来参加派对。
words.en: If you are invited to do something, you are formally asked or given permission to do it.

words.ex: Does anybody know the answer?
words.ex_cn: 有人知道答案吗？
words.en: Any person at all; anyone.

words.tr: v. 重撞；“smash”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The car smashed into a tree.
words.ex_cn: 汽车重重撞上了一棵树。
words.en: If something is smashed, it has been broken into many pieces, often violently. It can also describe someone who is very drunk.

words.ex: I am glad to see you.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴见到你。
words.en: If you are glad about something, you are happy and pleased about it.

words.ex: He asked if I wanted coffee, and I said yes.
words.ex_cn: 他问我是否想要咖啡，我说是。
words.en: Used to give an affirmative response or to agree with a positive statement.

words.ex: Wow, that cake looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哇，那个蛋糕看起来真美味！
words.en: You say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased by something.

words.tr:
adj. 最坏的；最糟糕的；
n. 最坏的事；
words.ex: This is the worst day of my life.
words.ex_cn: 这是我生命中最糟糕的一天。
words.en: Superlative of bad: of the lowest quality, or the most unpleasant, difficult, or severe

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.tr:
adj. 切碎的
v. 撕碎；切碎；“shred”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He ate shredded cheese on his pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他在披萨上吃了切碎的奶酪。
words.en: Cut or torn into small pieces.

words.tr: adv. 曾经；在任何时候；总是；
words.ex: Have you ever been to Paris?
words.ex_cn: 你曾经去过巴黎吗？
words.en: At any time; always; in any case; used for emphasis when you are comparing things.

words.tr: v. 打破；打断；“break”的过去式； adj. 破产的；身无分文的；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打碎了玻璃。
words.en: If you are broke, you have no money.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.tr: n. 方式；道路；方向；路线；方法；
words.ex: He found a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方式。
words.en: A way is a method, style, or manner of doing something, or a route or path that you take to get from one place to another.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.tr: v. 笑；发笑；“laugh”的现在分词； n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: The children are laughing at the funny clown.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在笑那个滑稽的小丑。
words.en: Showing amusement or happiness by making sounds and movements in your face and body.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. upper half 上半部; utility helicopter 通用直升机
words.ex: The uh of the circle is shaded.
words.ex_cn: 圆的上半部被涂上了阴影。
words.en: used to indicate hesitation, uncertainty, or a pause for thought

words.ex: Paul is a teacher who loves math.
words.ex_cn: 保罗是一位喜欢数学的老师。
words.en: A male given name, often a short form of Paul or Pauline.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.ex_cn: 毯子盖在床上面。
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.tr: n. 内部通话系统（或设备）； 对讲机
words.ex: He pressed the intercom to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他按了对讲机来寻求帮助。
words.en: An intercom is a communication system that allows people in different parts of a building or vehicle to speak to each other.

words.ex: He walked to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天走路去学校。
words.en: To move at a regular pace by lifting and setting down each foot in turn, never having both feet off the ground at once.

words.tr:
prep. 自…以后；从…以来；
conj. 因为；由于；既然；从…以后；
adv. 此后；后来；
words.ex: He has lived here since 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他自2020年以来一直住在这里。
words.en: From a past time until now; because; as a result of the fact that.

words.ex: I will see you next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周见你。
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.tr: n. 时期；时间；次数；倍；“time”的复数； prep. 乘以；
words.ex: The times of ancient Rome were very different from today.
words.ex_cn: 古罗马时期与今天大不相同。
words.en: Times refers to the measurement of periods in which events occur, the number of occasions something happens, a period in history, or a multiplication factor.

words.ex: He brushed his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刷牙。
words.en: The hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.tr:
adj. 这样的；如此的；
pron. 这样的人或事；
words.ex: He made such a big mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他犯了这样的大错。
words.en: You use such to refer back to the thing or person that you have just mentioned, or a thing or person like the one that you have just mentioned. You use such as and such...as to introduce examples of the thing or person that you have just mentioned.

words.ex: He called his friend an idiot after the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他在犯错后称朋友是白痴。
words.en: An idiot is a person who is considered to be very stupid or foolish.

words.ex: I have five apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有五个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of two and three; one more than four, or half of ten.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.tr: v. 抓住；赶上；“catch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The boy caught a fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在河里抓到了一条鱼。
words.en: Caught is the past tense and past participle of catch, which means to seize or capture something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr: v. 告诉；讲述；“tell”的现在分词； adj. 有力的；反映情况的；
words.ex: He told me the news.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉了我这个消息。
words.en: If something is telling, it shows the true nature of a situation or someone's feelings or character in a very clear way.

words.tr: v. 提升；饲养；筹募；增加；“raise”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is raising his voice to be heard.
words.ex_cn: 他提高声音以便被人听到。
words.en: The act of increasing something in amount or size, or the process of bringing up and educating children.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.ex: The school held graduations last week.
words.ex_cn: 学校上周举行了毕业典礼。
words.en: The ceremonies marking the completion of an educational stage, such as school or university.

words.tr:
adj. 两者的；
pron. 两者；
conj. 不仅…而且...；
words.ex: Both books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这两本书都在桌子上。
words.en: You use both to refer to two things or people together.

words.tr: n. 生日( birthday的名词复数 )
words.ex: We eat cake on birthdays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在生日时吃蛋糕。
words.en: The anniversary of the day on which a person was born, typically treated as an occasion for celebration and the giving of gifts.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.tr:
adj. 第五的；
n. 五分之一；第五；
adv. 第五；
words.ex: He finished in fifth place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第五名。
words.en: The fifth item in a series is the one that you count as number five.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.tr:
adj. 清楚的；明确的；清晰的；清澈的；晴朗的；
v. 清空；清除；放晴；使明确；
adv. 清楚地；彻底地；
words.ex: The instructions are clear.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很清楚。
words.en: Free from anything that marks or darkens; transparent; bright; not obscure or ambiguous; easily understood; free from guilt or blame.

words.ex: He said 'um' when he couldn't think of the right word.
words.ex_cn: 当他想不出合适的词时，他说了‘呃’。
words.en: used to express hesitation or uncertainty

words.ex: He takes the book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他从书架上拿走书。
words.en: If you take something, you reach out for it and hold it.

words.tr:
n. 一小口；
v. 呷；啜；小口喝；
words.ex: He took a sip of water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一小口水。
words.en: To drink something slowly by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.ex: He was sexually harassed at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中遭受了性骚扰。
words.en: In a way that relates to the instincts, physiological processes, and activities connected with physical attraction or intimate physical contact between individuals.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.tr: n. 电动汽车（electric vehicle）的缩写
words.ex: He is evading the police.
words.ex_cn: 他正在躲避警察。
words.en: A combining form meaning 'out' or 'away', as in 'evade' or 'evolve'.

words.tr: adj. 能够；能…的；有能力的；
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能够游过这条河。
words.en: If you are able to do something, you have the skills, strength, knowledge, or other qualities needed to do it.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.ex: This book is hers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是她的。
words.en: used to refer to something belonging to or associated with a female person or animal previously mentioned

words.ex: The breaking of the ice caused a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 冰的破裂发出了一声巨响。
words.en: The act of breaking something; a pause or interruption in continuity.

words.ex: He accidentally dropped his phone on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把手机掉在地上了。
words.en: If something happens accidentally, it happens by chance or without being planned.

words.ex: She gave him a sweet kiss goodnight.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他一个甜蜜的晚安之吻。
words.en: To touch or press your lips against someone or something as a sign of love or affection.

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船离开了岸边。
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.ex: If it rains, we will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
words.en: You use if in conditional sentences to introduce the circumstances in which an event or situation might happen, might be happening, or might have happened.

words.tr:
v. 下降；跌倒；
n. 落下；跌落；秋天；
words.ex: The temperature falls quickly at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度迅速下降。
words.en: To move downward, typically rapidly and freely without control, from a higher to a lower level.

words.ex: He enjoys long walks in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里长时间散步。
words.en: To move along on foot; advance by steps.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.tr: v. 有助于，有利于；帮助；帮助( help的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: Eating vegetables helped him stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜有助于他保持健康。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of their work or by giving them advice or information.

words.tr: v. 笑；咧嘴笑（grin 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He grins when he sees his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他看到他的狗时笑了。
words.en: A broad smile, often showing teeth, expressing amusement or satisfaction.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊奇的；奇妙的
words.ex: The sunset looked wondrous over the sea.
words.ex_cn: 夕阳在海面上看起来奇妙无比。
words.en: If you describe something as wondrous, you mean it is strange and beautiful or impressive.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.tr: n. 淋浴站，淋浴设备；[气象]阵雨；[气象]阵雨（shower 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The gym has clean showers for members.
words.ex_cn: 健身房为会员提供干净的淋浴设备。
words.en: Showers refer to brief periods of rain or the act of washing oneself by standing under a spray of water. It can also mean to give someone a lot of something.

words.ex: The pigeon sits on the window sill.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子坐在窗台上。
words.en: A pigeon is a bird, usually grey in color, that is often seen in towns and is sometimes used for carrying messages.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: He gives his sister a book.
words.ex_cn: 他送给他妹妹一本书。
words.en: To transfer the possession of something to someone; to present voluntarily and without expecting compensation; to yield or surrender.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.tr: v. 排便（crap 的现在分词形式）；俚语指胡说八道
words.ex: He is crapping in the toilet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在厕所里拉屎。
words.en: The act of defecating; a crude term for excreting waste.

words.ex: He loves to paint and study art.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢绘画和学习艺术。
words.en: Art consists of paintings, sculpture, and other pictures or objects which are created for people to look at and admire or think deeply about.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.tr: pron. 这些；“this”的复数； adj. 这些的；
words.ex: These books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在桌子上。
words.en: You use these at the beginning of noun groups to refer to someone or something that you have already mentioned or identified.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.ex: She sings beautifully in the choir.
words.ex_cn: v. 她在合唱团里唱得很美。
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice.

words.ex: She picked red roses for her mother.
words.ex_cn: 她为母亲摘了红玫瑰。
words.en: Roses are a type of flower known for their beauty and fragrance, often used in gardens and as gifts.

words.ex: Raindrops fall on the window.
words.ex_cn: 雨滴落在窗户上。
words.en: Individual drops of rain falling from the clouds.

words.ex: The rabbits eat carrots in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在花园里吃胡萝卜。
words.en: Rabbits are small mammals in the family Leporidae of the order Lagomorpha, found in several parts of the world. They are known for their long ears, short tails, and strong hind legs. Rabbits are often kept as pets and are also hunted for their meat and fur.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of noodles for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭吃了一碗面条。
words.en: Noodles are long, thin pieces of food made from a mixture of flour, water, and sometimes egg, which are cooked in boiling water.

words.tr: n. 棒球手套，拳击手套；手套；连指手套（mitten 的复数，常用复数）
words.ex: He put on his mittens before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他打棒球前戴上了棒球手套。
words.en: Mittens are gloves which have one section that covers your thumb and another section that covers your four fingers together.

words.ex: La is a rare earth element used in batteries.
words.ex_cn: 镧是一种用于电池的稀土元素。
words.en: In music, 'la' is the sixth note of the diatonic scale in solfège.

words.ex: The kittens were playing with a ball of yarn.
words.ex_cn: 小猫们正在玩一团毛线。
words.en: Kittens are young cats, typically under one year old, known for their playful and curious nature.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 很少有人来参加会议。
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.tr: n. 圆叶风铃草( bluebell的名词复数 )
words.ex: The forest floor was carpeted with bluebells.
words.ex_cn: 森林地面上铺满了圆叶风铃草。
words.en: Bluebells are plants that produce blue, bell-shaped flowers in the spring.

words.tr: pron. 它们（宾格）；他们；她们；
words.ex: I saw them in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里看到了它们。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr: v. 按摩；揉捏（massage 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is massaging his sore shoulder.
words.ex_cn: 他正在按摩他疼痛的肩膀。
words.en: The act of rubbing or kneading muscles to relieve tension or promote relaxation.

words.tr: v. 给我（give me的口语缩略形式）
words.ex: He gimme a book yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天给了我一本书。
words.en: A casual, informal contraction of 'give me', used to request something.

words.ex: My feet hurt after walking all day.
words.ex_cn: 我走了一整天，脚很疼。
words.en: The plural of foot, which is the lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks. Also, a unit of linear measure equal to 12 inches (30.48 cm).

words.ex: The river water looked murky after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，河水看起来污浊。
words.en: If you describe something as murky, you mean that the details of it are not clear or that it is difficult to understand.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.tr:
adj. 自己的；
v. 拥有；
words.ex: This is my own book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: If you own something, it belongs to you.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.ex: What is your name?
words.ex_cn: 你叫什么名字？
words.en: You use 'what' in questions when you ask for specific information about something that you do not know.

words.ex: He went to the store yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天去商店了。
words.en: Went is the past tense of go.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 哦，我不知道那件事。
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.ex: This is her book.
words.ex_cn: 这是她的书。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a female person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天去上学。
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.tr: abbr. 不要；不；“do not”的缩写
words.ex: Don't touch the hot stove.
words.ex_cn: 不要碰热炉子。
words.en: Don't is the usual spoken form of 'do not'.

words.tr: n. 粗野之人；下层人；村夫；农夫；人；家伙；
words.ex: Carl is a rough carl who shouts at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 卡尔是个粗野之人，对每个人都大喊大叫。
words.en: A man, especially a rustic or uncouth one.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: She could swim when she was five.
words.ex_cn: 她五岁时就会游泳了。
words.en: Used to indicate possibility or ability in the past, or to make a polite request.

words.tr:
v. 摘；拔；猛拉；拨弹
n. 胆识；胆量；快而猛地拉
words.ex: He plucked a flower from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一朵花。
words.en: To pluck means to pull something quickly to remove it or to play a musical instrument by pulling the strings with your fingers. As a noun, it refers to the quality of being brave and determined.

words.tr: int. （表示惊讶、欣喜、痛苦等）嚯，呵
words.ex: Ooh, that looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哦，那看起来真好吃！
words.en: used to express surprise, pleasure, or excitement

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.ex: The air is clean after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气很清新。
words.en: Air is the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

words.ex: She has long eyelashes.
words.ex_cn: 她有长长的睫毛。
words.en: The fine hairs that grow from the edges of the eyelids, serving to protect the eyes from dust and debris.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the board with chalk.
words.ex_cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
words.en: A soft white limestone (calcium carbonate) formed from the skeletal remains of sea creatures.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: The windshields of the cars were covered with frost this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上，汽车的挡风玻璃上覆盖了霜。
words.en: The transparent front window of a motor vehicle, designed to protect the occupants from wind and weather.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.ex_cn: 他向前迈了一小步。
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.tr:
prep. 在...外；
n. 外面；外边；外部；
adv. 在外面；
adj. 外面的；外界的；
words.ex: The cat is sitting outside the house.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房子外面。
words.en: The outer side or surface of something; not inside a building; external to a particular place or thing.

words.tr: adj. 活着的； n. 生活；生计； v. 生活；“live”的现在分词；
words.ex: The living animals need water and food.
words.ex_cn: 活着的动物需要水和食物。
words.en: The state of being alive; the experience of being alive; a particular way or style of life.

words.tr: v. 杀死； adj. 被杀死的，断开的 v. 杀死( kill的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The lion killed the deer.
words.ex_cn: 狮子杀死了那只鹿。
words.en: If someone or something is killed, they are caused to die.

words.ex: He cleaned the room himself.
words.ex_cn: 他亲自打扫了房间。
words.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the male subject of the verb is also the object

words.ex: He has fourteen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十四个苹果。
words.en: The number 14.

words.tr: adv. 确切地；正是；准确地；
words.ex: He arrived exactly at 8 o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 他正好在八点到达。
words.en: In a precise manner; accurately.

words.tr: v. 结束；终止；结束，终止（end 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The movie ended at 9 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 电影在晚上9点结束了。
words.en: If something ends, or if you end it, it stops or you stop it.

words.tr: n. 清洁；打扫； v. 打扫；“clean”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cleaning of the room took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间花了一个小时。
words.en: The act of making something clean, especially the inside of a house or building.

words.ex: He came to school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天来学校了。
words.en: The past tense of come, meaning to move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.tr: n. 芳香疗法（用天然芳香油镇痛或按摩时揉入体内），用香料按摩
words.ex: She swears by aromatherapy for relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 她坚信芳香疗法有助于放松。
words.en: Aromatherapy is a form of alternative medicine that uses volatile plant materials, known as essential oils, and other aromatic compounds for the purpose of altering a person's mind, mood, cognitive function or health.

words.ex: The albino rabbit has white fur and pink eyes.
words.ex_cn: 这只白化兔子有白色的毛和粉红色的眼睛。
words.en: An albino is a person or animal with a congenital absence of pigment in the skin and hair (which are white) and the eyes (which are usually pink).

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.ex: They entered into matrimony last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年夏天结了婚。
words.en: The state of being married; marriage.

words.ex: Louise walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 路易丝每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: A female given name, form of Louisa.

words.ex: He wants to join the football team.
words.ex_cn: 他想加入足球队。
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.ex: The church is a holy place.
words.ex_cn: 教堂是一个神圣的地方。
words.en: If you describe something as holy, you mean that it is considered to be special because it is connected with God or a particular religion.

words.tr: v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children gathered around the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们聚集在火堆周围。
words.en: To gather means to bring together or collect from various places or sources.

words.ex: Cunningham solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 坎宁安迅速解出了这道数学题。
words.en: A proper noun, typically a surname; no standard English definition exists.

words.ex: Charles likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 查尔斯喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A male given name of Germanic origin, meaning 'free man'.

words.tr: adj. 一定会；密切相关的；有义务的； v. “bind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is bound to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他一定会赢得比赛。
words.en: If one person, thing, or situation is bound to another, they are closely connected with each other, and it is difficult for them to be separated or to escape from each other. If you say that something is bound to happen, you mean that you are sure it will happen, because it is a natural consequence of something that is already known or exists.

words.tr: n. 事情；物质；问题；麻烦；“matter”的复数
words.ex: These matters are important to him.
words.ex_cn: 这些事情对他很重要。
words.en: Matters refer to subjects or situations that are under consideration or discussion.

words.ex: They will marry next summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在明年夏天结婚。
words.en: To marry someone means to become their husband or wife in a legal or religious ceremony.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: Daddy is cooking dinner for us.
words.ex_cn: 爸爸正在为我们做晚饭。
words.en: A child's word for father.

words.ex: I can't swim.
words.ex_cn: 我不会游泳。
words.en: Cannot; used to indicate that something is not possible or allowed.

words.ex: There are twelve apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十二个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and four; one more than eleven, or two less than fourteen; 12.

words.tr: adj. 训练过的；受过培训的；v. 训练（train 的过去分词）； v. 训练；
words.ex: The trained dog can follow commands.
words.ex_cn: 这只经过训练的狗能听从指令。
words.en: Having been taught the skills for a particular job or activity.

words.tr: v. 嘲笑; 笑( laugh的过去式和过去分词 ); 发笑; （特别表示因成功而）处于有利地位
words.ex: They laughed at his old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他们嘲笑他的旧衣服。
words.en: To make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.ex: He has three interviews this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周有三场面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study, or in order to find out their opinions or experiences.

words.ex: The coffee is too hot to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这咖啡太热了，没法喝。
words.en: In addition; also; more than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively or extremely.

words.ex: The machine stops when the power is off.
words.ex_cn: 当电源关闭时，机器停止工作。
words.en: Stops: (verb) Ceases movement or activity.

words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving the house.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了袜子。
words.en: A piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of wool or cotton.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: Mrs. Smith is our neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 史密斯夫人是我们的邻居。
words.en: Mrs. is used before the name of a married woman when you are speaking or referring to her. It is a title of respect.

words.tr: v. 使得；制作；做；“make”的现在分词； n. 制造；
words.ex: The rain is making the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 下雨使得道路变得滑。
words.en: The process of creating or producing something.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: He is lucky to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运赢得了奖品。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lucky, you mean that they have something which is very desirable or that they are in a very desirable situation.

words.ex: He isn't coming to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他不来参加聚会。
words.en: Is not; used to form negative statements or questions.

words.ex: The movie was incredibly funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极其搞笑。
words.en: In a manner that is difficult to believe; extremely.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.ex: The girl is playing with her dog.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩正在和她的狗玩。
words.en: A girl is a female child or young woman.

words.tr: v. 拨号；调节；n. 刻度盘；拨号盘
words.ex: She dials the number carefully.
words.ex_cn: 她小心地拨号。
words.en: To dial means to select or adjust something by turning a dial or pressing buttons, especially on a telephone or a radio.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.tr: v. 削减；切；（从某物上）切下；
words.ex: The company cuts costs to save money.
words.ex_cn: 公司削减成本以节省资金。
words.en: Cuts can refer to the act of making an incision or reducing something in size, amount, or extent. It can also denote a wound or incision made by a sharp object.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.tr: v. 停止；停下来；停下来（stop 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He stopped his car at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 他在红灯前停下了车。
words.en: If you stop something happening, or you stop something from happening, you prevent it from happening or continuing.

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了鞋子。
words.en: A shoe is a covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.

words.tr: v. “say”的现在分词；说； n. 谚语；警句；
words.ex: He is saying goodbye to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友们道别。
words.en: A short, well-known expression that states a general truth or gives advice.

words.tr: n. 女用小包；钱包；资金；
words.ex: She put her keys in her purse.
words.ex_cn: 她把钥匙放进她的女用小包里。
words.en: A purse is a small bag used especially by women to carry everyday personal items.

words.ex: Calling time a thief is a metaphor.
words.ex_cn: 把时间称为小偷是一种隐喻。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天戴一顶黑帽子。
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.tr: int. （惊奇、高兴或有所发现时用）哈；（笑声）哈
words.ex: Ha! I found my keys!
words.ex_cn: 哈！我找到我的钥匙了！
words.en: Ha is used in writing to represent a noise that people make to show they are surprised, annoyed, or excited about something.

words.ex: I buy apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场买苹果。
words.en: To buy means to obtain something by paying money for it.

words.tr: n. 微笑；笑容 v. 微笑；露出笑容
words.ex: She smiles every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都微笑。
words.en: A smile is a facial expression formed by flexing the muscles near both ends of the mouth and often around the eyes, expressing happiness, pleasure, or amusement.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.ex_cn: 我的房间在三楼。
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他明天会来。
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.tr: v. 睡觉；“sleep”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He slept well last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚睡得很好。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of sleep.

words.ex: The coat is on a hanger in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 外套挂在衣橱里的衣架上。
words.en: A hanger is a curved piece of wood, metal, or plastic that you use to hang clothes on.

words.tr: v. 制作；使得；做；“make”的过去式和过去分词； adj. …制作的；
words.ex: She made a cake for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为弟弟做了一个蛋糕。
words.en: To produce something, often using a particular material or method.

words.tr: adj. 全部的；整个的；完全的；
words.ex: He ate the entire cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: You use entire to emphasize that you are referring to the whole of something, for example, the whole of a place, time, or population.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.tr:
v. 停留；保持；
n. 停留；逗留；
words.ex: He will stay at home tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚会待在家里。
words.en: To stay means to continue to be in a particular place or situation, or to remain in a specified state or condition.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 也许明天会下雨。
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.ex: He cannot swim without water.
words.ex_cn: 没有水，他不会游泳。
words.en: If you do something without something else, you do not have that thing with you or you do not use that thing.

words.tr:
n. 降落伞
v. 跳伞；用降落伞空投
words.ex: He jumped from the plane and opened his parachute.
words.ex_cn: 他从飞机上跳下并打开了降落伞。
words.en: A parachute is a device used to slow the motion of an object through an atmosphere by creating drag.

words.tr:
v. 跳；跳跃；
n. 跳；跳跃；
words.ex: The boy jump over the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 男孩跳过了水坑。
words.en: To push oneself off a surface and into the air by using the muscles in one's legs and feet; to move quickly and suddenly.

words.ex: He sees an airplane in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看到天上有一架飞机。
words.en: An airplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.ex: Is this your book?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书吗？
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: I thank you for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我谢谢你帮助我。
words.en: to express gratitude or appreciation to someone for something they have done

words.tr: v. 说；所说；“say”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 上述的；
words.ex: He said he would come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他说他明天会来。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of say, which means to express in words.

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.ex: Here is your book.
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书。
words.en: in or at this place or position

words.tr:
n. 锤子；
v. 锤打；
words.ex: He hit the nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子敲钉子。
words.en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle, used for hitting things.

words.ex: He believes in God.
words.ex_cn: 他相信上帝。
words.en: In monotheistic religions, God is the supreme being, creator, and principal object of faith.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: He is a big boy now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在是个大男孩了。
words.en: Of considerable size or extent; larger than other items of its kind.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.ex: He is charging his phone at the outlet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在插座处给手机充电。
words.en: The act of storing electrical energy in a battery or other storage device; the act of asking for money as a payment for goods or services; the act of accusing someone formally of a crime; a rush or attack in a particular direction.

words.tr: adv. 在任何时间；无论何时；
words.ex: You can call me anytime.
words.ex_cn: 你随时都可以给我打电话。
words.en: at any time; whenever

words.ex: He was wondering why the door was open.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得奇怪为什么门是开着的。
words.en: If you wonder about something, you think about it, either because it interests you and you want to know more about it, or because you are worried or suspicious about it.

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.ex_cn: 那个女孩是谁？
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.ex_cn: 我醒来的时候吃早餐。
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.ex: They were happy yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨天很开心。
words.en: Were is the plural past tense of the verb 'be'. It is used with plural subjects to indicate a state of being or existence in the past.

words.tr: v. （使）改变方向；（使）转动；（使）转动( turn的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He turned the car to the left.
words.ex_cn: 他把车转向了左边。
words.en: If you turn something, you move it so that it is facing in a different or opposite direction, or is in a very different position.

words.ex: He is taller than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟高。
words.en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison

words.tr:
adj. 甜的；悦人的；
n. 糖果；
words.ex: The cake is sweet and delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕又甜又美味。
words.en: Sweet is used to describe something that tastes of sugar or is pleasant in a way that is reminiscent of sugar. It can also describe something that is pleasing to the senses other than taste, such as a sound or smell, or something that is kind and gentle.

words.tr: v. 开始；创立；创始；发动（机器）；开动；出发，启程（start 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He started his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: If you start to do something, you do something that you were not doing before and you continue doing it.

words.ex: He realized his mistake after the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试后意识到了自己的错误。
words.en: To become fully aware of something as a fact; to understand clearly. To achieve something desired or anticipated.

words.ex: She bought ten presents for her friends.
words.ex_cn: 她为朋友们买了十份礼物。
words.en: If you present someone with something such as a prize or document, or if you present it to them, you formally give it to them.

words.ex: He ate a potato for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个土豆。
words.en: A potato is a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with a brown, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: A kind person helped me find my way.
words.ex_cn: 一位善良的人帮我找到了路。
words.en: A human being regarded as an individual.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐只吃苹果。
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.tr:
adv. 非常地；
adj. 多；许多；
pron. 许多；
words.ex: She is much happier now.
words.ex_cn: 她现在快乐多了。
words.en: A large amount or to a great degree.

words.ex: Mr. Smith teaches math at the school.
words.ex_cn: 史密斯先生在学校教数学。
words.en: Abbreviation for Mister, used as a title before a man's name, especially in formal contexts.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.tr:
v. 看上去；看；
n. 相貌；
words.ex: She looks happy today.
words.ex_cn: 她今天看上去很开心。
words.en: The appearance of someone or something, especially when it is attractive or interesting.

words.tr: v. 看，瞧；寻找；注意；看，瞧( look的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He looked out the window.
words.ex_cn: 他望向窗外。
words.en: To direct one's gaze in a specified direction.

words.ex: Lo and behold, the missing keys were on the table all along.
words.ex_cn: interj. 瞧，看，那丢失的钥匙一直在桌子上。
words.en: Used to draw attention to something surprising or interesting.

words.tr: v. 居住；活；以…为生； adj. 活( live的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: They lived in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: Having life; being alive.

words.tr: adv. 有一点；有点儿（同“kind of”）
words.ex: I kinda like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: used to mean 'kind of' or 'somewhat'

words.tr: v. 保持；保留；“keep”的现在分词； n. 一致；保管；
words.ex: She is keeping the room clean.
words.ex_cn: 她正在保持房间干净。
words.en: The act of holding onto something or maintaining it in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: She completed a 675-hour training program.
words.ex_cn: 她完成了一个675小时的培训项目。
words.en: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.

words.tr:
v. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；抨击；达到；
n. 打；击；碰撞；袭击；(演出等)成功；
words.ex: He hit the ball with a bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒打了球。
words.en: If you hit someone or something, you deliberately touch them with a lot of force, with your hand or an object held in your hand.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.tr:
n. 一半；
adj. 一半的；
adv. 一半地；
words.ex: He ate half of the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了苹果的一半。
words.en: One of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided.

words.ex: He poured gravy over the mashed potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他把肉汁浇在土豆泥上。
words.en: Gravy is a sauce made from the juices that come out of meat when it is cooked, often thickened with flour or cornstarch.

words.ex: She wore a gorgeous dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件华丽的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: If you say that something is gorgeous, you mean that it gives you a lot of pleasure or is very attractive.

words.tr: v. 使极度兴奋；使震惊
words.ex: She freaked out when she saw the spider.
words.ex_cn: v. 当她看到蜘蛛时，她吓坏了。
words.en: To become very excited or upset, often because of something unexpected.

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.tr: v. 漂；漂( drift的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The boat drifted away from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船漂离了岸边。
words.en: If something drifts somewhere, it is carried there by the movement of wind or water.

words.tr:
v. 做；干；
n. 所作所为；活动；
words.ex: He is doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在做作业。
words.en: The act of performing or accomplishing something.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.tr: v. 带来；引起；导致；“bring”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He brought a book to class.
words.ex_cn: 他带了一本书来上课。
words.en: To take or carry someone or something to a place or a person, or in the direction of the person speaking.

words.ex: He rowed the boat across the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他划着小船渡过湖面。
words.en: A boat is a small vehicle for travelling on water.

words.ex: He made a barry in his math homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: A male given name; also a verb meaning to tease or mock playfully.

words.ex: The two houses are apart by fifty meters.
words.ex_cn: 这两所房子相隔五十米。
words.en: If people or things are apart, they are separated by a distance.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于动物的。
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.ex: He won the lottery by pure luck.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是靠运气中了彩票。
words.en: Luck is the force that causes things, especially good things, to happen to you by chance and not as a result of your own efforts or abilities.

words.tr: v. 热爱；热爱（love 的过去分词）； adj. 受珍爱的；
words.ex: She loved her dog very much.
words.ex_cn: 她非常热爱她的狗。
words.en: If you love someone, you feel romantically or sexually attracted to them, and they are very important to you.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: The scientist made careful watching of the birds.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对鸟类进行了仔细的观察。
words.en: The act of looking at or observing something or someone for a period of time.

words.ex: He watches tv every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.tr: v. 尝试；试图；“try”的现在分词； adj. 难对付的；令人厌烦的；
words.ex: He is trying to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他正在尝试学习英语。
words.en: If you describe something as trying, you mean that it is difficult to deal with and causes you to feel annoyed or upset.

words.tr:
n. 西班牙语；
adj. 西班牙的；西班牙语的；
words.ex: He speaks spanish fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地讲西班牙语。
words.en: Of or relating to Spain, its people, or its language.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr: v. 希望；期望；盼望；期待；希望，期望( hope的现在分词 )；
words.ex: I am hoping for good weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望能有好天气。
words.en: If you are hoping for something, you want it to happen or be true and usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.tr: art. 一个 （在下一单词为元音开头时代替“a”）
words.ex: I saw an apple on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我看到桌子上有一个苹果。
words.en: Used before a word that begins with a vowel sound.

words.ex: He found two new jobs last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了两份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: My parents go to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母每天早上去上班。
words.en: Your parents are your mother and father.

words.ex: I said ugh when I saw the math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我看到数学作业时说了声‘哼’。
words.en: Used to express disgust, horror, or other strong negative feelings.

words.ex: He washed his hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 他在吃饭前洗手了。
words.en: The word 'hands' refers to the parts of the body at the end of the arms that are used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things. It can also mean help or assistance, skill in doing something, or the pointers on a clock.

words.tr:
n. 一群；一帮；一伙
v. 成群结队；结成一伙；合伙攻击
words.ex: The gang stole a car last night.
words.ex_cn: 那群人昨晚偷了一辆车。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often deliberately cause trouble.

words.ex: Please excuse me for being late.
words.ex_cn: 请原谅我迟到了。
words.en: To excuse someone means to forgive them for something they have done wrong or to allow them not to do something that they should do.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.ex: My father cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我父亲每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A male parent of a child; a man who has begotten a child.

words.tr: v. 使用；利用；“use”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 习惯的；使用过的；二手的；
words.ex: He used a pen to write the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支笔写了这封信。
words.en: Previously owned by someone else; second-hand.

words.ex: He hardly ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃东西。
words.en: You use hardly to modify a statement when you want to emphasize that it is only a small amount or degree which is true, or that it is not true at all.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.tr:
v. 悬挂；吊；
n. 悬挂；
words.ex: He hangs a picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一幅画挂在墙上。
words.en: To hang something means to attach it to something else so that it is supported from above and does not touch the ground.

words.ex: I'm gonna go to the store later.
words.ex_cn: 我待会儿要去商店。
words.en: Gonna is used in written English to represent the words 'going to' when they are pronounced informally.

words.tr: v. 用来表示某人或某物即主语本身；用来表示某人或某物属于某一群体或有某种性质；用来表示某人或某物即主语本身，用来表示某人或某物属于某一群体或有某种性质（ be的过去分词 ）；
words.ex: I have been to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 我去过巴黎。
words.en: Past participle of be.

words.tr: adv. 事实上；实际上；竟然；
words.ex: I thought he was late, but actually he was on time.
words.ex_cn: 我以为他迟到了，但事实上他准时到了。
words.en: You use actually to indicate that a situation exists or happened, or to emphasize that it is true.

words.tr: adj. 所谓的；假定的； v. 认定；假设；“suppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is the supposed expert on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他是所谓的古代史专家。
words.en: If you say that something is supposed to be true, you mean that people say it is true but you do not know whether it is definitely true.

words.ex: They went to Bali for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们去巴厘岛度蜜月。
words.en: A honeymoon is a holiday taken by a newly married couple.

words.tr: v. 率领朝向；“head”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有头的；
words.ex: He headed toward the station with his bag.
words.ex_cn: 他提着包朝车站走去。
words.en: Having a head or heading; directed or moving in a specified direction.

words.tr: n. 阿鲁巴（加勒比海的一个岛屿，属于荷兰王国）
words.ex: We spent our vacation in Aruba last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天在阿鲁巴度假。
words.en: Aruba is an island in the Caribbean Sea, part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, known for its white sandy beaches and sunny climate.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.ex: I have seen that movie before.
words.ex_cn: 我以前看过那部电影。
words.en: If you have seen something, you have observed it through your eyes or understood it.

words.ex: The dove is a symbolic bird of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征性鸟类。
words.en: If you describe an event, action, or procedure as symbolic, you mean that it represents an important change, although it has little practical effect.

words.ex: He made a gesture of welcome with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手做了一个欢迎的姿态。
words.en: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr: n. 销售；出售；减价销售；
words.ex: The store has a big sale every winter.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每年冬天都有大促销。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: Fifty percent of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 百分之五十的学生通过了考试。
words.en: A percent is a unit of measure equal to one hundredth of a whole. It is often used to express proportions, rates, and comparisons in various contexts, such as finance, statistics, and everyday calculations.

words.tr: n. 约翰（男性名）；俚语指厕所；
words.ex: John is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 约翰是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name.

words.tr: v. 发现；找到；建立；认为；“find”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He found a strange stone on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一块奇怪的石头。
words.en: To establish or set up (an organization, institution, or place) on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他口袋里有五十美元。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: He wore heavy boots to walk in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了厚重的靴子在雪地里走路。
words.en: Boots are a type of footwear that covers the foot and extends up the leg, sometimes to the knee or even the hip. They are typically made of leather or rubber and are worn for protection against cold, wet, or rugged terrain.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.ex: He was choked with emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他哽咽了。
words.en: If you are choked by something, it makes you unable to breathe properly, or it makes you feel very upset.

words.ex: The dog was sniffing around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗在花园里嗅来嗅去。
words.en: The act of drawing in air audibly through the nose to detect a smell.

words.tr: adj. 已知的；知名的；出了名的； v. 知道；认识；“know”的过去分词；
words.ex: This is a known fact.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个已知的事实。
words.en: Recognized, familiar, or within the scope of knowledge.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.ex: He drank water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后喝了水。
words.en: The past tense of 'drink', meaning to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it.

words.tr: v. 抓住；紧握；（clutch 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is clutching his bag tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧地抓着包。
words.en: Holding something tightly, often due to nervousness or determination.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.ex: Christine walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 克里斯汀每天早上步行去学校。
