words.en: A female given name, of Greek origin meaning 'follower of Christ'.

words.tr: adj. 窘迫的；受辱的; v. 使受辱（mortify 的过去式）
words.ex: He was mortified when he forgot his lines on stage.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记舞台上的台词时，他感到羞愧至极。
words.en: If you say that someone is mortified, you mean that they feel extremely ashamed or humiliated.

words.ex: Hi, how are you today?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你今天怎么样？
words.en: used as a friendly greeting

words.ex: His temperature is normal.
words.ex_cn: 他的体温正常。
words.en: Something that is normal is usual and ordinary, and is what people expect.

words.tr:
n. 单词；字；话语；“word”的复数
v. 措辞；“word”的第三人称单数
words.ex: He learned new words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天学习新单词。
words.en: The plural of 'word'; units of language used to communicate meaning.

words.ex: He gave a scornful look when she spoke.
words.ex_cn: 当她说话时，他投去轻蔑的一眼。
words.en: If you are scornful of someone or something, you show contempt or disdain for them.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: He bought the car on a whim.
words.ex_cn: 他一时兴起买了这辆车。
words.en: A whim is a sudden desire or change of mind, especially one that is unusual or unexplained.

words.tr: adv. 无论什么；任何(用于否定句中以加强语气)；
words.ex: You can eat whatever food whatsoever.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何食物。
words.en: used to emphasize a negative statement

words.tr: v. 使用；利用；“use”的现在分词； n. 使用；利用；
words.ex: He is using a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用一支笔写字。
words.en: To use something means to employ it for a particular purpose or to utilize it in a certain way.

words.tr: v. 蹲；蹲坐；擅自占用空地或空屋
words.ex: He is squatting near the river to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他正在河边蹲着洗手。
words.en: Squatting is the act of crouching or sitting with the knees bent and the thighs parallel to the ground, or the unauthorized occupation of an unused or abandoned space or building.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: The child has two strong legs.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子有两条强壮的腿。
words.en: Legs are the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr: n. 指令；说明；指示；“instruction”的复数；
words.ex: Follow the instructions on the box.
words.ex_cn: 按照盒子上的指令操作。
words.en: Instructions are detailed information about how to do something, especially how to use a piece of equipment or perform a task.

words.ex: I cannot swim.
words.ex_cn: 我不能游泳。
words.en: Cannot is the negative form of 'can'. It is used to say that someone is not able to do something or that something is not possible.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.tr: v. 徘徊；漫游；“wander”的现在分词；
words.ex: He was wandering in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后在公园里徘徊。
words.en: If you describe a person or their thoughts as wandering, you mean that the person is not concentrating on anything in particular and their thoughts are not clear.

words.ex: He tries to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早晨试图跑步。
words.en: If you try to do something, you make an effort to do it.

words.tr: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的；
words.ex: Their books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他们的书在桌子上。
words.en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: He walks slowly to enjoy the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地走，以便欣赏日落。
words.en: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed.

words.tr: v. 倒；喷涌；（雨）倾盆而下；“pour”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He poured water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进了玻璃杯里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.tr: v. 询问；请求；邀请；“ask”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He asked me where the library is.
words.ex_cn: 他问我图书馆在哪里。
words.en: Past simple and past participle of ask; to inquire or request something.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.tr: adj. 已婚的； v. 结婚；“marry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They are married and have two children.
words.ex_cn: 他们已婚，有两个孩子。
words.en: Having a husband or wife; united in matrimony.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子饿了，哭着要吃的。
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.tr: adj. 角状的；角质的；坚硬的；粗糙的；好色的；性饥渴的
words.ex: The deer has a large horny antler.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿有一只巨大的角状鹿角。
words.en: If you describe someone as horny, you mean that they are sexually aroused or that they easily become sexually aroused. It can also describe something that is made of horn or is hard like horn.

words.ex: I honestly don't know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我诚实地不知道答案。
words.en: In a way that is truthful and sincere; without deceit.

words.tr: v. 绑；系；拴；约束；与...成平局；“tie”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He tied his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系好了鞋带。
words.en: If something is tied, it is fastened or secured with a knot or similar method.

words.ex: He had a sore throat after singing all night.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一整晚后喉咙疼。
words.en: Your throat is the back part of your mouth, where it connects to your neck. It includes the passage that leads from your mouth to your stomach and lungs.

words.ex: Someone left their bag on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 有人把包落在椅子上了。
words.en: You use someone to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

words.ex: He has a small dog.
words.ex_cn: 他有一只小狗。
words.en: If something is small, it is not large in size or amount.

words.tr: v. 到达；联络；到达( reach的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He reached the station just in time.
words.ex_cn: 他刚好及时到达了车站。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a long or difficult journey; to achieve something after trying hard; to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something.

words.tr: v. 拉过来；拉( pull的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He pulled the chair closer to the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把椅子拉近了桌子。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of pull. To exert force on (someone or something) so as to cause movement towards oneself.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He washed his mouth after eating.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完饭后洗了嘴。
words.en: The opening in the lower part of the human face, surrounded by the lips, through which food is taken in and sound is uttered.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.ex: He grabbed his bag and ran out.
words.ex_cn: 他抓起包就跑了。
words.en: To take hold of something or someone suddenly and firmly.

words.tr:
v. 感到；认为；触摸；
n. 感受；
words.ex: I feel happy today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天感到开心。
words.en: To experience a sensation or emotion through touch or perception.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树周围跑。
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr: v. 告诉；“tell”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He told me the news.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉了我这个消息。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of tell. To communicate information, facts, or news to someone in spoken or written words.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.tr: v. 好像，仿佛；好像，仿佛( seem的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He seemed tired after the long walk.
words.ex_cn: 经过长时间的散步，他看起来很累。
words.en: If something seems to be a particular thing or to have a particular quality, it appears to be that thing or to have that quality.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很好。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.ex: The stars are bright at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚星星很亮。
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.ex: My mom makes breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A mother; a female parent.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.ex: My dad cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我爸爸每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A father; a male parent.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.tr:
v. 希望；
n. 希望；
words.ex: I hope it rains tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我希望明天下雨。
words.en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.ex: Everyone likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

words.tr: adj. 离婚的； v. “divorce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a divorced father with two children.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有兩個孩子的離婚父親。
words.en: If someone is divorced, they are no longer married because their marriage has been legally ended.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.ex: Mmm, I'm not sure about that.
words.ex_cn: 嗯，我不确定那件事。
words.en: An interjection used to express thoughtfulness, hesitation, or mild uncertainty.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.ex: He fears going to hell after death.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕死后去地狱。
words.en: Hell is a place of suffering and punishment in some religions, where bad people are believed to go after they die.

words.ex: Why did you come late?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么来晚了？
words.en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

words.ex: You should eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 你应该多吃蔬菜。
words.en: You use 'should' when you are saying what would be the right thing to do or the right state for something to be in.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上。
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: How do you make coffee?
words.ex_cn: 你如何煮咖啡？
words.en: In what way or manner; by what means.

words.tr: v. 固定；凝视；沉迷于（fixate 的现在分词）
words.ex: He is fixating on his phone screen.
words.ex_cn: 他正盯着手机屏幕。
words.en: Becoming obsessively focused on a single idea or object, often to an unhealthy degree.

words.tr:
v. 停止；阻止；
n. 停止；阻止；车站；停留；
words.ex: He stopped walking when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他停止了走路。
words.en: If you stop something from happening, you prevent it from happening or prevent it from continuing.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.tr: n. 清洁；使清洁的人或物；清洁，使清洁的人或物 adj. 有去污作用的 v. 弄干净，清洗( cleanse的现在分词； v. 弄干净；清洗； adj. 有去污作用的；
words.ex: The cleansing of the river took many months.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的清洁花了好几个月。
words.en: The act of cleaning something, especially the skin.

words.ex: The old house has a mysterious aura.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子有一种神秘的氛围。
words.en: An aura is a distinctive atmosphere or quality that seems to surround and be generated by a person, thing, or place.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他独自在公园里散步。
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: I will call you sometime next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周某个时候给你打电话。
words.en: At some unspecified or unknown time.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.ex: The system has a vulnerability that hackers can exploit.
words.ex_cn: 这个系统有一个黑客可以利用的脆弱性。
words.en: The state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.tr:
n. 因素；要素；倍数；
v. 把…因素包括进去；
words.ex: Weather is a factor in the game's outcome.
words.ex_cn: 天气是比赛结果的一个因素。
words.en: A factor is one of the things that affects an event, decision, or situation.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.ex: He crushed the can with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把罐子压碎了。
words.en: To crush something means to press it very hard so that its shape is destroyed or so that it breaks into pieces. It can also mean to defeat someone completely, or to make someone feel extremely upset or disappointed.

words.ex: He drinks wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时喝葡萄酒。
words.en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.

words.ex: He was born in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于2000年。
words.en: A year is a period of time that is approximately equal to the time it takes for the Earth to make one complete orbit around the Sun.

words.ex: We work together every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天一起工作。
words.en: If people do something together, they do it with each other.

words.ex: He thinks it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you think that something is the case, you have the opinion that it is the case.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: He put the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: If you put something in a particular place or position, you move it into that place or position.

words.ex: The children saw lizards in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在花园里看到了蜥蜴。
words.en: Lizards are reptiles that are typically distinguished by their dry scaly skin, four legs, movable eyelids, and external ear openings.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.tr: v. 获得；了解；“get”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is getting a new phone for his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为生日获得一部新手机。
words.en: The act of obtaining or receiving something, or the process of becoming.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.tr: v. 来；到来；“come”的现在分词； adj. 即将发生的； n. 到来；来临；
words.ex: He is coming to my house tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要来我家。
words.en: The act of arriving or the arrival of something or someone.

words.tr: v. “be”的现在分词；是；在； n. 存在；生物；人；生命；
words.ex: He is being quiet in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆里保持安静。
words.en: The state or quality of having existence.

words.ex: Although it was raining, he went outside.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite the fact that; even though.

words.tr:
int. 对不起；抱歉；
adj. 抱歉的；遗憾的；
words.ex: Sorry, I broke your cup.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我打碎了你的杯子。
words.en: feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.tr: int. 谢谢； n. 感谢；“thank”的复数；
words.ex: Thanks for helping me.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢你帮我。
words.en: an expression of gratitude

words.tr: v. 采取；接受；拿；取；乘坐；吃；“take”的过去式；
words.ex: He took a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了一种新的方法来解决问题。
words.en: The past tense of 'take', which means to lay hold of something with one's hands; to reach for and hold.

words.tr:
n. 词；单词；话语；
v. 用词语表达；
words.ex: This word means 'happy' in English.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在英语中意思是‘高兴’。
words.en: A single unit of language that has meaning and can be spoken or written.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: The children gazes at the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们凝视着星星。
words.en: Looks or stares intently, often with interest or curiosity.

words.tr:
adv. 足够地；充分地；
adj. 足够的；充足的；
int. 够了；
words.ex: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得不够快，没能赢得比赛。
words.en: as much or as many as required.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看到树上有一只鸟。
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.tr: adj. 更老的；更旧的；更年老的；“old”的比较级；
words.ex: My older brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥年纪更大一些，是一名老师。
words.en: Comparative of old; having lived or existed for a longer time; more aged.

words.tr: adj. 极客的；怪咖的；对电脑痴迷的
words.ex: He's always been a bit geeky, spending hours coding on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他一直有点极客，花几个小时在电脑上编码。
words.en: If you describe someone as geeky, you mean they are very interested in computers and technology, and perhaps have little social skill.

words.tr: adj. 以图形和数字表示的，华丽的
words.ex: He figured out the answer quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快算出了答案。
words.en: Having a pattern or design; to calculate or think.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.ex: That was the scariest movie I've ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 那是我看过的最可怕的电影。
words.en: Superlative form of 'scary', meaning the most frightening or causing the most fear.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.ex_cn: 书在哪里？
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.tr: adj. 未切割的；未删节的；完整的
words.ex: He bought an uncut diamond.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一颗未经切割的钻石。
words.en: not cut; not having been cut; complete and not shortened in any way

words.ex: This is the book I bought.
words.ex_cn: 这是我自己买的那本书。
words.en: used to refer to a specific person or thing that has already been mentioned or is known about

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.ex_cn: 我有一个苹果。
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.ex: The plane's monica detected an approaching aircraft.
words.ex_cn: 飞机的机尾警戒雷达探测到了一架接近的飞机。
words.en: A common female given name.

words.tr: v. 得到；受到（惩罚等）；说服；抓住；
words.ex: He gets a gift on his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日时得到一份礼物。
words.en: To come into possession or use of something; receive or obtain.

words.tr:
art. 一（个）
n. 英文字母表的第一个字母
words.ex: A cat is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 一只猫在桌子上。
words.en: Used before nouns to refer to a single thing or person that has not been mentioned before.

words.ex: She transcribed the interview notes into a report.
words.ex_cn: v. 她把采访笔记转录成了一份报告。
words.en: To transcribe means to make a written copy of spoken material or to represent speech sounds in written form.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.tr: v. “write”的过去分词；写作；书写； adj. 书面的；
words.ex: The letter was written by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这封信是手写的。
words.en: Something that is written has been recorded in writing rather than spoken.

words.ex: David is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 大卫正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Hebrew name דָּוִד (Dāwīḏ), meaning 'beloved'.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: I pick the red shirt for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我为派对选择红色衬衫。
words.en: To choose something from a group of things or people, or to remove something from a place using your fingers or a tool.

words.ex: The teacher checked the answers on the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了试卷上的答案。
words.en: An answer is a response to a question, problem, or situation. It can be a solution to a problem or a reply to a question.

words.tr: v. 返回，回来； n. 利润；回复( return的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He returns home every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都回家。
words.en: Returns refer to the act of coming or going back to a place or activity, or the profits obtained from an investment.

words.tr: v. （he 的第三人称单数现在时）犹豫；迟疑（注：hes 并非标准英语单词，可能是 he's 的误写，正确形式应为 he's = he is）
words.ex: He hes to answer the question.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着不回答问题。
words.en: A possessive pronoun, contraction of 'he is' or 'he has'; e.g., 'He's leaving.

words.ex: He hurt his ear while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了耳朵。
words.en: The organ of hearing in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of this organ.

words.ex: The fisherman showed his catches from the morning trip.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫展示了他早晨捕获的渔获物。
words.en: To catch means to capture or seize something after a chase or search.

words.ex: He stares at the sky every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上凝视着天空。
words.en: To look fixedly or intently at someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.tr:
n. 绒毛
v. 使松软；搞砸
words.ex: The cat's fur is full of fluff.
words.ex_cn: 猫的毛上全是绒毛。
words.en: Fluff can refer to soft fibers from fabrics or the like, or to something of little importance or substance. It can also mean to make something fluffy or to make a mistake.

words.tr: v. 接着发生；因而产生
words.ex: Chaos ensues when the lights go out.
words.ex_cn: 灯一灭，混乱就发生了。
words.en: If something ensues, it happens immediately after another event, usually as a result of it.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.tr: v. 倾倒；倒；“pour”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is pouring water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把水倒进玻璃杯里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: The makeup of the team includes students from five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的组成包括来自五个国家的学生。
words.en: Makeup refers to substances applied to the face to improve or alter the appearance, or the way in which something is composed or arranged.

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.ex_cn: 她打开灯来读书。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.tr: v. 提出理由证明；坚决主张；争吵；争吵，辩论( argue的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is arguing that exercise improves mental health.
words.ex_cn: 他提出理由证明锻炼能改善心理健康。
words.en: Arguing: (verb) Having a heated verbal disagreement.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.ex: We visited a museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个博物馆。
words.en: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

words.ex: Marsha is my best friend from college.
words.ex_cn: 玛莎是我大学时最好的朋友。
words.en: Marsha is a female given name, often a variant of Marcia.

words.tr: n. 人体模型；时装模特儿（复数）
words.ex: The store displays clothes on mannequins.
words.ex_cn: 商店用模特展示衣服。
words.en: Life-sized figures used to display clothing in shops, often made of plastic or wax.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.ex: He likes to read history books about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读关于古罗马的历史书籍。
words.en: History is the study of past events, particularly in human affairs.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: Cobalt, or Co, is used in batteries.
words.ex_cn: 钴（Co）用于电池中。
words.en: prefix meaning together, jointly, or mutually, used in the formation of compound words.

words.ex: The boy found a dark cave near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在山附近发现了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cave is a large hole in the side of a cliff or hill, or one that is under the ground.

words.tr: v. 回答；回应；“answer”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is answering the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 他正在回答老师的问题。
words.en: If you answer someone, you say something to them in response to something they have said or done.

words.ex: He took the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿走了书。
words.en: If something is taken, it has been removed or captured from a place or person.

words.ex: It is quite cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天很冷。
words.en: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree; fairly.

words.ex: Be careful when you cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 过马路时要小心。
words.en: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes.

words.ex: Mindy is playing with her doll.
words.ex_cn: Mindy在玩她的洋娃娃。
words.en: A female given name, often a diminutive of Melinda or similar names, used informally to refer to a specific person.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: If you hurt someone, you cause them to feel pain. If you hurt a part of your body, you feel pain there. If someone is hurt, they are injured.

words.tr: v. 想要；需要；“want”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 受通缉的；
words.ex: He wanted a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一辆新自行车。
words.en: If someone is wanted by the police, the police are searching for them because they are suspected of committing a crime.

words.tr: n. 正牙医生；牙齿矫正医师
words.ex: He visits the orthodontist every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都去看牙科正畸医生。
words.en: A dentist who is qualified to treat irregularities in the teeth and jaws.

words.ex: He will return next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月回来。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.ex: I saw him two days ago.
words.ex_cn: 我两天前见过他。
words.en: If something happened a particular length of time ago, it is that length of time since it happened.

words.ex: Jason is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 杰森是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Greek name Ιάσων (Iason), which possibly means 'healer'.

words.tr: v. 塞住…的口；压制言论
words.ex: They were gagging the prisoner with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他们用一块布塞住了囚犯的嘴。
words.en: To prevent someone from speaking or expressing their opinions, often by using authority or force; or to choke or have difficulty in breathing because something is blocking your throat.

words.ex: Bernice walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 伯尼斯每天早上走路去上学。
words.en: A proper noun, typically a female given name; no standard English definition exists.

words.ex: My grandmother bakes cookies every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我祖母每个星期天都烤饼干。
words.en: Your grandmother is the mother of your father or mother.

words.ex: Dr. Smith is a famous scientist.
words.ex_cn: 史密斯博士是一位著名的科学家。
words.en: Abbreviation for 'doctor' or 'doctorate'.

words.tr: n. 迫击炮; vt. 用迫击炮轰击
words.ex: The soldiers fired a minnie at the enemy bunker.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们向敌人的掩体发射了一门迫击炮。
words.en: Minnie is a fictional character created by The Walt Disney Company. As the longtime sweetheart of Mickey Mouse, she is an anthropomorphic mouse with a sweet voice and cheerful personality.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.tr:
adj. 偏执狂的；患妄想狂的；过分猜疑的
n. 偏执狂患者；妄想症患者
words.ex: He is paranoid that someone is watching him.
words.ex_cn: 他总觉得有人在监视他。
words.en: If you say that someone is paranoid, you mean that they are extremely suspicious and afraid of other people.

words.tr: v. 说话；讨论；说； n. 讲话，交谈 talk的过去式 v. 说话；说( talk的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: She talked to her friend yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天和朋友说话了。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; converse or communicate by spoken words.

words.ex: His silence was suggesting he disagreed.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: To suggest means to put forward for consideration or to hint at something indirectly.

words.tr: n. 边界；边疆；“border”的复数； v. 和…毗邻；与…接壤；
words.ex: The two countries agreed on their borders.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家同意了它们的边界。
words.en: The limits or edges of an area, especially the political dividing line between two countries or regions.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.tr:
v. 降低；落下；
n. 落下；
words.ex: The temperature drops at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度降低。
words.en: 1. a small round or pear-shaped portion of liquid that hangs or falls, or adheres to a surface. 2. to let or make something fall vertically. 3. a small quantity of liquid.

words.ex: The doctor checked her cervix during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查时查看了她的宫颈。
words.en: The cervix is the lower, narrow part of the uterus (womb). The cervix connects the main body of the uterus to the vagina (birth canal).

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: Ew, that smell is terrible!
words.ex_cn: 呸，这气味太难闻了！
words.en: interjection used to express disgust or aversion

words.tr: n. 迪娜（人名，常为女性名）
words.ex: Dinah is singing a song in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 迪娜正在花园里唱歌。
words.en: A proper noun, typically a female given name; no standard English definition exists.

words.ex: The boys are playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这些男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: Boys are male children or young men.

words.ex: This small enterprise makes handmade toys.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业生产手工玩具。
words.en: An enterprise is a company or business, often a large one, or a difficult or important project, especially one that involves a lot of planning and organization.

words.ex: 'What time is it?' 'Dunno.'
words.ex_cn: ‘现在几点了？’ ‘不知道。’
words.en: Informal contraction of 'do not know'.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.tr: adj.最大的【形容词big的最高级】
words.ex: This is the biggest apple I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最大的苹果。
words.en: Of the greatest size or extent; largest.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.tr: int. 嗯(用于问题、建议之后)；嗯(表示没有听清楚)；
words.ex: You're going now? Huh?
words.ex_cn: 你现在就走？嗯？
words.en: Used to express confusion, surprise, or to ask for repetition.

words.tr: n. 误解；误会； v. “misunderstand”的现在分词；
words.ex: There was a misunderstanding between them about the time.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间对时间产生了误解。
words.en: A misunderstanding is a failure to understand something correctly, often leading to confusion or disagreement.

words.tr: v. 写作；“write”的过去式；书写；写信；
words.ex: He wrote a letter to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友写了一封信。
words.en: The past tense of write, which means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: She sees a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 她看见树上有一只鸟。
words.en: To perceive with the eyes; to understand or realize something.

words.tr: v. 实现；实现（realise 的过去分词）；
words.ex: He realised his dream of becoming a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他实现了成为医生的梦想。
words.en: If you realise something, you become aware of it or you understand it.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.tr: adj. 明显的； v. “glare”的现在分词；
words.ex: The mistake was glaring to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个错误对每个人来说都很明显。
words.en: If you describe something bad as glaring, you are emphasizing that it is very obvious and easily seen.

words.tr: adj. 成球的；被弄成球形的
words.ex: She balled the paper into a tight wad before throwing it away.
words.ex_cn: 她把纸揉成一个紧实的球后扔掉了。
words.en: Formed into a ball or balls.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr:
n. 事情；物质；
v. 要紧；
words.ex: What's the matter with you?
words.ex_cn: 你怎么了？
words.en: Matter is a physical substance in general, as distinct from mind and spirit; (in physics) that which occupies space and possesses rest mass, especially as distinct from energy. It can also refer to a subject or situation under consideration.

words.ex: There are 637 girls in the school.
words.ex_cn: 学校里有637个女孩。
words.en: Female children or young women.

words.tr: n. 战斗； v. 战斗；“fight”的现在分词；
words.ex: The fighting lasted for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这场战斗持续了三天。
words.en: The act of engaging in combat or battle.

words.ex: He drives a red car to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开车去上班。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；“prefer”的过去式或过去分词；
words.ex: She preferred tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: Liked or wanted more than anything else; chosen in preference to others.

words.ex: The dragon is an imaginary creature.
words.ex_cn: 龙是一种想象中的生物。
words.en: An imaginary person, place, or thing is one that does not exist or is not real, but that people think about or talk about.

words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.tr:
adj. 粉红色的；
n. 粉红色；
words.ex: The flower is pink.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是粉红色的。
words.en: Pink is a pale red color that is named after the flower of the same name. It is often associated with femininity and romance.

words.tr: n. 开始；开口；空缺职位； v. 打开；“open”的现在分词； adj. 开始的；
words.ex: The opening of the meeting was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 会议的开始被推迟了。
words.en: An opening is a gap or hole in something, or the act of making or becoming open. It can also refer to the beginning of an event or period.

words.ex: Floyd is walking to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 弗洛伊德每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: A proper name, often used as a first name or surname.

words.tr: v. 来；到达；达到（认识、理解或相信的程度；
words.ex: He comes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天来学校。
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker.

words.tr: n. 喜剧演员；滑稽人物；
words.ex: The comedian made everyone laugh with his jokes.
words.ex_cn: 这位喜剧演员用他的笑话逗得大家大笑。
words.en: A comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes or funny stories.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母帮我做作业。
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: The flatness of the land made it easy to build a road.
words.ex_cn: 土地的平坦使修建道路变得容易。
words.en: The quality or condition of being flat.

words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.ex: He waits for days to get a reply.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几天才得到回复。
words.en: Days refer to the time between sunrise and sunset, or a period of 24 hours.

words.ex: The smell of the food made her feel nausea.
words.ex_cn: 食物的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.tr: adj. 荒废的； v. “ruin”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old house is ruined after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子在风暴后变得荒废了。
words.en: If something is ruined, it is severely damaged or destroyed, often beyond repair.

words.tr: v. 看；“see”的现在分词；领悟； conj. 鉴于；
words.ex: I am seeing the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我正在看树上的鸟。
words.en: the ability to see; the act of perceiving with the eyes

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃苹果。
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.ex: He stopped swallowing when the medicine tasted bad.
words.ex_cn: 当药味道很苦时，他停止了吞咽。
words.en: The act of taking food, liquid, or medicine into the stomach and down the throat.

words.ex: The car slowed down near the school.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在学校附近减慢了速度。
words.en: To become slower or to make something become slower.

words.tr: adj. 糟糕的；坏的；严重的；
words.ex: The weather today is bad.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you describe something as bad, you mean that it is of a low or unacceptable standard or quality.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.ex: The mastodon was a massive prehistoric creature.
words.ex_cn: 乳齿象是一种巨大的史前生物。
words.en: A mastodon is any species of extinct proboscidean in the genus Mammut, distantly related to elephants, that inhabited North and Central America during the late Miocene or late Pliocene up to their extinction at the end of the Pleistocene 10,000 to 11,000 years ago.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.tr: adj. 极好的;令人兴奋的
words.ex: The party was banging until the early hours of the morning.
words.ex_cn: adj. 派对直到凌晨都非常热闹。
words.en: adjective INFORMAL extremely good or exciting.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.tr: v. 讲话；发言；“speak”的现在分词； n. 谈话；演讲； adj. 交谈的；
words.ex: He is speaking to his friend on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他正在打电话和朋友讲话。
words.en: The act of talking or making speeches in public.

words.tr: n. <非正式>前妻，前夫，以前的性伴侣; prep. （货物）直接从……出售；<美>（货物）从……...
words.ex: He still talks about his ex like she was his best friend.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然像她是他最好的朋友一样谈论他的前妻。
words.en: Someone's ex is a person they were married to or were having a romantic or sexual relationship with, but are no longer married to or having a relationship with.

words.ex: The news reported many issues last week.
words.ex_cn: 新闻报道了上周的许多事件。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are discussing or arguing about.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；喊叫；
v. 哭；哭泣；
words.ex: His cry woke up the whole house.
words.ex_cn: 他的哭泣惊醒了整个房子。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain; to shout or scream, typically to express fear, pain, or grief.

words.tr: v. 使处于某种状态；表达；放置；
words.ex: He puts the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: To move something to a particular position or place; to cause someone or something to be in a particular state; to express something in words.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: The child listens to stories every night before bed.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子每晚睡觉前听故事。
words.en: Stories are accounts of imaginary or real people and events told for entertainment.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上看新闻。
words.en: News is information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by newspapers, radio, television, or online media.

words.tr: n. 人们；人民；民族；“folk”的复数；
words.ex: The folks in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: People in general, or a group of people related to each other.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr: n. 寓所，住处 v. 挖，掘( dig的第三人称单数 ); （如用铲、锨或推土机等）挖掘; 挖得;
words.ex: They moved into their new digs last week.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周搬进了新寓所。
words.en: Digs refers to a place where someone lives, especially a rented room or apartment.

words.tr: adv. 绝望地；拼命地；不顾一切地；极度地
words.ex: He is desperately trying to find his lost dog.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拼命寻找他丢失的狗。
words.en: In a way that shows a lack of hope and a willingness to do anything to change a situation, often involving a lot of effort or risk.

words.tr: n. 掌故，趣闻，轶事( anecdote的名词复数 )
words.ex: He told us funny anecdotes about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他给我们讲了关于他童年的有趣小故事。
words.en: A short amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.

words.ex: Tears were welling up in her eyes as she listened to the sad story.
words.ex_cn: v. 她听着悲伤的故事时，眼泪涌上了她的眼睛。
words.en: To rise or gush forth, as water from the earth.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是你的。
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很容易。
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.ex: He put the bread in the pan.
words.ex_cn: 他把面包放进平底锅里。
words.en: A pan is a round metal container with a long handle, which is used for cooking things in, usually on top of a stove.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户是玻璃做的。
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.tr: v. 给予；发出；“give”的过去式；
words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了我一本书。
words.en: Past tense of give, which means to freely transfer the possession of something to someone.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He ran unbelievably fast in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中跑得不可思议地快。
words.en: In a manner that is hard to believe; extremely.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.tr: n. 计划；规划； v. 计划；打算；“plan”的现在分词；
words.ex: The planning for the trip took a week.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的计划花了一周时间。
words.en: The process of making plans for something.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.tr: v. 使朝（某方向或按某方式）移动；促使；提供；带来( bring的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was bringing the box toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正把箱子朝门口搬。
words.en: To carry, convey, lead, or cause to go along to another place.

words.ex: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

words.ex: The soldiers loaded ammunition into their guns.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们把弹药装进枪里。
words.en: Ammunition refers to the projectiles and propelling charges used in guns, firearms, or any other weapons.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.tr:
adv. 远；极；
adj. 较远的；遥远的；
words.ex: He ran far from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得离房子很远。
words.en: At, to, or by a great distance (used to indicate the extent to which one thing is distant from another).

words.tr: adj. 担心的；关注的； v. 涉及到；“concern”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My parents are concerned about my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母对我的成绩感到担心。
words.en: If you are concerned about something, you are worried about it.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.tr: adj. 出生的；天生的； v. 生（孩子）；“bear”的过去分词；
words.ex: He is a born teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是个天生的老师。
words.en: When a baby is born, it comes out of its mother's body at the beginning of its life.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.tr: v. 亲吻；接吻；“kiss”的现在分词
words.ex: The breeze was kissing her face gently.
words.ex_cn: 微风轻轻拂过她的脸颊。
words.en: The act of touching someone with your lips as a sign of love, greeting, or respect.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.ex: The boy kicked the ball into the net.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把球踢进了网里。
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as soccer, baseball, and basketball. It can also refer to a formal dance.

words.ex: Tungsten wire is used in light bulbs because it has a high melting point.
words.ex_cn: 钨丝用于灯泡中，因为它具有高熔点。
words.en: A noun referring to a type of hard, crystalline mineral, typically blue, used in jewelry and decorative items.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.ex: He solves math puzzles every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解数学谜题。
words.en: A puzzle is a game, toy, or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge. As a verb, it means to cause someone to feel confused because they cannot understand or make sense of something.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小孩在玩球。
words.en: A kid is a child or young person. As a verb, to kid means to tease or deceive someone in a playful way.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.ex: I play soccer with my friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我每个周末都和朋友一起踢足球。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: The chubby baby laughed loudly.
words.ex_cn: 那个胖乎乎的宝宝大声笑了。
words.en: Someone who is chubby is slightly fat in a way that people often find attractive.

words.tr: v. 花费；度过；“spend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He spent five dollars on bread.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五美元买面包。
words.en: If you are spent, you are extremely tired and have no energy left.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: The stars shine brightly at night.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜晚明亮地闪耀。
words.en: Stars are celestial bodies that appear as points of light in the night sky. They are massive, luminous spheres of plasma held together by gravity.

words.ex: The soldier shoot at the target.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向目标射击。
words.en: To shoot means to fire a bullet from a gun or to take a photograph. It can also refer to the act of a plant sprouting or a player attempting to score in sports by sending the ball or puck towards the goal.

words.tr: adj. 满意的；满足的； v. 使满意；使满足；“satisfy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was satisfied with the result.
words.ex_cn: 他对结果感到满意。
words.en: If you are satisfied with something, you are happy because you have got what you wanted or needed.

words.tr: v. 出版；发布；“publish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 出版了的；发布了的；
words.ex: He published a book last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年出版了一本书。
words.en: To publish something means to make it available to the public, usually by printing it in a book, magazine, or newspaper, or by broadcasting it on the radio or television.

words.tr: n. 论文；文件；报纸；考卷；文章；“paper”的复数；
words.ex: He wrote three papers about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了三篇关于气候变化的论文。
words.en: Papers are documents containing information, such as reports, essays, or newspapers.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.ex: His expression showed he was happy.
words.ex_cn: 他的表情显示他很快乐。
words.en: The act of making your thoughts, feelings, etc., known by speech, writing, or some other method.

words.tr:
n. 品味；味觉；味道；
v. 有 ...味道；
words.ex: Her tastes in music are very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 她在音乐方面的品味与我的完全不同。
words.en: If you taste something, you eat or drink a small amount of it in order to try its flavor, for example, to see if you like it or not.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: Martha is coming to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: n. 玛莎今晚要来参加派对。
words.en: Martha is a female given name of Aramaic origin, meaning 'lady' or 'mistress'.

words.ex: My daughter loves to read books.
words.ex_cn: 我的女儿喜欢读书。
words.en: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parents.

words.ex: He eats curry every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上吃咖喱。
words.en: Curry refers to a variety of dishes originating in the Indian subcontinent that use a complex combination of spices or herbs, usually including ground turmeric, cumin, coriander, ginger, and fresh or dried chilies. It also refers to the act of grooming a horse with a special comb.

words.tr: v. 缺少； n. 需求；欲望；必需品；需要的东西；缺乏( want的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He wants water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后缺少水。
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.tr: v. 毕业；“graduate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 标有刻度的；
words.ex: He graduated from high school last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年从高中毕业。
words.en: Having successfully completed a course of study and received a degree or diploma.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.tr: n. 烹饪； adj. 烹调用的； v. 烹饪；“cook”的现在分词；
words.ex: Cooking is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 烹饪是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: The act of preparing food by heating it.

words.tr:
adv. 最小；最少；
adj. 最少的；最小的；
n. 最小；最少；
words.ex: He ran the least among all the runners.
words.ex_cn: 他在所有跑步者中跑得最少。
words.en: You use least to indicate that something is the smallest in amount, degree, or size, or the lowest in importance.

words.ex: The priest placed the offering on the altar.
words.ex_cn: 牧师把供品放在祭坛上。
words.en: An altar is a raised area in a place of worship where people can honor God with offerings.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.tr: adv. 早些时候；“early”的比较级； adj. 之前的；早期的；“early”的比较级；
words.ex: He left the party earlier.
words.ex_cn: 他早些时候离开了派对。
words.en: Before the present time or before the time one is referring to.

words.tr: v. 经营；跑步；“run”的过去式；
words.ex: He ran a small coffee shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经营一家小咖啡店。
words.en: The past tense of 'run', which means to move swiftly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.tr: v. 使大吃一惊；击晕( stun的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The news stunned her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她大吃一惊。
words.en: If you are stunned by something, you are extremely shocked or surprised by it and therefore unable to speak or react for a while.

words.tr: adj. 丢失的； v. 丢失；输；“lose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lost keys were found under the table.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙在桌子下面找到了。
words.en: If you are lost, you do not know where you are or you are unable to find your way.

words.tr: v. 使害怕；吓唬（scare 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: The loud noise was scaring the children.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子们。
words.en: Causing fear or alarm.

words.ex: The room was chaotic after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片混乱。
words.en: If a situation, place, or system is chaotic, it is in a state of complete disorder and confusion.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.tr: v. 怒视；瞪眼（glare 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He glares at the noisy kids.
words.ex_cn: 他瞪着那些吵闹的孩子。
words.en: Stares angrily or intensely with narrowed eyes.

words.tr: v. 弄糟；失误；（使）蓬松（fluff 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He fluffed his lines during the play.
words.ex_cn: 他在演出中把台词说错了。
words.en: Made a mistake or bungled something, often in a casual or clumsy way.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天讲英语。
words.en: To say words in order to express thoughts, feelings, or opinions.

words.tr: v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；“power”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有动力装置的；用动力推动的；
words.ex: The solar panel powered the light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能板为灯提供了能量。
words.en: Having a specified source of energy or motive force.

words.tr: v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的过去分词； adj. 发愤图强的；
words.ex: Fear of failure drove him to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 对失败的恐惧驱使他更加努力工作。
words.en: If you describe someone as driven, you mean they are very strongly motivated to achieve something or to do something.

words.ex: He built a successful career in medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他在医学领域建立了成功的事业。
words.en: A career is the job or series of jobs that you do during your working life, especially if you continue to get better jobs and earn more money.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.ex: The twins are playing in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 双胞胎正在花园里玩耍。
words.en: Twins are two offspring produced by the same pregnancy.

words.tr:
v. （使）倾斜；（使）偏向
n. 倾斜；企图
words.ex: The boy tilt the cup and spill the water.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把杯子倾斜，水洒了出来。
words.en: If you tilt an object or if it tilts, it moves into a sloping position with one end or side higher than the other.

words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.ex: He closed his eyes to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他闭上眼睛休息。
words.en: The eyes are the organs of sight. They detect light and convert it into electro-chemical impulses in neurons.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.ex: She hesitates before answering the difficult question.
words.ex_cn: v. 她在回答这个难题前犹豫了。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause before doing something, especially because you are uncertain or nervous about it.

words.ex: He realizes his mistake quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快意识到了自己的错误。
words.en: To become aware of something or to achieve something that you have been hoping for.

words.ex: He became mad after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后变得发疯了。
words.en: If you say that someone is mad, you mean that they are very angry.

words.ex: He is eating lasagne for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃意大利千层面当晚餐。
words.en: A baked Italian dish consisting of layers of flat pasta, meat sauce, and cheese, typically served hot.

words.tr: v. 起作用；（使）工作；（使）运转； n. 作品；工厂；全部事物；“work”的复数；
words.ex: This medicine works well for headaches.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对头痛很有效。
words.en: The term 'works' can refer to a factory, the output of an artist or writer, a construction project, or a mechanical device.

words.tr: v. 猛击；抨击；用力关上（slam 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He slams the door when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时砰地关上门。
words.en: To criticize or attack someone or something harshly and publicly.

words.tr: v. 射击；拍摄（电影）；疾驰；“shoot”的过去式和过去分词； n. 照片；射击；射门；
words.ex: He shot the target with his gun.
words.ex_cn: 他用枪射击了目标。
words.en: A shot is an act of shooting a gun, or the sound that this makes. It can also refer to an attempt to do something, a photograph, or an injection.

words.ex: I saw a bird fly over the house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一只鸟飞过房子。
words.en: A saw is a tool consisting of a tough blade, wire, or chain with a hard toothed edge. It is used to cut through material, very often wood, though sometimes metal or stone. The cut is made by placing the toothed edge against the material and moving it forcefully forth and less forcefully back or continuously forward.

words.ex: He has a big nose.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个大鼻子。
words.en: The part of the face or head that contains the nostrils and organs of smell and through which a person or animal breathes.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.tr:
n. 发际线
adj. （裂缝、缝隙等）极细的；极细微的
words.ex: He has a thin hairline.
words.ex_cn: 他的发际线很细。
words.en: A hairline is the edge of a person's hair, especially at the front, or a very thin line.

words.ex: This shirt is cheap and nice.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫又便宜又好看。
words.en: If something is cheap, it costs less money than usual or than you expected.

words.tr:
v. 附着；粘贴；
adj. 粘或有粘性的；
words.ex: The sticker is sticking to the table.
words.ex_cn: 贴纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: The present participle of the verb 'stick', which means to attach something to something else using a sticky substance, to continue doing something despite difficulties, or to extend out from a surface.

words.ex: The camera has two lenses.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有两个透镜。
words.en: Lenses are pieces of glass or other transparent material that are used in optical instruments to form images by focusing light.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.tr:
n. 眼睛；
v. 注视；审视；
words.ex: He hurt his eye in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中伤了眼睛。
words.en: The organ of sight in humans and animals, typically one of a pair, which is sensitive to light and enables vision.

words.tr: v. 给予；发出；“give”的现在分词； adj. 慷慨善良的；
words.ex: He is giving his friend a book.
words.ex_cn: 他正在给他的朋友一本书。
words.en: The act of freely transferring the possession of something to someone else.

words.tr: v. 是…的成员；应被放在；
words.ex: He belongs to a book club.
words.ex_cn: 他是读书俱乐部的成员。
words.en: Is the property or possession of someone or something.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.ex: We will meet at the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在公园见面。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone by chance or arrangement.

words.ex: The maid cleans the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 女仆每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A maid is a woman who works as a servant in a hotel or in someone's home.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.ex: The cat is under the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: In or to a position below or beneath something.

words.ex: The sofa has soft cushions.
words.ex_cn: 沙发上有柔软的靠垫。
words.en: Cushions are soft objects that are used to make a seat or bed more comfortable, or to support a part of the body.

words.ex: The cat jumped onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
words.en: If something moves or is put onto an object or surface, it is then on that object or surface.

words.ex: He leans on the wall while waiting.
words.ex_cn: 他等的时候靠在墙上。
words.en: If someone leans on or against something, they incline their body towards it or rest against it for support. It can also mean to have a tendency or preference towards a particular belief or course of action.

words.tr: n. 插头；塞子；（对某事物的）大力宣传
words.ex: He plugs the charger into the socket.
words.ex_cn: 他把充电器插进插座。
words.en: Blocks or fills a hole or opening; also, electrical connectors for power or data.

words.tr: v. 抓住；抢夺；攫取（grab 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He grabs his bag and runs out.
words.ex_cn: 他抓起包就跑出去了。
words.en: Seizes or takes hold of something suddenly and roughly.

words.tr: n. (网球等运动中的)正手击球
words.ex: He paid in forehand for the new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他提前支付了新自行车的费用。
words.en: In sports such as tennis, a forehand is a stroke made with the palm of the hand facing in the direction of the stroke.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: She wore a white veil on her wedding day.
words.ex_cn: 她在婚礼那天戴了一条白色的面纱。
words.en: A veil is a piece of thin soft cloth that women sometimes wear over their heads and which can also cover their face.

words.tr:
n. 明天；
adv. 在明天；
words.ex: I will go to school tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天去学校。
words.en: The day after today; in the future.

words.ex: He stomped his foot in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地跺了跺脚。
words.en: To stomp means to walk with heavy steps, typically because of anger or to make a noise.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.ex: The rain makes the ground wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使地面变湿。
words.en: To produce or create something, often by putting different parts together, or to cause something to happen or exist.

words.tr:
adj. 更困难的；更硬的；
adv. 更努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is harder than the last one.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题比上一个更难。
words.en: Harder is the comparative form of hard, meaning more difficult or requiring more effort.

words.tr: v. (dread 的现在分词) 害怕；担心；预感不祥
words.ex: He is dreading the math test tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕明天的数学考试。
words.en: Feeling intense fear or anxiety about something.

words.ex: The math problem is complicated.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题很复杂。
words.en: Involving many different and confusing aspects.

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.tr: v. 扔掉；（为逃跑而）急忙放下；推卸；（非正式）抛弃（某人）；（非正式）抛售；卸出（数据）；（向国...
words.ex: He dumped the trash into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To dump something means to get rid of it in a way that shows you do not care about it, especially by leaving it somewhere or selling it very cheaply.

words.tr: n. 灯；“light”的复数； v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The lights in the room are bright.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的灯很亮。
words.en: Plural form of light, which refers to the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor with a broom.
words.ex_cn: 她用扫帚扫地。
words.en: A broom is a cleaning tool consisting of usually stiff fibers attached to, and roughly parallel to, a cylindrical handle, the broomstick. It is thus a variety of brush with a long handle.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.tr:
adj. 晒黑的
v. （使）晒成棕褐色；鞣（革）；“tan”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He has tanned at the beach last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天在海滩上晒黑了。
words.en: If someone is tanned, their skin has become darker as a result of spending time in the sun.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.tr: n. 倾听；收听； v. 听；“listen”的现在分词；
words.ex: Good listening helps you understand others.
words.ex_cn: 良好的倾听能帮助你理解他人。
words.en: The act of paying attention to and trying to hear something.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: The dog spits out the bitter pill.
words.ex_cn: 狗把苦药丸吐了出来。
words.en: To expel saliva or other substances from the mouth.

words.tr: adj. 卡住的；受困的； v. 粘贴；“stick”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The door is stuck and won't open.
words.ex_cn: 门卡住了，打不开。
words.en: If something is stuck in a particular position, it is fixed tightly in this position and is unable to move.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.tr: adj. 外科的；外科手术的；
words.ex: The surgical team worked quickly to save the patient.
words.ex_cn: 外科团队迅速工作以挽救病人。
words.en: Relating to or used in surgery.

words.tr:
n. 嘎嘎叫声；庸医；冒充内行的人
v. 嘎嘎地叫；大声闲谈；冒充内行
words.ex: The duck made a loud quack.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子发出了响亮的嘎嘎叫声。
words.en: A quack is someone who pretends to have medical skills that they do not really possess. It can also refer to the sound a duck makes.

words.tr: n. 镐( pick的名词复数 ); 最佳选择; 选中的人（或物） v. 摘; 啄; 采( pick
words.ex: He picks up his books after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后收拾书本。
words.en: The act of choosing or selecting something, often from a range of options.

words.tr: n. 哑剧演员（mime 的复数形式）
words.ex: The children mimes funny actions to make people laugh.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们模仿滑稽的动作来逗人笑。
words.en: Performs actions without speaking, using only gestures and expressions.

words.ex: The duck swims in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A duck is a bird that lives by water and has webbed feet, a short neck, and a large flat beak. As a verb, to duck means to lower the head or body quickly to avoid being hit or seen.

words.tr: v. 意识到；认识到；实现；
words.ex: He finally realised his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To realise means to become fully aware of something as a fact; understand clearly. It also means to achieve something desired or anticipated.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.ex: She pulls the door open every morning.
words.ex_cn: v. 她每天早上拉开门。
words.en: To exert force on (someone or something) so as to cause movement towards oneself.

words.tr: v. 命名；取名；“name”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 指定的；
words.ex: They named the baby Lily.
words.ex_cn: 他们给婴儿取名为莉莉。
words.en: Given a specified name or title.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.ex: The child is playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个儿童正在玩玩具。
words.en: A child is a human being who is not yet an adult.

words.tr:
n. 摇动；颤动；
v. 摇动；颤动；
words.ex: The shake of the car made me feel sick.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的摇动让我感到恶心。
words.en: To move or cause to move with quick, short movements from side to side or up and down.

words.ex: He ignored the warning sign.
words.ex_cn: 他忽视了警告标志。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: The mouse ran under the table.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠跑到了桌子下面。
words.en: A mouse is a small animal with a long tail, which is found in houses and fields and is often kept as a pet. In computing, a mouse is a small device that you move across a surface in order to move a cursor on your computer screen.

words.tr:
v. 位于；站立；忍受；
n. 立场；站立；摊位；站立；
words.ex: The castle stands on a hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡位于一座山上。
words.en: To be in an upright position on the feet; to be situated in a particular place; to tolerate or endure.

words.ex: They erect a flagpole in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里竖立一根旗杆。
