words.ex_cn: 他生气地打了墙一拳。
words.en: To punch means to hit someone or something hard with your fist, or to make a hole in something using a tool.

words.ex: He passes the test with ease.
words.ex_cn: 他轻松通过了考试。
words.en: To move past or go by something or someone; to transfer something to someone else; (of time) to elapse.

words.ex: Children wear costumes on halloween.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在万圣节穿服装。
words.en: Halloween is the evening before All Saints' Day, celebrated on October 31, when children dress up in costumes and go trick-or-treating.

words.tr: v. 去；走；“go”的过去分词； adj. 已往的；离去的；死去的；
words.ex: He is gone to the store.
words.ex_cn: 他去商店了。
words.en: No longer present; departed.

words.ex: There are eleven apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十一个苹果。
words.en: The number 11.

words.tr: n. 戏服；服装；衣服；“costume”的复数； v. “costume”的复数；
words.ex: The actors wore colorful costumes for the play.
words.ex_cn: 演员们为这场戏剧穿上了色彩鲜艳的戏服。
words.en: Costumes are clothes that are worn by actors in a play or film, or by someone to make them look like something else, especially at a party.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.tr: n. 会谈；‘“talk”的复数； v. 谈话；
words.ex: The talks between the two countries ended peacefully.
words.ex_cn: 两国之间的会谈和平结束。
words.en: Talks are formal discussions or negotiations between two or more parties, often with the aim of reaching an agreement or solving a problem.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: The teacher showed us slides about the solar system.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们展示了关于太阳系的幻灯片。
words.en: Slides can refer to a series of images projected onto a screen or a surface, typically used in presentations, or to a smooth, inclined surface for children to play on by sliding down. As a verb, it means to move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it.

words.ex: Sleeping is important for health.
words.ex_cn: 睡眠对健康很重要。
words.en: The state of being asleep or the process of resting with your eyes closed and your mind and body not active.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr: adj. （非标准用法）高兴的，愉快的（通常应为 glad）
words.ex: The news gladdened her heart.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她心情愉悦。
words.en: An obsolete term meaning to make glad or gladden.

words.tr: abbr.abbr. 运筹学与分析局（Directorate of Operational and Analy...
words.ex: DORA plays a crucial role in strategic planning.
words.ex_cn: 运筹学与分析局在战略规划中起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: A common female given name.

words.tr: abbr. 文学士；“Bachelor of Arts”的缩写
words.ex: The concept of the ba in ancient Egyptian mythology represents the soul of a person or deity.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及神话中的'身魂'概念代表人或神的灵魂。
words.en: A title or abbreviation for a Bachelor of Arts degree, or a term for a British Airways flight.

words.tr:
n. 朋友；伙伴
v. 结为伙伴
words.ex: He is my best pal.
words.ex_cn: 他是我最好的朋友。
words.en: A pal is a friend or companion.

words.ex: He gave her a romantic gift on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送了她一份浪漫的礼物。
words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.ex: He found himself in a predicament when he lost his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 当他丢掉钱包时，他陷入了困境。
words.en: A predicament is a difficult, perplexing, or trying situation.

words.tr:
n. 怪诞行为；
adj. 不正常的；怪异的；
words.ex: His freak of wearing socks with sandals surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他穿袜子配凉鞋的怪诞行为让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A freak is a person who is considered to be unusual because of their behaviour or interests, or a sudden and unexpected event or situation.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.ex: The lambs are eating grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 小羊正在田野里吃草。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.tr: v. 认为；考虑；“consider”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They considered him a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为他是个好老师。
words.en: If something is considered, it has been thought about carefully before a decision or action is taken.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: I will love you forever.
words.ex_cn: 我会永远爱你。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or continue forever, you mean that it will always happen or continue.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.tr:
adj. 空的；无意义的；
v. 倒空；
words.ex: The box is empty.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是空的。
words.en: If you describe a place, object, or person as empty, you mean that they contain nothing or have no special qualities, and are therefore not interesting or useful.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.tr: n. 匹兹堡（美国宾夕法尼亚州西南部城市）
words.ex: Pittsburgh is known for its steel industry.
words.ex_cn: 匹兹堡以其钢铁工业闻名。
words.en: A city in southwestern Pennsylvania, USA, known for its steel industry and cultural institutions.

words.ex: The fans cheered loudly when their favorite singer appeared.
words.ex_cn: 当他们最喜欢的歌手出现时，粉丝们大声欢呼。
words.en: A fan is someone who admires and supports a person, sport, sports team, or entertainment activity.

words.ex: He took painkillers for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: Painkillers are drugs used to reduce or eliminate pain without causing loss of consciousness.

words.ex: The moon shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 月亮在夜空中明亮地照耀。
words.en: The natural satellite of the earth, visible (chiefly at night) by reflected light from the sun.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.ex: Leslie is my new classmate.
words.ex_cn: 莱斯利是我的新同学。
words.en: A female given name, often associated with the character Leslie Knope from the TV show 'Parks and Recreation'.

words.tr: v. 阻塞；阻碍；“block”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The tree fell and blocked the road.
words.ex_cn: 树倒下并阻塞了道路。
words.en: If something is blocked, it is prevented from moving or flowing freely because there is something in the way.

words.ex: The movie shows a fantasy, not reality.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示的是幻想，而不是现实。
words.en: Reality is the state of things as they actually exist, rather than as they may appear or might be imagined.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: She wears a white apron while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她做饭时穿着一件白色围裙。
words.en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you wear over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.

words.ex: He listed the main points of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他列出了会议的主要要点。
words.en: A point is a detail, aspect, or quality of something or someone. It can also refer to the sharp end of something or a unit of scoring in games and sports. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending one's finger or something held in one's hand.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.ex: He bought two tickets for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了两张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a piece of paper or card that gives the holder a certain right, especially to enter a place, travel by public transport, or participate in an event.

words.ex: The rangers patrol the forest to protect animals.
words.ex_cn: 护林员巡逻森林以保护动物。
words.en: Rangers are individuals or groups responsible for patrolling and protecting a particular area, such as a forest or park, or serving in a military capacity.

words.ex: The penguins swim in the cold ocean.
words.ex_cn: 企鹅在寒冷的海洋中游泳。
words.en: Penguins are a group of aquatic, flightless birds living almost exclusively in the Southern Hemisphere, especially in Antarctica.

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He is having a birthday party tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要开生日派对。
words.en: Your birthday is the anniversary of the date on which you were born.

words.ex: He has six apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他桌子上有六个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of three and two; one more than five, or four less than ten; 6.

words.ex: He is ninety years old.
words.ex_cn: 他九十岁了。
words.en: the number 90

words.tr: adv. 较少地；更少地；“little”的比较级； adj. 更少的；“little”的比较级； pron. 较少；更少；
words.ex: He eats less sugar now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在吃得更少的糖。
words.en: You use less to indicate that there is a smaller amount of something than before or than average. You can use 'less' to indicate that something is smaller in size or degree than another thing.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: The farmer rides his ass to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫骑着他的驴去市场。
words.en: An ass is a donkey, a domesticated animal of the horse family, or a foolish or stupid person.

words.ex: The spots where we met are still special to me.
words.ex_cn: 我们见面的那些地点对我来说仍然很特别。
words.en: Small marks or areas of a different color or texture from the surface on which they are found.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.tr: v. 踢； n. 极度兴奋；（毒品或酒精的）效力( kick的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He kicks the ball hard.
words.ex_cn: 他用力踢球。
words.en: To strike out with the foot or feet; to make a sudden forceful thrust with the foot.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；皱痕
v. 起皱；弄皱
words.ex: The paper has a deep crease from folding.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸因为折叠而有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: A crease is a line or mark made on cloth or paper when it is folded or crushed.

words.tr: n. 桃子（peach 的复数）; v. <非正式>检举，告发（peach 的第三人称单数）
words.ex: She eats peaches every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上吃桃子。
words.en: Peaches are soft, round, slightly furry fruits with sweet yellow or pink flesh, and a large seed inside.

words.tr: n. 拥吻；亲吻（kiss 的复数形式）
words.ex: He kisses her every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上亲吻她。
words.en: Touches with the lips as a sign of affection or greeting.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.tr: n. 哭泣者；（复数）流泪的雕像或装饰物
words.ex: The weepers cried softly at the funeral.
words.ex_cn: 哀悼者在葬礼上轻声哭泣。
words.en: People who are crying or mourning.

words.ex: The losers smiled even after the game.
words.ex_cn: 输的人在比赛后仍然微笑了。
words.en: People or things that are unsuccessful or defeated in a competition or contest.

words.ex: The keepers feed the animals every morning.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员每天早上喂动物。
words.en: A keeper is someone who is responsible for looking after something, especially something valuable or important.

words.ex: The finders got a reward for returning the lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 这些发现者因为归还了丢失的钱包而得到了奖励。
words.en: People who discover something, often by chance; discoverers.

words.tr:
v. 打架；战斗；
n. 打架；战斗；
words.ex: The two boys fight every day after school.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天放学后都打架。
words.en: To fight means to take part in a violent struggle involving the exchange of physical blows or the use of weapons. It can also refer to a determined effort to achieve or resist something.

words.tr: v. 包含；容纳；认为；保存；把握；拿；
words.ex: This box holds all my books.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子装着我的所有书。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; keep fast; grasp; to contain or be capable of containing.

words.ex: She is waitressing at a local café to earn some extra money.
words.ex_cn: 她在一家本地咖啡馆做女服务员以赚取一些额外收入。
words.en: The job of a woman who serves food and drinks to customers in a restaurant or café.

words.tr:
n. 倾销
v. 倒空；“dump”的现在分词
words.ex: The company is accused of dumping cheap goods into the market.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司被指控向市场倾销廉价商品。
words.en: The act of getting rid of something unwanted, especially by leaving it in a place that is not suitable, or the act of selling goods in a foreign country at a price that is lower than the price in the country where they were made.

words.tr:
n. 双层公寓；联式房屋
adj. 双重的；双倍的
words.ex: The new development includes both single-family homes and duplexes.
words.ex_cn: 新开发项目包括独栋住宅和连栋式的两栋住宅。
words.en: A duplex is a type of house that is divided into two separate homes, or a system that can send and receive signals at the same time.

words.tr: v. 跳； n. 跳跃 adj. 跳跃的，跳跃而行的 v. 跳( leap的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The cat is leaping over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫正在跳过篱笆。
words.en: To jump or spring a long way, to a great height, or with great force.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: To give attention with the ear; attend closely for the purpose of hearing.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.tr: n. 停顿；停顿( pause的名词复数 )； v. 停顿；
words.ex: The speaker took long pauses between sentences.
words.ex_cn: 演讲者在句子之间做了长时间的停顿。
words.en: Brief interruptions in speech or writing.

words.tr: adj. 错开的； v. “stagger”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The classes have staggered start times.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是错开的。
words.en: If something staggers you, it surprises you very much.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.ex: He swore he didn't steal the money.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓他没有偷钱。
words.en: If someone swears, they use language that is considered to be rude or offensive, usually because they are angry.

words.ex: The lion is the king of the animal kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是动物王国之王。
words.en: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

words.ex: The birds fly high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中高飞。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.tr: v. 演出；参加比赛；捉弄；演奏( play的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He played a king in the play.
words.ex_cn: 他在戏剧中扮演了一位国王。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.ex: He has a monopoly on selling ice cream in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他在这座小镇上垄断了冰淇淋的销售。
words.en: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.

words.tr: v. 倾泻；涌出；倾；倒；涌流；
words.ex: He pours water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进杯子里。
words.en: To pour means to cause a liquid or other substance to flow from a container in a continuous stream, especially by holding the container at an angle.

words.tr: n. 眼镜；玻璃杯；“glass”的复数；
words.ex: He wears glasses to see the board clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴眼镜以便清楚地看到黑板。
words.en: Glasses are objects worn in front of the eyes to help people see better. They consist of a pair of lenses set in a frame that rests on the nose and ears.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.ex: The contents of the book are easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的内容很容易理解。
words.en: The things that are contained within something, especially a written work or a container.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.ex: He took a short napping after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后小睡了一会儿。
words.en: To take a short sleep, especially during the day.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: He felt a cold breeze on his pate.
words.ex_cn: 他感到头顶有一阵冷风。
words.en: The top of a person's head.

words.ex: He finished in seventh place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第七名。
words.en: The seventh item in a series is the one that you count as number seven.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He is unwell today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天身体不舒服。
words.en: A prefix meaning 'not,' 'opposite of,' 'lacking,' used to give a negative or opposite force to adjectives and their derivatives.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.tr:
n. 地中海；
adj. 地中海的；
words.ex: He sailed across the Mediterranean last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天横渡了地中海。
words.en: relating to the Mediterranean Sea or the countries around it

words.tr: adj. 有才智的；聪明的；明智的；
words.ex: The intelligent boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个有才智的男孩很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is intelligent has the ability to think, understand, and learn things quickly and well.

words.tr: adv. 好奇地；奇异地；奇怪地
words.ex: He looked curiously at the strange box.
words.ex_cn: 他好奇地看着那个奇怪的盒子。
words.en: In a way that shows eagerness to know or learn something.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；令人震惊的； v. “stun”的现在分词；
words.ex: She wore a stunning dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件极好的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Extremely impressive or attractive.

words.ex: The twister destroyed the small farm.
words.ex_cn: 旋风摧毁了那座小农场。
words.en: A twister is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud, or it can refer to someone or something that twists.

words.ex: He wore a trashy shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件廉价的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Of very poor quality; cheap and vulgar.

words.tr:
v. 睡眠
n. 睡眠（常复数）
words.ex: The baby fell into a deep slumber after feeding.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝喂完奶后进入了深深的睡眠。
words.en: Slumber is a state of sleep, especially one that is peaceful and restful.

words.ex: She wears two rings on her fingers.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着两枚戒指。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. As a verb, to ring means to encircle or to cause a bell or similar device to make a sound.

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.ex: He reads magazines about sports every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读关于体育的杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a publication with a paper cover which is issued regularly, usually every week or every month, and which contains articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements.

words.tr:
n. 朗姆酒
adj. 古怪的；奇特的
words.ex: He drank a glass of rum by the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在火炉旁喝了一杯朗姆酒。
words.en: Rum is an alcoholic drink made from sugar cane.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: The goose is swimming in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹅正在湖里游泳。
words.en: A goose is a large bird that has a long neck and webbed feet. Geese are often kept for their meat, feathers, or as guard animals.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.ex_cn: 白色的猫坐在窗台上。
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.ex: He wore a sexy shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件性感的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe something as sexy, you mean that it is attractive in a way that suggests sex or sexual activity.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.ex_cn: 这只小狗很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: He is an adviser to the government.
words.ex_cn: 他是政府的顾问。
words.en: An adviser is a person who gives advice, especially someone who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.tr: n. 肘；弯头；急弯；（沙发、椅子等的）扶手（elbow 的复数形式）; v. 用肘推；变成肘状（e...
words.ex: He leaned on the table with his elbows.
words.ex_cn: 他用手肘撑在桌子上。
words.en: The joints at the outer ends of the upper arms, often used as a point of reference in posture or etiquette.

words.tr: v. 醒来；“wake”的现在分词； adj. 醒着的；不眠的；
words.ex: He is waking up slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在慢慢醒来。
words.en: The state of being awake and not sleeping.

words.tr: adj. 令人吃惊的； v. “startle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The news was startling to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让所有人都感到吃惊。
words.en: Something that is startling is so surprising, unexpected, or remarkable that it makes you feel slightly shocked.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: I will definitely come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我肯定会来参加派对。
words.en: without any doubt; certainly

words.tr: n. 矿井；矿；矿( mine的名词复数 ) v. 在…中开采，开采( mine的第三；
words.ex: The workers went down into the mines to dig coal.
words.ex_cn: 工人们进入矿井挖煤。
words.en: Mines can refer to excavations in the earth for extracting coal, minerals, or precious stones, or to explosive devices placed in the ground or water to destroy enemy personnel or vehicles.

words.ex: There are nine queens in the palace.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有九个女王。
words.en: A queen is a woman who rules a country as its monarch or who is the wife of a king.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: Mom reassured me that everything would be fine.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈让我安心，一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you reassure someone, you comfort them and stop them from worrying.

words.tr: adj. 不安全的；无保障的；缺乏自信的；无把握的
words.ex: He feels insecure when he is alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 当他晚上一个人时，他感到不安全。
words.en: If you are insecure, you lack confidence because you think that you are not good enough or are not loved.

words.ex: He is deaf and uses sign language to communicate.
words.ex_cn: 他是聋的，使用手语交流。
words.en: If someone is deaf, they cannot hear anything, or they cannot hear very well.

words.ex: He is constantly checking his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不断地查看他的手机。
words.en: If something happens constantly, it happens all the time or very often.

words.ex: He is her boyfriend.
words.ex_cn: 他是她的男朋友。
words.en: A boyfriend is a man or boy with whom someone is having a romantic or sexual relationship.

words.ex: He sleeps on a soft bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡在一张柔软的床上。
words.en: A bed is a piece of furniture that you lie on when you sleep.

words.ex: Jack climbed up the beanstalk to find a giant's castle.
words.ex_cn: 杰克爬上豆茎，发现了一座巨人的城堡。
words.en: A beanstalk is the stem of a bean plant, especially one that grows very tall.

words.tr: n. 一种爱尔兰传统曲棍球运动；也指该运动所用的球棒
words.ex: Hurley is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 赫利正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A long wooden stick used in the sport of hurling.

words.tr: n. 步行； v. 步行；行走；“walk”的现在分词； adj. 步行的；
words.ex: Walking is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 步行对健康有益。
words.en: Walking is the activity of going for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: The covers of the books are colorful.
words.ex_cn: 这些书的封面是五颜六色的。
words.en: To cover something means to place something else over it, often to protect or hide it, or to include or deal with a particular subject or area.

words.tr:
n. 坏女人；讨厌的女人
v. 埋怨；发牢骚；搞糟
words.ex: They are calling her bitch for no reason.
words.ex_cn: 他们无缘无故地叫她婊子。
words.en: A bitch is a female dog. In informal use, it can also refer to a woman who is regarded as malicious or unpleasant. As a verb, it means to complain in a petulant or whining manner.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.tr: adj. 全能的；无所不能的
words.ex: The god is omnipotent.
words.ex_cn: 这个神是无所不能的。
words.en: Having unlimited power, able to do anything.

words.ex: He felt hunger after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到饥饿。
words.en: A strong desire or need for food.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: He made a rude comment about her boobs.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的胸部说了粗鲁的话。
words.en: boobs: Informal term for a woman's breasts.

words.ex: This box is bigger than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子比那个大。
words.en: Comparative form of big: larger in size, amount, or degree than something else.

words.ex: She carefully picked up the splinter with a pair of tweezers.
words.ex_cn: 她用一把镊子小心地夹起了那根刺。
words.en: Tweezers are a small tool that you use for picking up objects too small to be easily handled with the human fingers. The tool is most likely derived from tongs, pincers, or scissors-like pliers used to grab or hold hot objects since the dawn of recorded history.

words.tr:
v. 预备；准备
n. 家庭作业；预习功课
adj. 准备的
words.ex: He is preparing for the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为考试做准备。
words.en: Preparation or preliminary work, especially in education or before an event.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；施行手术；
words.ex: The machine operates smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转顺畅。
words.en: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

words.ex: He woke up early to catch the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 他早早醒来去看日出。
words.en: Aware of and actively attentive to important societal facts and issues (especially issues of racial and social justice).

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: There are many possibilities for your future.
words.ex_cn: 你的未来有很多可能性。
words.en: The range of things that can happen or be done.

words.tr:
n. 魔术；魔法；
adj. 魔术（似）的；神奇的；
words.ex: He performed magic at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上表演了魔术。
words.en: Magic is the power to use supernatural forces to make impossible things happen, such as making people disappear or controlling events in nature.

words.tr:
adj. 满的；充满的；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The glass is full of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃杯装满了水。
words.en: Containing or holding as much or as many as possible; having no empty space.

words.tr: n. 豆；豆( bean的名词复数 )；[亦用复数][口语][通常用于否定结构]丝毫；[复数][美国；
words.ex: He eats beans for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃豆子。
words.en: Beans are the seeds of certain types of plants which are eaten as food. They are a good source of protein and fiber.

words.ex: He used a jack to lift the car.
words.ex_cn: 他用千斤顶把车顶了起来。
words.en: A jack is a device for lifting heavy objects, especially one for raising the axle of a motor vehicle so that a wheel can be changed or removed.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.ex: He chopped an onion for the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他为汤切了一个洋葱。
words.en: An onion is a round vegetable with a light brown skin. It has many layers and a strong, sharp smell and taste.

words.ex: He picked a wild mushroom in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里摘了一朵野生蘑菇。
words.en: A mushroom is a fungus that grows in damp, dark places and has a stem with a rounded top.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，树叶是绿色的。
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.ex: He is a bonehead for forgetting his keys again.
words.ex_cn: 他又忘了带钥匙，真是个笨蛋。
words.en: A bonehead is someone who is stupid or foolish.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼去拿饮料。
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.tr: adv. 悲惨地；不幸地；糟糕地
words.ex: He slept miserably after the fight.
words.ex_cn: 打架后，他睡得很不舒服。
words.en: In a manner that is extremely unhappy or uncomfortable; very badly.

words.ex: He waited for weeks to get a reply.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几个星期才等到回复。
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.tr:
adj. 值得的；有…价值；
n. 价值；
words.ex: This book is worth reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

words.tr: vt. 擦；消除；涂上；涂上（wipe的过去式和过去分词）；打（wipe的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.tr: n. 桌子；台子；表格；“table”的复数；
words.ex: The children sat at the tables to eat lunch.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在桌子旁吃午餐。
words.en: A piece of furniture with a flat top and one or more legs, providing a level surface for eating, writing, or working.

words.tr: adj. 蒸熟的； v. “steam”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The steamed fish tastes very fresh.
words.ex_cn: 蒸熟的鱼味道很新鲜。
words.en: Cooked by steam.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.tr: n. （巴西）学生福利基金会（Fundação de Assistência ao Estudante）的缩写，常用于指代巴西的学生援助组织
words.ex: He pays fica taxes from his salary.
words.ex_cn: 他从工资中缴纳联邦保险税。
words.en: A Brazilian tax identification number.

words.tr: adj. 令人激动的；使人兴奋的； v. “excite”的现在分词；
words.ex: The football match was exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这场足球赛令人激动。
words.en: If something is exciting, it makes you feel very happy or enthusiastic.

words.tr: v. 赚得；获得；“earn”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He earned money by delivering newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他送报纸赚了钱。
words.en: Gained or deserved through effort or work.

words.tr: v. 秘密侦察；发现；“spy”的现在分词
words.ex: The government has intensified its efforts to combat spying.
words.ex_cn: 政府加大了打击间谍活动的力度。
words.en: The act of secretly collecting information about a country, organization, or person, especially in a way that is considered illegal or unethical.

words.tr:
n. 争吵
v. 争吵
words.ex: The two boys squabble over toys every day.
words.ex_cn: 这两个男孩每天为玩具争吵。
words.en: A squabble is a noisy disagreement about something unimportant.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: She put flowers in a vase on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她把花放在桌子上的花瓶里。
words.en: A vase is a container, often used for holding cut flowers. It can be made from a variety of materials, including glass, ceramics, and metals.

words.tr: n. 特价; 专车( special的名词复数 ); 特刊; 特约稿
words.ex: The restaurant has specials on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅在周五有特价菜。
words.en: A special offer or item, typically at a reduced price, available for a limited time or as a promotion.

words.ex: She bought some flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一些花。
words.en: A plant with a stem, leaves, and flowers, often grown for its beauty or scent.

words.tr: n. 小甜饼；曲奇饼；“cookie”的复数
words.ex: She baked cookies for her friends.
words.ex_cn: 她为朋友们烤了饼干。
words.en: A cookie is a small sweet cake, typically round, flat, and crisp.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr: n. 软泥状物（复数形式，非正式用语，指黏糊糊、 Blob 类似的东西）
words.ex: The blobbies are soft and wobbly.
words.ex_cn: 这些 blobbies 是柔软且晃动的。
words.en: Soft, shapeless, or amorphous objects or creatures.

words.ex: He sent a card to his valentine on February 14.
words.ex_cn: 他在2月14日给他的情人送了一张卡片。
words.en: A valentine is a sweetheart chosen or complimented on Valentine's Day, or a card or gift sent on this day.

words.ex: Tommy is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 汤米正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, diminutive of Thomas.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.tr:
n. 倾向；偏好
v. 倾斜；倚靠；“lean”的现在分词
words.ex: She has a leaning towards classical music.
words.ex_cn: 她倾向于喜欢古典音乐。
words.en: A tendency or preference towards a particular way of thinking or acting; an inclination.

words.tr:
v. 下降；
n. 瀑布；陨石；
words.ex: The temperature falls at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚温度下降。
words.en: A waterfall; or the third person singular present of fall, meaning to drop down from a higher to a lower level, typically rapidly and without control.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: She sent her best wishes for the New Year.
words.ex_cn: 她送上了对新年的美好祝愿。
words.en: A wish is a desire or hope for something to happen.

words.tr:
adj. 嘲弄的
v. 嘲笑；嘲弄；（模仿）取笑；“mock”的现在分词
words.ex: His mocking laugh made her feel stupid.
words.ex_cn: 他嘲弄的笑声让她觉得自己很蠢。
words.en: Mocking is used to describe someone or something that makes fun of someone or something in a cruel way.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.tr: v. 宣传；提升；促进；将（体育运动队）晋级（promote 的过去式和过去分词）；
words.ex: The company promoted the new product on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过电视宣传了新产品。
words.en: If someone is promoted, they are given a more important job or rank in the organization that they work for.

words.ex: He completely forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他完全忘记了钥匙。
words.en: In a way that is whole or entire; to the fullest extent.

words.ex: The child ate a piece of candy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 孩子晚饭后吃了一块糖果。
words.en: Candy is a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate, often eaten as a treat.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He tosses the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To throw something lightly or casually; to move or cause to move from side to side or back and forth.

words.tr: n. 形式；表格；“form”的复数； v. 组成；
words.ex: The art show displayed many forms of sculpture.
words.ex_cn: 艺术展展示了多种形式的雕塑。
words.en: Forms can refer to the shape or structure of something, or it can mean to make or shape something. It can also refer to a document with spaces in which to write.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.tr: int. （思索该说什么话时发出的声音）哦；嗯；呃
words.ex: Er, I'm not sure if I can come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 呃，我不确定我明天能不能来。
words.en: An interjection used to express hesitation, uncertainty, or to fill a pause in speech.

words.tr: v. 纺（纱）；旋转；疾驰；“spin”的现在分词； n. 纺织；
words.ex: She is spinning wool into yarn.
words.ex_cn: 她正在把羊毛纺成纱线。
words.en: the process or activity of spinning fibers to produce yarn or thread.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.tr: v. 跳；跳跃；“jump”的现在分词； n. 跳跃；跳跃动作；
words.ex: The child is jumping over the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子正在跳过水坑。
words.en: The act of pushing yourself off the ground and into the air using your legs.

words.tr: v. 削弱； adj. “dent”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The scandal dented his reputation.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻削弱了他的声誉。
words.en: If something is dented, its surface has been pushed in or damaged, often by being hit.

words.ex: He is squeezing a lemon for his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为饮料挤柠檬。
words.en: To press something firmly, especially from all sides in order to change its shape, reduce its size, or remove liquid from it.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.tr:
v. 夺取；一把抓住
n. 夺取；一把抓住；音乐片段
words.ex: He tried to snatch the bag from her hand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从她手中抢走包。
words.en: If you snatch something, or if you snatch at it, you take it or pull it away quickly.

words.ex: He knocks on the door before entering.
words.ex_cn: 他进门前敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, or to collide with something.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: He organized all his files on the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他把电脑上的所有文件都整理好了。
words.en: n. A file is a box or a folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. v. If you file a document, you put it in the correct file. If you file a formal or legal accusation, complaint, or request, you make it officially.

words.ex: He eats nectarines every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃油桃。
words.en: A smooth-skinned variety of peach.

words.ex: The fact is that he was late.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他迟到了。
words.en: A fact is a piece of information that is known to be true.

words.ex: He explained the rules specifically.
words.ex_cn: 他具体地解释了规则。
words.en: You use specifically to emphasize that something is given special attention and considered separately from other things of the same kind.

words.tr: n. 月（month 的复数形式）
words.ex: He waited for months to get his visa.
words.ex_cn: 他等了好几个月才拿到签证。
words.en: A month is one of the twelve periods of time that a year is divided into, for example January or February.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr:
n. 件；作品；片；块；
v. 拼凑；
words.ex: She bought a piece of cake.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一块蛋糕。
words.en: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

words.ex: The nurse bandaged the wound carefully.
words.ex_cn: 护士小心翼翼地用绷带包扎了伤口。
words.en: To cover a part of the body with a bandage for protection or to hold a dressing in place.

words.tr:
adj. 公众的；
n. 公众；公共场所；
words.ex: The park is open to the public.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对公众开放。
words.en: Relating to or involving people in general, rather than being limited to a particular group of people.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.tr:
n. 月光
v. 兼职；（尤在夜间）从事第二职业
words.ex: She works as a waitress at night to moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 她晚上当服务员来兼职。
words.en: The light that comes from the moon at night.

words.ex: The movie was incredible.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影太棒了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as incredible, you like them very much or are impressed by them, because they are extremely or unusually good.

words.ex: The glow of the fire warmed the room.
words.ex_cn: 火的炽热温暖了房间。
words.en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

words.tr: v. 点头（nod 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He nodded when I asked if he was okay.
words.ex_cn: 当我问他是否没事时，他点了点头。
words.en: Made a small, downward movement of the head to indicate agreement or acknowledgment.

words.ex: He finished in twelfth place in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第十二名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number twelve in a series.

words.tr: adj.loud（响亮的，大声的，高声的）的比较级形式
words.ex: Please speak louder; I can't hear you.
words.ex_cn: 请大声点说话，我听不见你。
words.en: At a higher volume or with greater intensity.

words.ex: He fell into a coma after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后陷入了昏迷。
words.en: A coma is a state of deep unconsciousness that lasts for a prolonged or indefinite period, caused especially by severe injury or illness.

words.ex: He mumbles when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候会嘟囔。
words.en: Speaks in a low, indistinct, or muffled voice.

words.ex: There was frost on the grass this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上草地上有霜。
words.en: A thin layer of ice that forms on surfaces when the temperature drops below freezing.

words.ex: He was born on the twentieth of May.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于五月二十日。
words.en: The twentieth item in a series is the one that you count as number twenty.

words.ex: He was born in October.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在十月。
words.en: October is the tenth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.ex: He ate a ripe peach for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的桃子。
words.en: A peach is a soft, round, slightly furry fruit with sweet yellow flesh and pinky-orange skin. Peaches grow in warm countries.

words.ex: I couldn't finish my homework yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天没能完成作业。
words.en: Couldn't is the usual spoken form of 'could not'.

words.ex: He realises his mistake too late.
words.ex_cn: 他太晚才意识到自己的错误。
words.en: To become aware of or understand something clearly; to achieve something that you have planned or hoped for.

words.tr: adj. 穿着衣服的； v. “dress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was dressed and ready for school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子穿好衣服，准备去上学。
words.en: Wearing clothes or a particular type of clothes.

words.ex: I take the bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天乘公共汽车去学校。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another.

words.tr: v. （使）迷惑；“puzzle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 困惑的；
words.ex: He was puzzled by the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他被这个简单的问题弄糊涂了。
words.en: If you are puzzled, you are confused because you do not understand something.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr:
v. 通过；传递；路过；(时间)流逝；
n. 通行证；(考试)及格；
words.ex: He passed the exam with a high score.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: To move or go past someone or something; to transfer or hand over something to someone.

words.ex: He gave a rose to his lover on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节给情人送了一朵玫瑰。
words.en: A lover is someone who is in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person, or someone who enjoys a particular thing or activity very much.

words.ex: They consummated their marriage last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚完成了婚姻的结合。
words.en: To bring to completion or perfection; to fulfill or achieve something.

words.ex: George likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 乔治喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A male given name, derived from the Greek name Georgios, meaning 'farmer' or 'earth-worker'.

words.ex: The bird spread its wings and flew away.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞走了。
words.en: The wings of a bird or insect are the two parts of its body that it uses for flying.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了鸡肉。
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.tr:
n. 柜台；
v. 抵消；反驳；
adv. 相反地；
words.ex: The customer paid at the counter.
words.ex_cn: 顾客在柜台付款。
words.en: A counter is a long flat surface in a shop or bank on which customers are served. It can also refer to a device that counts something, or an action taken to oppose something.

words.ex: The lid is tight on the jar.
words.ex_cn: 罐子的盖子很紧。
words.en: Something that is tight is fastened or fixed firmly and is not loose.

words.tr: adj. 充满快乐的；使人高兴的
words.ex: The children were joyous on Christmas morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节早上非常快乐。
words.en: If you describe something as joyous, you mean that it is full of joy and happiness.

words.ex: She gives her brother hugs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都给弟弟拥抱。
words.en: A close, affectionate embrace with the arms.

words.tr: adj. 吃惊的；惊奇的； v. 使惊奇；使吃惊；“amaze”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was amazed by the magic show.
words.ex_cn: 我对这场魔术表演感到吃惊。
words.en: If you are amazed by something, you are very surprised by it.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: The children are learning motions in dance class.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在舞蹈课上学习动作。
words.en: Motions refer to the act or process of moving or the way in which something moves. It can also mean a formal proposal made in a meeting or court.

words.tr:
n. 负荷；载重；
v. 载入；
words.ex: The bridge can't hold such a heavy load.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥承受不了这么重的负荷。
words.en: A load is a large quantity of something that is carried by a vehicle, person, or animal, or the amount of work that a person or machine has to do.

words.ex: The train arrives at 5 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车在下午五点到达。
words.en: To reach a place, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.tr:
v. 大口吞咽；喘气；抑制
n. 一大口；吞咽
words.ex: He gulped down his water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速地吞下了水。
words.en: If you gulp something, you eat or drink it very quickly by swallowing large quantities of it at once.

words.ex: We went for a walk on the downs.
words.ex_cn: 我们在丘陵地带散步。
words.en: Downs refers to a range of low hills, especially in southern England, or a stretch of open, rolling, grassy land.

words.ex: He arrives at the station at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他早上8点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a place, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物； v. 洗；洗涤；“wash”的现在分词；
words.ex: She put the washing into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 她把要洗的衣物放进洗衣机里。
words.en: The act of cleaning something using water and usually soap or detergent.

words.tr: v. 尝试；试图；努力；“try”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 经过考验的；
words.ex: I tried to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 我尝试跑得更快。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of try. To make an effort to do or accomplish (something); attempt.

words.ex: He stole a book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店偷了一本书。
words.en: To take something that belongs to someone else without their permission and without intending to return it.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.ex: He climbs the mountain every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去攀登那座山。
words.en: To go up or ascend, especially by using the hands and feet.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr:
adj. 联网的；接有电线的；兴奋的；紧张不安的
v. 发电报；装电线；“wire”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is wired to the computer.
words.ex_cn: 他连接着电脑。
words.en: Connected to the internet or another network by a wire; very excited or nervous.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: I bought a dozen eggs from the store.
words.ex_cn: 我从商店买了十二个鸡蛋。
words.en: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

words.ex: He drinks coffee from two cups every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用两个杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.tr: v. 训练；辅导；训练，辅导( coach的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is coaching the team every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午都在训练球队。
words.en: Coaching is the activity of providing training or guidance to someone in a particular skill or sport.

words.tr: adj. 就座的； v. “seat”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The seated students listened quietly.
words.ex_cn: 就座的学生安静地听着。
words.en: If someone is seated, they are sitting down.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: The loading of the cargo took three hours.
words.ex_cn: 货物的装载花了三个小时。
words.en: The process of loading something, especially data or cargo, onto a vehicle, ship, or computer system.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.tr: n. 分类； v. 分类；整理；“sort”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sorting of books by genre makes the library easier to use.
words.ex_cn: 按类型对书籍进行分类使图书馆更容易使用。
words.en: The act of separating things into different groups, types, or sizes.

words.tr: v. 擦；擦去；擦( wipe的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is wiping the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用布擦桌子。
words.en: The act of cleaning or drying something by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or one's hand.

words.tr: v. 溢出；溅出；“spill”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The glass was knocked over, and the water spilled everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 杯子被撞倒了，水洒得到处都是。
words.en: If a liquid spills or if you spill it, it accidentally flows over the edge of a container.

words.tr: adv. 随意地；偶然地；漫不经心地
words.ex: He casually waved at his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地向朋友挥了挥手。
words.en: In a way that suggests a lack of concern or seriousness.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.ex: He went to auditions for the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加新电影的试镜。
words.en: Auditions are short performances by actors, singers, or musicians that are held so that a director or producer can decide if they are good enough to be in a play, film, or orchestra.

words.tr: n. 高处；顶点；高度( height的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The children are playing on the heights.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在高处玩耍。
words.en: The vertical distance from the top to the bottom of something, or the quality of being tall.

words.ex: He lives in Brooklyn with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在布鲁克林。
words.en: A borough of New York City, located on the western end of Long Island, known for its diverse neighborhoods.

words.ex: He gave a quick bob when I greeted him.
words.ex_cn: 我向他打招呼时，他快速地点了点头。
words.en: A bob is a short haircut for a woman or girl. To bob means to move quickly up and down.

words.tr: n. 口音；[语]重音（accent 的复数）; v. 重读；强调（accent 的第三人称单数）
words.ex: People from different countries have different accents.
words.ex_cn: 来自不同国家的人有不同的口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: Joe is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 乔正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: Joe is a male given name, often a short form of Joseph.

words.tr: n. 克利夫兰（美国俄亥俄州城市）
words.ex: He lives in Cleveland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在克利夫兰。
words.en: A city in Ohio, USA, known for industry and sports.

words.tr: v. 注意；觉察；注意（ notice的过去式和过去分词 ）；
words.ex: I noticed a bird outside the window.
words.ex_cn: 我注意到窗外有一只鸟。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.tr: v. 覆盖；“cover”的现在分词； n. 遮盖物；
words.ex: The snow is covering the ground.
words.ex_cn: 雪覆盖着地面。
words.en: A covering is a layer of something that spreads over or encloses something else, often to protect it or hide it.

words.tr: v. 挥舞；乱打；胡乱摆动（第三人称单数）
words.ex: The child flails his arms when he is excited.
words.ex_cn: 孩子兴奋时会挥舞手臂。
words.en: Moves arms or legs wildly and uncontrolledly.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.ex_cn: 这两个苹果不一样。
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.ex: He drinks a cup of espresso every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯浓咖啡。
words.en: A strong coffee made by forcing steam or hot water through ground coffee beans.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.tr: n. （常指不满一岁的）小狗(puppy的复数); 小狗，幼犬( puppy的名词复数 ); 浅薄自
words.ex: The puppies are playing in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 小狗们正在院子里玩耍。
words.en: Young dogs, especially those that are small and playful.

words.tr: v. 交；递；（非正式）（使）轻松得到（hand 的过去式及过...；
words.ex: He handed the book to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把书交给了他的朋友。
words.en: Having a hand or hands. Used to describe someone's preference or ability in using a particular hand.

words.ex: He showed courage when he saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他从火中救出孩子时展现了勇气。
words.en: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.

words.ex: Add a softener to the laundry to make the clothes feel softer.
words.ex_cn: 在洗衣物时加入柔软剂，使衣物感觉更柔软。
words.en: A softener is a substance that you add to something to make it softer or less harsh.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.ex: The storm caused a brutal flood that destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了残酷的洪水，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

words.ex: The camper parked near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 露营车停在湖边。
words.en: A camper is someone who stays in a tent or a caravan, especially for a holiday.

words.tr: pron. 你的（非正式拼写，常用于网络用语）
words.ex: He is ur teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是你的老师。
words.en: A pronoun used to refer to a person or thing that is the subject of a sentence.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.tr: v. 坐；“sit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He sat on the chair quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地坐在椅子上。
words.en: To be in a position in which your bottom is resting on a chair, the ground, etc., with the top part of your body upright.

words.tr: v. 重新思考；重新考虑；
words.ex: We need to rethink our plan.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要重新思考我们的计划。
words.en: To consider again, especially with a view to changing or altering.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极其地；极端地；
words.ex: The weather is extremely cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气非常冷。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very.

words.ex: She is supremely confident in her abilities.
words.ex_cn: 她对自己的能力极其自信。
words.en: To an extreme or utmost degree.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: I eat vegetables every day for health.
words.ex_cn: 为了健康，我每天都吃蔬菜。
words.en: Plants or parts of plants that are eaten as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish.

words.tr: v. 吸；吸，吮( suck的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The vacuum cleaner sucked up the dust.
words.ex_cn: 吸尘器把灰尘吸走了。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 证明；证据（proof 的复数）；校稿
words.ex: He writes proofs for every math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他为每个数学问题写证明。
words.en: Evidence or facts used to establish the truth of something.

words.ex: He took a photo of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A photo is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr: v. 吹；刮风；浪费；“blow” 的过去式
words.ex: He blew out the candles on his cake.
words.ex_cn: 他吹灭了蛋糕上的蜡烛。
words.en: To blow means to move air or to cause air to move, especially in a way that is noticeable or strong.

words.ex: She carries her books in bags.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在包里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: The squirrel ran up the tree with a nut.
words.ex_cn: 松鼠带着一颗坚果跑上了树。
words.en: A squirrel is a small animal with a bushy tail that lives in trees and is known for its ability to climb and jump.

words.tr: adj. 多岩石的；崎岖不平的（rocky的复数形式，通常用于描述地形）
words.ex: The hikers walked over the rockys with care.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者小心地走过这些多石的地方。
words.en: A nickname for the Rocky Mountains or a rocky area.

words.ex: A moose walked near the lake in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只麋鹿在森林里的湖边走动。
words.en: A moose is a large deer with palmate antlers, a sloping back, and a growth of skin hanging from the neck, native to northern forests of North America, Europe, and Asia.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: He is proud of his son's good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子的好成绩感到自豪。
words.en: Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements, qualities, or possessions or those of someone with whom one is closely associated.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: Warm weather favors plant growth.
words.ex_cn: 温暖的天气有利于植物生长。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favor, you like or support them.

words.tr: v. 问；询问；要求；“ask”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is asking for help.
words.ex_cn: 他正在求助。
words.en: To say something in order to obtain an answer or some information.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 突然，灯灭了。
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: v. 下降；跌倒；“fall”的现在分词； adj. 衰退的；落下的；跌落的； n. 下降；
words.ex: The temperature is falling quickly.
words.ex_cn: 温度正在迅速下降。
words.en: Moving downward from a higher to a lower level, typically rapidly and without control.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.ex: He made new plans for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他为周末制定了新的计划。
words.en: A plan is a method of achieving something that you have worked out in detail beforehand.

words.ex: He seems tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后好像很累。
words.en: If something seems to be true, it appears to be true, although you cannot be certain.

words.tr: n. 密西西比河（美国河流，世界上最大的河流之一）；
words.ex: The Mississippi flows through many states in the USA.
words.ex_cn: 密西西比河流经美国许多州。
words.en: A state in the southern United States, known for its river of the same name, which is one of the longest rivers in the world.

words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.tr: adj. 狂乱无秩序的；喧闹的；难控制的
words.ex: The rambunctious children were causing chaos in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 喧闹的孩子们在教室里制造混乱。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a child, as rambunctious, you mean that they are full of energy and difficult to control.

words.tr: n. 乳房（breast 的复数形式）
words.ex: The doctor checked her breasts for any abnormal lumps.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了她的乳房是否有异常肿块。
words.en: The front part of a bird's body, including the wing and breast meat, or the mammary glands in mammals.

words.ex: The wind blows hard in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天风刮得很猛。
words.en: To move air or wind; to cause something to move by the force of air or wind.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.tr: int. 表示突然疼痛所发出的声音
words.ex: Ow! I hurt my finger.
words.ex_cn: 哎哟！我弄伤手指了。
words.en: used to express sudden pain

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.tr: n. 头部；头脑；上端； v. （无释义）； adj. 上端( head的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The baby touched his heads with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝用双手摸了摸自己的头部。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or top part of an animal's body, containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs; the person in charge of a group or organization; the side of a coin that bears the image of a head.

words.tr:
n. 黄鼠狼；鼬
v. 逃避；逐渐放弃；逐渐背弃
words.ex: The weasel stole the chicken from the coop.
words.ex_cn: 黄鼠狼从鸡舍里偷走了鸡。
words.en: A weasel is a small, carnivorous mammal with a slender body and short legs, known for its cunning and ability to escape from tight spots.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.tr: adj. （食物）易碎的；一口一口咬着吃的
words.ex: The child is nibbly with his snacks.
words.ex_cn: 孩子一小口一小口地吃零食。
words.en: Inclined to nibble or eat small amounts frequently.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To take in through the mouth as food; ingest.

words.ex: He answered the question lightly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻率地回答了那个问题。
words.en: In a way that is not heavy or forceful; gently.

words.tr: v. 生长；成长；渐渐变成；种植；
words.ex: The plant grows quickly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天长得很快。
words.en: If someone or something grows, they increase in size, amount, or degree, often over a period of time.

words.ex: He is shutting the window because it is cold.
words.ex_cn: 他正在关窗，因为天气很冷。
words.en: The act of closing something, such as a door, window, or business.

words.ex: Nobody knows the answer.
words.ex_cn: 没有人知道答案。
words.en: Nobody means not any person or no person.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.tr:
v. 打嗝；冒出
n. 嗝
words.ex: He belched after eating the big meal.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完这顿大餐后打了个嗝。
words.en: To expel gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth; to emit or discharge something forcefully.

words.tr: n. 混合物; 鸡尾酒( cocktail的名词复数 ); 餐前开胃菜
words.ex: He drinks cocktails at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上喝鸡尾酒。
words.en: Alcoholic drinks served before a meal or as a social drink, typically mixed with other ingredients.

words.tr: n. 阿巴拉契亚（美国东部一地区）
words.ex: He grew up in Appalachiа.
words.ex_cn: 他在阿巴拉契亚地区长大。
words.en: Appalachia refers to a cultural region in the Eastern United States, characterized by its mountainous terrain and distinct cultural traditions.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.tr:
adj. 诺曼人的；
n. 诺曼底人；
words.ex: The Norman soldiers wore heavy armor.
words.ex_cn: 诺曼士兵穿着厚重的盔甲。
words.en: A Norman is a member of the people of Normandy in northern France, especially in the context of the Norman conquest of England in 1066.

words.ex: He sent the letter by mailer.
words.ex_cn: 他通过邮寄箱寄出了信件。
words.en: A mailer is someone who sends out mail, especially advertisements or promotional material, or the material itself that is sent.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人作呕的； v. “disgust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of the rotten food was disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂食物的气味令人厌恶。
words.en: If you say that something is disgusting, you mean that you find it completely unacceptable or unpleasant.

words.ex: The movie was horribly scary.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影非常可怕。
words.en: In a manner that causes horror or is extremely unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 失败者；处于劣势的一方
words.ex: The underdog team won the match against all expectations.
words.ex_cn: 这支被视为失败者的球队出人意料地赢得了比赛。
words.en: An underdog is a person or group in a competition, usually in sports and creative works, who is popularly expected to lose.

words.tr: v. 膨胀；使充气；夸口；吹嘘
words.ex: He tries to inflate the balloon with his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用嘴把气球吹大。
words.en: To inflate something means to cause it to increase in size by filling it with air or gas. It can also refer to increasing the amount of money in circulation, leading to a decrease in its value.

words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is inappropriate.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去参加会议是不合适的。
words.en: If you say that something is inappropriate, you are criticizing it because you think it is not suitable for a particular situation or purpose.

words.tr: v. 笨拙地移动或落下；失败
words.ex: The fish was flopping on the deck.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在甲板上扑腾。
words.en: To move or fall clumsily or helplessly; to fail completely.

words.ex: They watched a musical on Broadway last night.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨晚在百老汇看了一部音乐剧。
words.en: Broadway is a major thoroughfare in New York City, best known for its theaters and entertainment venues, particularly those presenting musicals.

words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.ex_cn: 他是个高个子男人。
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他头发很短。
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.ex: He is laying the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something down, especially horizontally or in a flat position; to produce eggs; to prepare or make ready by putting something in position.

words.ex: He ate two pieces of bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了两片面包。
words.en: A piece is a part or a section of something larger, or an individual item that is considered separately from the whole.

words.ex: We cleaned the house ourselves.
words.ex_cn: 我们自己打扫了房子。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is the speaker and one or more other people considered together.

words.ex: The truck can carry ten tons of sand.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车可以载十吨沙子。
words.en: A unit of weight equal to 2,240 pounds (1,016 kilograms) in the UK or 2,000 pounds (907 kilograms) in the US.

words.ex: He obviously forgot his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他显然忘了做作业。
