words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: The hotel has a large atrium with plants and sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有一个带植物和阳光的宽敞中庭。
words.en: An atrium is a part of the heart that receives blood from the veins, or a large open space within a building, often with a glass roof.

words.ex: He drinks sugarless coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝无糖咖啡。
words.en: Containing no sugar.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.tr: n. 节约； v. 拯救；节省；保存；“save”的现在分词；
words.ex: His saving helped him buy a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他的节约帮他买了一辆新车。
words.en: Saving refers to the act of keeping money or other resources for future use, or the money that is saved.

words.ex: My parents are letting me go to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我父母允许我去公园。
words.en: the act of renting out property or accommodation

words.ex: He wore a strange hat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去学校。
words.en: If something is strange, it is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

words.ex: She seeks perfection in everything she does.
words.ex_cn: 她在所做的每件事中都追求完美。
words.en: The state of being perfect; the highest degree of excellence or quality.

words.ex: I loathe waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: If you loathe something or someone, you dislike them very much.

words.tr: v. 供应；提供；报价；“offer”的现在分词； n. 出售物；作品；
words.ex: The store is offering fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天早上供应新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: An offering is something that is produced for other people to use, watch, or enjoy, or the act of producing it.

words.tr: adv. 笨拙地；局促不安地；尴尬地
words.ex: He walked awkwardly after his injury.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路很不自然。
words.en: In a manner that is not graceful or elegant in movement or shape; clumsily.

words.ex: They had a heimlich meeting to discuss the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 他们秘密开会讨论惊喜派对。
words.en: adjective. done secretly or kept secret.

words.tr:
n. 鞭子
v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动
words.ex: The farmer used a whip to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To whip means to hit a person or animal with a whip, or to move something quickly and suddenly.

words.tr: n. 秋千；摆动；显著的变化；摆动( swing的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The children are playing on the swings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩秋千。
words.en: Swings can refer to the act of moving back and forth or to the piece of playground equipment designed for such motion.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr:
int. 再见；
n. 说再见；
words.ex: She said goodbye and left the room.
words.ex_cn: 她说再见后离开了房间。
words.en: Goodbye is a conventional expression used at parting.

words.ex: He touched his cheek gently.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻摸了摸脸颊。
words.en: The soft part of a person's face below the eye and between the nose and ear.

words.tr: adj. 发狂的；狂热的；疯狂的
words.ex: He had a maniacal glint in his eyes as he spoke about his new project.
words.ex_cn: 他谈起自己的新项目时，眼中闪烁着狂热的光芒。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as maniacal, you mean that it is extremely wild and often violent because they are mentally ill or very angry.

words.ex: He is learning algebra at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习代数。
words.en: An expression of amusement or laughter, often used informally.

words.ex: He intentionally left his homework at home.
words.ex_cn: 他故意把作业忘在家里。
words.en: If something is done intentionally, it is done deliberately and not by accident.

words.tr:
adj. 混乱不清的；引起误解的
v. 混淆；曲解；断章取义；“garble”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The phone call was garbled and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 电话声音杂乱，很难听清楚。
words.en: If something is garbled, it is confused and difficult to understand, often because it has been communicated in a way that is unclear or distorted.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.ex: He waited for the bus for 20 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他等了20分钟的公交车。
words.en: to stay in a place until an expected event happens, until someone arrives, until it is your turn to do something, etc.

words.ex: He throw the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给他的朋友。
words.en: To propel something through the air with a movement of the arm and hand.

words.ex: He visited York last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了约克。
words.en: A city in northern England, known for its rich history and the York Minster, a large Gothic cathedral.

words.tr:
adj. 怪异的；捉摸不定的；不可思议的；可怕的；“weird”的最高级
n. 〈古〉命运；〈古〉【文】命运女神
words.ex: That is the weirdest hat I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 那是我见过的最奇怪的帽子。
words.en: Superlative form of 'weird', meaning the most strange or unusual.

words.tr: n. 牧师职位；神职人员
words.ex: He became a priest and joined the priesthood.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了一名牧师，并加入了神职人员行列。
words.en: The priesthood refers to the position or office of a priest, or the group of priests as a whole.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: He eats jewish food on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日吃犹太人的食物。
words.en: Jewish means relating to the religion, culture, or people of the Jews.

words.tr: n. 光明节（犹太人的一个节日，为期八天，通常在12月）
words.ex: We light the menorah each night of Chanukah.
words.ex_cn: 我们在光明节的每个晚上点亮烛台。
words.en: Chanukah, also known as the Festival of Lights, is an eight-day Jewish holiday commemorating the rededication of the Second Temple in Jerusalem during the Maccabean Revolt against the Seleucid Empire.

words.ex: He is messing with the computer again.
words.ex_cn: 他又在摆弄电脑了。
words.en: To make untidy or dirty; to interfere with.

words.tr: n. 奇迹；“wonder”的复数； v. 想知道；
words.ex: The pyramids are ancient wonders of the world.
words.ex_cn: 金字塔是世界古代奇迹。
words.en: If you wonder about something, you think about it because you are curious about it or because you are doubtful or uncertain about it.

words.ex: He gave a simple explanation for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的错误给出了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An explanation is a statement or account that makes something clear or provides a reason for something.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: He wears a warm sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件暖和的毛衣。
words.en: A sweater is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. It is usually made of wool or cotton and has long sleeves.

words.ex: The looters stole food from the store.
words.ex_cn: 劫掠者从商店偷了食物。
words.en: People who steal from buildings, especially after a disaster or during unrest.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.ex: The city had a blackout during the war.
words.ex_cn: 战争期间，这座城市实行了灯火管制。
words.en: A blackout is a period of time during which there is no electricity, or when the lights are turned off, especially as a result of an emergency or for a theatrical effect. It can also refer to a temporary loss of memory or consciousness.

words.tr: adj. 被迷住的，神魂颠倒的
words.ex: He is smitten with the new girl in class.
words.ex_cn: 他迷上了班上那个新女孩。
words.en: If you are smitten with someone or something, you are very attracted to them or in love with them.

words.ex: The queens wear crowns at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 女王们在仪式上戴着王冠。
words.en: A queen is a woman who rules a country because she has been born into a royal family, or a woman who is married to a king.

words.tr: n. 曼哈顿（美国纽约市的一个区）
words.ex: He lives in Manhattan near Central Park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在曼哈顿，靠近中央公园。
words.en: Manhattan is one of the five boroughs of New York City, located primarily on Manhattan Island at the mouth of the Hudson River. It is known for its skyscrapers, Central Park, and as the financial, cultural, and commercial center of the city.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.tr: n. 水塘；水池；备用物资；美式撞球；
words.ex: The children play near the small pool.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小水塘边玩耍。
words.en: A pool is a small area of still water, especially one that is artificially created.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.ex: He owes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If you owe money to someone, they have lent it to you and you have not yet paid it back. You can also say that you owe someone a debt of gratitude if they have helped you in a way that you feel you should thank them for.

words.tr: n. （衣服上的）纽扣；按钮（button 的复数形式）
words.ex: The shirt has five buttons.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫有五个纽扣。
words.en: Pressable controls on a device or interface used to activate a function.

words.tr: n. 英语字母表的第二个字母；（成绩）良
words.ex: The word 'bat' starts with the letter b.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'bat' 以字母 b 开头。
words.en: The second letter of the English alphabet; used as a symbol or abbreviation.

words.ex: Add a poco of sugar to the tea.
words.ex_cn: 往茶里加一点糖。
words.en: adv. A little; somewhat. Used chiefly in directions in music.

words.ex: Silicon is used in computer chips, and its symbol is Si.
words.ex_cn: 硅用于计算机芯片，它的符号是Si。
words.en: In music, 'si' is the seventh note in the solfège system, corresponding to the note 'B' in the fixed-do system.

words.ex: She writes a letter to her friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 她每周都给她的朋友写信。
words.en: To form letters, words, or symbols on a surface such as paper with a pen, pencil, etc.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.ex: I love the lyrics of this song.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这首歌的歌词。
words.en: The words of a song, especially a pop song.

words.ex: Betcha can't guess what I got you for your birthday!
words.ex_cn: v. 我敢打赌你猜不到我为你生日准备了什么！
words.en: A contraction of 'bet you', used informally to express certainty or to challenge someone.

words.tr: n. 孟德尔（姓氏，通常指遗传学之父格雷戈尔·孟德尔，复数形式，较少使用）
words.ex: Mendels studied pea plants to find how traits are passed.
words.ex_cn: 孟德尔研究豌豆植物，以发现性状是如何遗传的。
words.en: The surname of Gregor Mendel, the founder of modern genetics.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.tr: n. 祖母；外祖母；奶奶；外婆
words.ex: My grandma cooks soup every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶每个星期天都煮汤。
words.en: Your grandma is your grandmother. In other words, your grandma is your mother or father's mother.

words.tr: pron. 那是（that is 的缩写形式）
words.ex: That's my book.
words.ex_cn: 那是我的书。
words.en: A common informal spelling of 'that's' (that is).

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.ex: She licked her lip before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 她在说话前舔了舔嘴唇。
words.en: Your lips are the two outer parts of the edge of your mouth.

words.tr:
n. 咬；咬伤；上钩；
v. 咬；叮；上钩；
words.ex: The dog gave him a sudden bite.
words.ex_cn: 狗突然咬了他一口。
words.en: If an animal or person bites you, they use their teeth to cut into your flesh.

words.tr: adj. 负面的；消极的；否定的；
words.ex: The news had a negative effect on the market.
words.ex_cn: 这条新闻对市场产生了负面影响。
words.en: If someone is negative or has a negative attitude, they consider only the bad aspects of a situation, rather than the good ones.

words.tr:
adj. 黑暗的；暗色的；深色的；
n. 黑暗；夜；暗色；
words.ex: The room was dark after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间变得黑暗。
words.en: The absence of light in a place is referred to as dark. It can also describe something that is not light in color, or something that is mysterious or difficult to understand.

words.ex: The wood burns slowly in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 木头在火中缓慢燃烧。
words.en: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that there is a burn there. When you burn something, you destroy or damage it with fire or heat.

words.tr: adj. 害怕的；恐惧的； v. “scare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The child was scared of the dark.
words.ex_cn: 孩子害怕黑暗。
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.tr: n. 所有权人；主人；物主；
words.ex: The owner of the house sold it last week.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的主人上周把它卖了。
words.en: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

words.tr: n. 密尔沃基（美国威斯康星州东南部港市）
words.ex: He lives in Milwaukee.
words.ex_cn: 他住在密尔沃基。
words.en: A city in the U.S. state of Wisconsin, known for its brewing industry.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.tr: n. 踏板摩托车（一种小型摩托车，通常由脚踏驱动或电动驱动）
words.ex: The children ride mopeds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里骑轻便摩托车。
words.en: Lightweight motor vehicles with two wheels, powered by a small engine, often used for personal transport.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园看狮子。
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.ex: The peacock spreads its colorful tail.
words.ex_cn: 孔雀张开了它五彩斑斓的尾巴。
words.en: A peacock is a large bird, the male of which has very long tail feathers that it can spread out to display bright colors and patterns as part of courtship.

words.tr: v. 移动；“move”的现在分词；搬家； adj. 运动的；感人的；动人的；可移动的；
words.ex: The boy is moving his toy car.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩正在移动他的玩具车。
words.en: If something is moving, it makes you feel strongly touched or emotional.

words.ex: The dog was bitten by a snake.
words.ex_cn: 那只狗被蛇咬了。
words.en: If you are bitten by an animal or a person, their teeth go into your skin.

words.tr:
n. 英语；英文；
adj. 英格兰的；英格兰人的；英语的；
words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天说英语。
words.en: English refers to the language spoken in Britain, the United States, and many other parts of the world, as well as to the people of England.

words.ex: The grass was trampled by the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 草地被人群踩踏了。
words.en: To tread on and crush something underfoot.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时睡着了。
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: She smiled at the compliment.
words.ex_cn: 她对着赞美微笑。
words.en: To smile means to form the lips into a curve that shows happiness or amusement.

words.tr: n. 百慕大（北大西洋西部群岛）
words.ex: He went on vacation to Bermuda last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去百慕大度假了。
words.en: Bermuda is a group of islands in the North Atlantic Ocean, known for its pink sand beaches and the mysterious Bermuda Triangle.

words.ex: The kitty is sleeping on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 小猫正在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: A kitty is a young cat or a term of endearment for a cat.

words.tr: adj. 迷惑的；混乱的； v. 迷惑；混淆；“confuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He looked confused when the teacher asked the question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他看起来很迷惑。
words.en: If you are confused, you do not know exactly what is happening or what to do.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.tr: v. 摩擦；揉搓（rub 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来取暖。
words.en: To apply pressure and move one's hands back and forth over a surface; to massage.

words.ex: He playfully teased his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他逗弄他的妹妹，带着玩闹的语气。
words.en: In a manner that is full of fun and high spirits; not seriously.

words.tr:
v. 叹息；叹气
n. 叹息；叹气
words.ex: He sighed when he saw the messy room.
words.ex_cn: 他看到凌乱的房间时叹了口气。
words.en: To sigh is to let out a deep breath slowly and audibly, often as a sign of sadness, tiredness, or relief.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.ex: The kitten is sleeping on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 小猫正在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: A kitten is a very young cat.

words.ex: The cat sleeps on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发上睡觉。
words.en: A cat is a small furry animal with a tail, whiskers, and sharp claws. Cats are often kept as pets.

words.tr: v. 嘲弄；喝倒彩；（常用于复数形式）喝倒彩声
words.ex: The crowd heckles the speaker during the debate.
words.ex_cn: 观众在辩论期间对演讲者嘘声不断。
words.en: To interrupt or harass a public speaker or performer with loud, critical remarks.

words.ex: He visited Italy last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了意大利。
words.en: A country in southern Europe, known for its rich cultural heritage, history, art, and cuisine.

words.tr:
adj. 微型的；
n. 微型画；小型模型；
words.ex: He bought a miniature car for his collection.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的收藏买了一辆微型汽车。
words.en: A miniature is a very small detailed painting, often a portrait. It can also refer to a small-scale model or representation of something.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.tr: v. 嘘声；示意安静（shush 的现在分词）
words.ex: He was shushing the kids so they wouldn't wake the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他正在嘘声让孩子们安静，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: The act of urging someone to be quiet, typically by making a 'shh' sound.

words.tr: v. 使变黑（black 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He blacked out during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上昏过去了。
words.en: To become completely dark or black, often due to a power outage or loss of vision.

words.tr: v. 呼出；呼气（exhale 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He exhales slowly after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完后慢慢呼气。
words.en: To breathe out air, especially after holding one's breath or during exertion.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.tr: n. 吹风，排泄，鼓风 v. 吹气( blow的现在分词 ); 刮风; 吹响; 炸开
words.ex: The blowing wind made it difficult to hear.
words.ex_cn: 刮风使得很难听到声音。
words.en: The act of moving air or wind; the act of expelling air from the mouth.

words.ex: He stared in amazement at the magic trick.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地盯着那个魔术。
words.en: Amazement is the feeling you have when something surprises you very much.

words.ex: His knowledge of history is superficial.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史的了解是表面的。
words.en: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr: adj. 感到惊讶的； v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；“surprise”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was surprised when I saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当我看到礼物时，我感到很惊讶。
words.en: If you are surprised, you have a feeling of surprise, because something unexpected has happened.

words.ex: His acts were very kind to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为对每个人都非常友善。
words.en: Acts can refer to the deeds or actions performed by someone, or it can denote a formal written law passed by a legislative body. As a verb, it means to do something or to perform a role in a play, movie, etc.

words.tr: adv. 天真地；单纯地；佯装无知地
words.ex: He smiled innocently when he broke the vase.
words.ex_cn: 他打碎花瓶时，天真地笑了。
words.en: In a way that shows you are not guilty of a crime or of doing something wrong; in a way that shows you do not intend to deceive or trick anyone.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.tr:
n. 废话；胡扯；空谈
adj. 乏味的；无聊的
words.ex: Stop saying blah and tell me the truth.
words.ex_cn: 别再说废话了，告诉我真相。
words.en: If you say that something is blah, you mean that it is boring, uninteresting, or meaningless.

words.tr: n. 六个；六点（骰子点数）；六分（板球得分）
words.ex: He rolled sixes with the dice.
words.ex_cn: 他掷出了六个六。
words.en: A score of six runs in cricket, achieved by hitting the ball over the boundary without touching the ground.

words.ex: He laughed sarcastically when she said she was perfect.
words.ex_cn: 当她说自己完美时，他讽刺地笑了。
words.en: In a sarcastic manner; using sarcasm.

words.tr: n. 拉比；犹太的法学博士
words.ex: The rabbi teaches the children about Jewish traditions.
words.ex_cn: 拉比教孩子们关于犹太传统。
words.en: A rabbi is a Jewish scholar or teacher, especially one who studies or teaches Jewish law.

words.tr: v. 担任裁判；主持（比赛或仪式）
words.ex: He is officiating the basketball game.
words.ex_cn: 他正在执裁这场篮球比赛。
words.en: Acting as an official in a sports game or formal event, enforcing rules and making decisions.

words.tr: n. 迪士尼乐园（美国加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市的一个主题公园，由华特·迪士尼创建）；
words.ex: We went to Disneyland last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天去了迪士尼乐园。
words.en: Disneyland is a theme park in Anaheim, California, created by Walt Disney and opened in 1955. It is known for its attractions, entertainment, and characters from Disney films.

words.tr: n. 基础；基本原理；根基
words.ex: The company laid the groundwork for future expansion.
words.ex_cn: 公司为未来的扩展打下了基础。
words.en: The groundwork is the preparation that is necessary before something can be done or begun.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr: n. 安全；保障；防护措施；
words.ex: The school improved security to protect students.
words.ex_cn: 学校加强了安全措施以保护学生。
words.en: Security refers to the state of being free from danger or threat, or measures taken to ensure safety.

words.tr: n. 女性同性恋；女性同性恋行为
words.ex: Her openness about her lesbianism has inspired many others to come out.
words.ex_cn: 她对自己女性同性恋身份的公开激励了许多其他人也出柜。
words.en: Lesbianism refers to the sexual orientation or sexual behavior between women.

words.tr: adj. 鬼一般的；怪异吓人的；阴森可怖的
words.ex: The old house looks spooky at night.
words.ex_cn: 那座老房子晚上看起来很阴森。
words.en: If something is spooky, it is strange and frightening, and makes you think of ghosts.

words.ex: Technically, the phone works, but it's slow.
words.ex_cn: 技术上讲，这部手机能用，但很慢。
words.en: In a way that relates to the knowledge, machines, or methods used in science and industry.

words.ex: He felt sad when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到伤心。
words.en: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.tr: v. 变成；成为；变得；“become”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is becoming a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他正在变成一名老师。
words.en: If something is becoming, it suits you and looks good on you.

words.tr: adj. 决定性的；权威性的；确定的；
words.ex: The test results were definitive.
words.ex_cn: 这些检测结果是决定性的。
words.en: A definitive book, performance, or report is considered to be the best of its kind that has ever been done or that will ever be done.

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.tr: adj. 评价过高的； v. “overrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: That movie is overrated; it's not that good.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影评价过高；其实没那么好。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is overrated, you mean that people have a higher opinion of them than they deserve.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；“touch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child is touching the soft blanket.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在触摸柔软的毯子。
words.en: If something is touching, it causes feelings of sadness or sympathy.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean.
words.ex_cn: 她保持房间干净。
words.en: If you keep something, you continue to have it in your possession and do not throw it away, give it away, or lose it.

words.ex: My sister walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹每天走路去上学。
words.en: A sister is a woman or girl who has one or both parents in common with another individual.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.tr:
n. 骑；乘坐；
v. 骑；乘坐；
words.ex: He gave me a ride on his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他让我骑了他的自行车。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal, especially a horse, or to travel in or on a vehicle or other conveyance.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.tr: adj. 固定的；不能变的； v. 修理；固定；确定；“fix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a fixed schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有一个固定的日程。
words.en: If something is fixed, it is attached or positioned so that it cannot move, or is arranged in a particular way and cannot be changed.

words.tr:
adj. 荷兰的；
n. 荷兰人；荷兰语；
words.ex: He ate Dutch cheese for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了荷兰奶酪。
words.en: Dutch refers to anything related to the Netherlands, including its people, language, or culture.

words.ex: The children are playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Children are people who are not yet adults, typically those who are under the age of 18.

words.ex: The children were silent during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在看电影时很安静。
words.en: Someone or something that is silent makes no noise at all.

words.tr: n. 肩膀；肩部；肩膀（shoulder 的复数）；
words.ex: He carried the bag on his shoulders.
words.ex_cn: 他把包扛在肩膀上。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the arm is connected, or the part of a piece of clothing that covers this.

words.ex: The cat jumps over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过篱笆。
words.en: To move suddenly and quickly off the ground or from one place to another, often using your legs.

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.ex: He is se.
words.ex_cn: 他正在se。
words.en: A misspelling of 'see', to perceive with the eyes.

words.ex: He showed no ruth for the crying child.
words.ex_cn: 他对哭泣的孩子毫无怜悯。
words.en: Ruth is a noun that refers to a feeling of pity or compassion for someone.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.tr: v. 到达；延伸；伸出手臂；到达( reach的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is reaching the station just in time.
words.ex_cn: 他正到达车站，刚好来得及。
words.en: To extend out an arm in order to touch or grasp something; to arrive at a place, goal, or state.

words.ex: He eats meat every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃肉。
words.en: Meat is the flesh of an animal that is eaten as food.

words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.ex: He felt disappointment when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 当他考试没及格时，他感到失望。
words.en: A feeling of sadness or displeasure caused by the nonfulfillment of one's hopes or expectations.

words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.ex: He finds a hidden key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他在垫子下发现了一把隐藏的钥匙。
words.en: To discover something or someone after searching.

words.ex: He stared at the money with disbelief.
words.ex_cn: 他难以置信地盯着那些钱。
words.en: Disbelief is the feeling of not being able to believe that something is true or real.

words.ex: The mountains in the reaches of the horizon look blue.
words.ex_cn: 地平线远处的山看起来是蓝色的。
words.en: Arrives at or extends to a particular place or point.

words.tr: adj. 更高的；高等级的；“high”的比较级； adv. 在更高处；“high”的比较级；
words.ex: He got a higher score than his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他比他的朋友得分更高。
words.en: Higher is the comparative form of 'high', meaning at or to a greater level or degree.

words.ex: He shouted for help when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时大叫着求救。
words.en: If you shout, you say something very loudly, usually because you want people a long distance away to hear you or because you are angry.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.ex: He congratulates his friend for winning the race.
words.ex_cn: 他祝贺朋友赢得了比赛。
words.en: To express pleasure and approval for someone's achievement or good fortune.

words.ex: He stopped talking abruptly.
words.ex_cn: 他突然停止了说话。
words.en: Suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He wears a black overcoat in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件黑色大衣。
words.en: An overcoat is a long warm coat that you wear over your other clothes in cold weather.

words.ex: He stepped aside to let the bus pass.
words.ex_cn: 他走到一旁，让公交车通过。
words.en: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you, usually because it is in the way.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: The dog ran through the mud.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑过了泥地。
words.en: Mud is a sticky mixture of earth and water.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.ex_cn: 护士给病人服了药。
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.tr: n. 小衣；抽屉( drawer的名词复数 )；
words.ex: He keeps his socks in the drawers.
words.ex_cn: 他把袜子放在抽屉里。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding boxlike container that is open at the top and fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or dresser, in such a way that it can be drawn out horizontally to access its contents.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.tr:
v. 包含；
vt. 包含；容纳；
words.ex: This box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.ex: He was amongst the first to arrive.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到达的人之一。
words.en: If something is among other things, it is one of them.

words.tr: adj. 醉酒的；被石头砸的；被毒品麻醉的
words.ex: He got stoned at the party last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚在派对上喝醉了。
words.en: affected by or as if by a drug that alters consciousness; intoxicated, especially by alcohol or drugs.

words.tr:
adj. 露齿而笑的
v. 咧嘴而笑；“grin”的现在分词
words.ex: He is grinning after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛后正咧嘴笑着。
words.en: To smile broadly, often showing the teeth.

words.tr: adj. 新兴的； v. 浮现；显露；“emerge”的现在分词；
words.ex: China has many emerging tech companies.
words.ex_cn: 中国有许多新兴的科技公司。
words.en: An emerging market, country, or economy is one that is beginning to grow and develop its industries and infrastructure.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.ex: I put the photos on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我把照片放在桌子上。
words.en: Photos are images taken by a camera and recorded on a photosensitive surface or digitally.

words.ex: Mary Shelley is best known for her novel 'Frankenstein'.
words.ex_cn: 玛丽·雪莱以其小说《弗兰肯斯坦》最为人所知。
words.en: A female proper name, often used as a given name or surname.

words.tr: n. 喝；喝酒； v. 喝；喝酒；“drink”的现在分词；
words.ex: Drinking water is important for health.
words.ex_cn: 喝水对健康很重要。
words.en: The act of consuming liquids, especially alcohol.

words.tr: v. 准备； adj. 准备的，预备的 v. 准备( prepare的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is preparing for his exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为考试做准备。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.ex: Lillian walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 莉莉安每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: A female given name, meaning 'lily'.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.tr: adj. 受伤的；受损害的； v. “injure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The injured player was taken to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 受伤的球员被送往医院。
words.en: If you are injured, you have been hurt, usually in an accident or attack.

words.ex: He is checking the answers before submitting.
words.ex_cn: 他在提交前检查答案。
words.en: The act of examining something to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or a type of bank account that allows you to write checks against the money you have deposited.

words.tr: v. 重新进入；再次进入（enter 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is reentering the classroom after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后重新进入教室。
words.en: To enter a place again after having left it.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.tr:
adj. 日本的；日本人的；日语的；
n. 日语；日本人；
words.ex: She ate Japanese food for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚餐吃了日本菜。
words.en: Relating to Japan, its people, or their language.

words.ex: The fluorescent lamp lights up the room quickly.
words.ex_cn: 荧光灯很快照亮了房间。
words.en: Fluorescent substances produce bright light of a particular color when they are exposed to light of a different wavelength.

words.tr: adj. 脱水的； v. “dehydrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The dehydrated fruit tastes sweet and chewy.
words.ex_cn: 脱水的水果味道甜美且有嚼劲。
words.en: If someone is dehydrated, they have lost too much water from their body.

words.ex: Heh, what are you doing?
words.ex_cn: 嗨，你在干什么？
words.en: Used to represent a slight laugh or an expression of mild embarrassment or surprise.

words.ex: Dorothy walks down the yellow brick road.
words.ex_cn: 多萝西沿着黄色砖路走。
words.en: A female given name of Greek origin, meaning 'gift of God'.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: He performed remarkably well in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中表现得非常出色。
words.en: In a way that is worthy of attention; strikingly.

words.tr: n. 布伦特（一种小型鹅）
words.ex: He works at a brent oil field in North Sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在北海的一个布伦特油田工作。
words.en: A small species of goose, known for its migration patterns.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: The hotel provides excellent services.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店提供出色的服务。
words.en: Services are systems or organizations that provide something that the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities like electricity and water.

words.ex: The movie is fascinating because it shows strange aliens.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极有吸引力，因为它展示了奇怪的外星人。
words.en: If you describe something as fascinating, you find it very interesting and attractive, and your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: The company updated the payroll last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 公司上星期五更新了职工工资册。
words.en: A payroll is a list of employees and the amount of money they are to be paid, or the total amount of money paid to the employees of a company.

words.ex: Brian is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 布莱恩正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A proper name, a common given name.

words.tr: adj. 引起恐惧的；使惊恐的；骇人的； v. “frighten”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark forest looked frightening at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来很吓人。
words.en: If you say that something is frightening, you mean that it makes you feel afraid or anxious.

words.tr: n. 兽皮；兽皮( hide的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The trader sells hides from deer and cows.
words.ex_cn: 商人出售鹿和牛的兽皮。
words.en: To hide means to put or keep out of sight; to conceal from the view or notice of others. As a noun, it refers to the skin of an animal, especially when tanned or dressed.

words.ex: He listens to music with earphone.
words.ex_cn: 他用耳机听音乐。
words.en: A device consisting of a pair of small loudspeakers worn over or in the ears, used for listening to audio signals such as music or speech.

words.tr: n. 伤残；失去能力；无能力；
words.ex: He has a disability that makes walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 他有伤残，导致行走困难。
words.en: A disability is a physical or mental condition that limits a person's movements, senses, or activities.

words.ex: The children watched the giants in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们观看了电影中的巨人。
words.en: Giants are very large imaginary creatures that appear in fairy tales and legends. They are often depicted as being much larger and stronger than humans.

words.tr: n. 牛仔；牧童；牛仔竞技表演者
words.ex: The cowboys herded the cattle across the open range.
words.ex_cn: 牛仔们在开阔的牧场上驱赶牛群。
words.en: Cowboys are men who work on ranches, especially in the western United States, and who traditionally ride horses and are responsible for herding cattle.

words.ex: Pre-school children love to play.
words.ex_cn: 学龄前的孩子喜欢玩耍。
words.en: Pre is a prefix which means before.

words.tr: n. 缺乏圆滑；不机敏；不善交际
words.ex: His tactlessness made everyone feel uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 他的不圆滑让每个人都感到不舒服。
words.en: The quality of being tactless; lacking skill and sensitivity in dealing with others.

words.tr:
adj. 同性恋的；愉快的
n. 同性恋者
words.ex: He is a gay teacher who loves his students.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位同性恋老师，深爱他的学生。
words.en: Someone who is gay is homosexual.

words.ex: He has seventeen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十七个苹果。
words.en: The number seventeen is the natural number following sixteen and preceding eighteen.

words.tr: n. 一种用于切割或砍伐的工具，通常有长柄和宽刃
words.ex: He is macheing the walls with paint.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用油漆粉刷墙壁。
words.en: A mache is a tool with a long handle and a broad blade, used for cutting or chopping.

words.tr: abbr. generally recognized as safe 一般安全
words.ex: He cannot grasp the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: Gras: a French word meaning 'fat' or 'grease', often used in English culinary terms.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.ex: He said yup when asked if he was ready.
words.ex_cn: 当被问是否准备好了时，他回答‘嗯’。
words.en: used to say yes; an informal way of saying 'yes'

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: He visited Rome last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了罗马。
words.en: The capital city of Italy, known for its rich history, architecture, and as the center of the Roman Catholic Church.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.tr: v. 驱使；驾驶；“drive”的过去式；
words.ex: Fear drove him to leave the city.
words.ex_cn: 恐惧驱使他离开了这座城市。
words.en: A drove is a large group of animals, especially cattle or sheep, moving together. As a verb, it is the past tense of drive, meaning to force animals or people to move in a particular direction.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: He wore a crazy hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶疯狂的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as crazy, you mean that they are very enthusiastic or excited about something.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The baby covers his ears when the noise is loud.
words.ex_cn: 当噪音很大时，婴儿会捂住耳朵。
words.en: The organs of hearing and balance in humans and other vertebrates, especially the external part of these organs.

words.ex: He reads books every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words or symbols.

words.ex: Java is an island in Indonesia.
words.ex_cn: 爪哇是印度尼西亚的一个岛屿。
words.en: Java is a high-level, class-based, object-oriented programming language that is designed to have as few implementation dependencies as possible.

words.ex: The quality of this phone is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的质量很高。
words.en: The standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; the degree of excellence of something.

words.tr: n. 薄荷糖；薄荷（复数形式）
words.ex: He eats mints after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃薄荷糖。
words.en: A small, flat piece of metal used as a token for a game or a piece of hard candy.

words.tr: v. 检查；“check”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The teacher checked the students' homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师检查了学生的作业。
words.en: Having a pattern of squares, typically of two colors; past tense and past participle of check, meaning to examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition.

words.ex: The fish swim in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海里游泳。
words.en: The sea is the salty water that covers about three-quarters of the Earth's surface.

words.tr: v. 埋葬；埋藏；“bury”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 埋在地下的；
words.ex: They buried the dog in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把狗埋在了后院里。
words.en: If something is buried, it is placed in a hole in the ground and covered with earth, or it is hidden or concealed in some way.

words.tr: adj. 抑郁的； v. 降低；“depress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到抑郁。
words.en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

words.tr: v. 死亡，枯萎；死亡，枯萎（ die的过去式和过去分词 ）；
words.ex: The flowers died because of no water.
words.ex_cn: 这些花因为缺水而枯萎了。
words.en: If someone dies, they stop living. If something dies, it stops existing or functioning.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.ex: The little girl has a lovely smile.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lovely, you mean that they are very beautiful and therefore pleasing to look at or be with.

words.tr:
n. 小提琴；骗局
v. 摆弄；虚度时光；拉小提琴；篡改
words.ex: He bought a fiddle at the music shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐店买了一把小提琴。
words.en: A fiddle is a musical instrument with strings that you play with a bow. It is the same as a violin.

words.tr: v. 讨厌；憎恨；“hate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He hated waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他讨厌早起。
words.en: If you hate someone or something, you have an extremely strong feeling of dislike for them.

words.tr: adj. 未说出口的；未用语言表达出来的；收回（unsay 的过去分词形式）；
words.ex: He felt the unsaid words between them.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到了他们之间未说出口的话。
words.en: If something is unsaid, it has not been expressed in words.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；批判性的；关键的；危急的；临界的；
words.ex: Water is critical for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you are critical of someone or something, you show that you disapprove of them. In a critical situation, things are very serious and dangerous. A critical time or event is extremely important because it will affect future events.

words.ex: He takes two pills every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃两粒药丸。
words.en: Small solid round mass of medicine that you swallow without chewing.

words.ex: He pats the dog on the head.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了拍狗的头。
words.en: To touch someone or something gently and repeatedly with your hand flat.

words.tr:
adj. 高尔夫球运动的；打高尔夫球用的 
n. 打高尔夫球
v. 打高尔夫球；“golf”的现在分词
words.ex: He spent the weekend golfing with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末和朋友一起打高尔夫球。
words.en: the activity of playing golf.

words.ex: He drank water from a bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个瓶子里喝水。
words.en: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

words.tr: n. 事故；意外事件；意外；
words.ex: He was hurt in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中受伤了。
words.en: An accident is an unexpected and undesirable event, especially one resulting in damage or harm.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: She kept affirming her commitment to the project.
words.ex_cn: 她不断肯定她对项目的承诺。
words.en: To state or assert positively; maintain as true.

words.ex: He calls her sweetheart every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都叫她亲爱的。
words.en: A sweetheart is a person with whom one is in love or has a romantic relationship.

words.tr: n. 浪费; adj. 浪费的；造成浪费的
words.ex: Wasting water is bad for the environment.
words.ex_cn: 浪费水对环境有害。
words.en: Wasting refers to the act of using or expending something carelessly, extravagantly, or to no purpose. It can also refer to the process of becoming progressively weaker and thinner, especially due to illness.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.tr: adj. 上釉的； v. “glaze”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The glazed tile sparkled in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 上釉的瓷砖在阳光下闪闪发光。
words.en: Having a shiny or glassy surface; often used to describe eyes that appear lifeless or unfocused.

words.ex: What happens when it rains?
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时会发生什么？
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: The machine needs new bearings to run smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器需要新的轴承才能顺畅运行。
words.en: Bearings are devices that allow constrained relative motion between two or more parts, typically rotation or linear movement. They can also refer to a person's way of standing or moving, or the direction or position relative to a fixed point.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.tr:
adj. 黄色的；
n. 黄色；
words.ex: The banana is yellow.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉是黄色的。
words.en: Yellow is the color of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg. It is one of the three primary colors.

words.tr: v. 击；袭击；打；“strike”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The hammer struck the nail.
words.ex_cn: 锤子击中了钉子。
words.en: If you strike someone or something, you deliberately hit them.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.ex: The children are holding their pencils.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们拿着他们的铅笔。
words.en: Pencils are instruments for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of graphite or a similar substance enclosed in a cylinder of wood or fixed in a metal or plastic case.

words.ex: The lightning struck the tree last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚闪电击中了那棵树。
words.en: A flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.ex: He draws the door open slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地把门拉开。
words.en: To produce a picture or diagram by making lines and marks on paper or another surface; to pull or drag something such as a vehicle or a part of the body; to attract someone to a place or person.

words.ex: Debbie is a popular name for girls.
words.ex_cn: 黛比是一个很受欢迎的女孩名字。
words.en: A female given name, often a diminutive of Deborah.

words.ex: The children drew circles on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在纸上画了圈。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the center of the area.

words.tr: n. 痉挛；抽搐；一阵发作
words.ex: He had a spasm in his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他的腿抽筋了。
words.en: A spasm is a sudden and involuntary contraction of a muscle or group of muscles, often causing pain or discomfort.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.tr:
adj. 同性恋的
n. 同性恋者
words.ex: He is homosexual and loves his partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是同性恋，爱他的伴侣。
words.en: A homosexual is someone who is sexually attracted to people of the same sex.

words.tr: v. 错过；漏掉；想念；“miss”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上错过了公交车。
words.en: If you miss something, you fail to hit it, for example when you have thrown something at it or you have shot a bullet at it.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.tr:
adj. 恼火的；激怒的
v. 使恼怒；使恶化；使加剧；“exasperate”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was exasperated by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被那阵噪音气得发疯。
words.en: If you describe someone as exasperated, you mean that they are frustrated or angry because of something that is happening or something that another person is doing.

words.tr: v. 奉承；迁就；迎合（humour 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is humouring his little brother to keep him quiet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在哄弟弟，让他安静下来。
words.en: Treating someone indulgently or tolerantly, especially to avoid conflict.

words.tr: n. 薄脆饼干；爆竹；迷人的姑娘；黑客
words.ex: He ate a cracker with cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块饼干配奶酪。
words.en: A cracker is a thin, crisp biscuit which is often eaten with cheese, or a person who is very good at something, especially solving problems or puzzles.

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.ex: He gave a quick answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了一个快速的回答。
words.en: Moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.tr: v. 发出哔哔声（beep 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The car beeped when I backed up.
words.ex_cn: 当我倒车时，汽车响了一声。
words.en: Made a short, high-pitched sound, typically from a machine or vehicle.

words.ex: Mio is my little brother.
words.ex_cn: Mio是我的小弟弟。
words.en: An Italian possessive adjective meaning 'my' (masculine singular).

words.tr: n. （Bon）日本盂兰盆会; n. （Bon）（美）邦（人名）
words.ex: The Bon festival is a time for family reunions and ancestor worship.
words.ex_cn: 盂兰盆节是家人团聚和祭拜祖先的时刻。
words.en: A slang term for a good or excellent thing; also used as an intensifier.

words.tr: n. 耳坠子；耳环( earring的名词复数 )；
words.ex: She wore silver earrings to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了银色耳坠子去参加派对。
words.en: Earrings are pieces of jewelry which are attached to the ears by a hook that goes through a hole in the ear or by a clip.

words.ex: The knife was sharpened after cutting the wood.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀在砍完木头后被磨利了。
words.en: Made sharp or sharper, especially at the edge or point.

words.ex: He will possibly come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天可能会来。
words.en: You use possibly to indicate that something is true or might be true, but you are not certain.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.tr: v. 寻找食物；觅食；（动物）吃草；（人）四处搜寻食物
words.ex: The cow forages in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛每天早上在田野里觅食。
words.en: Searches widely for food or resources, often by digging or rummaging.

words.tr: n. 保持器；保留金；家仆
words.ex: The dentist gave me a retainer to wear at night.
words.ex_cn: 牙医给了我一个保持器，让我晚上戴着。
words.en: A retainer is a fee that you pay to someone in order to make sure that they will be available to do work for you when you need them to.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.ex: Love is for eternity.
words.ex_cn: 爱是永恒的。
words.en: Eternity refers to infinite or unending time, or a state to which time has no application; timelessness.

words.ex: He wore a burgundy sweater to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他参加派对时穿了一件酒红色的毛衣。
words.en: Burgundy is a region in eastern France, known for its wine.

words.ex: The children play under the trees.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树下玩耍。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant that has a wooden trunk and branches that grow from its upper part.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.tr: adj. 关闭的；保密的； v. 关闭；“close”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store is closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店星期天关门。
words.en: If something is closed, it is not open or available to the public.

words.tr: n. 首饰盒，匣子，<美>棺材
words.ex: She kept her most precious jewels in a small casket.
words.ex_cn: 她把她最珍贵的珠宝放在一个小匣子里。
words.en: A casket is a box used for holding the body of a dead person for burial, or a small box for keeping valuable items such as jewelry.

words.tr: n. 伯尼（男性名字，Bernard的昵称）；
words.ex: Bernie likes to ride his bike every morning.
words.ex_cn: 伯尼每天早上都喜欢骑自行车。
words.en: A proper noun referring to a person's name, often used as a nickname or given name, especially for males.

words.tr:
adv. 两者都不；
adj. 两者都不的；
conj. 也不；
pron. 两者都不；
words.ex: I don't like coffee, and neither do I like tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡，也不喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a further negative statement after a negative one, or to indicate that a negative statement is also true of another person or thing

words.ex: This is the greatest number of students in our class.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们班人数最多的时候。
words.en: The superlative form of great, used to describe something that is the largest in size, extent, or degree, or the most important or significant.

words.ex: Many restaurants close early on Mondays.
words.ex_cn: 许多餐厅在周一早早关门。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: The company suffered big los this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年遭受了巨大损失。
words.en: The fact of no longer having something or having less of it than before.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

words.ex: Nitrogen is a gas, and its symbol is n.
words.ex_cn: 氮是一种气体，它的符号是n。
words.en: The fourteenth letter of the alphabet.

words.tr: v. 萎靡；衰退；突然下垂；n. 萎靡期；经济衰退期
words.ex: He slumps in his chair when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他就会瘫坐在椅子上。
words.en: Sits or falls heavily and limply, often due to exhaustion or dejection.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.ex: Phyllis is my best friend from college.
words.ex_cn: 菲莉丝是我大学时最好的朋友。
words.en: A female given name of Greek origin, meaning 'foliage' or 'greenery'.

words.tr: abbr. 不间断电源（Uninterrupted Power Supply）；
words.ex: The computer stayed on during the power outage thanks to the ups.
words.ex_cn: 由于不间断电源，电脑在停电时仍然正常运行。
words.en: An upward movement or increase.

words.ex: The boy learned about the penis in science class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在科学课上学习了阴茎。
words.en: The male organ of copulation in higher vertebrates, carrying the duct for the transfer of sperm during copulation.

words.tr: v. 种植；成长；渐渐变成；生长；“grow”的过去分词； adj. 成熟的；成年的；长大的；
words.ex: He grown tomatoes in his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里种植番茄。
words.en: Having reached maturity or full development; adult.

words.tr:
adv. 昨天；
n. 昨天；
words.ex: I saw her yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天见到她了。
words.en: The day before today.

words.ex: Phew, it's finally over!
words.ex_cn: 啊，终于结束了！
words.en: used to express relief, fatigue, surprise, or disgust

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: He flushes the toilet after using it.
words.ex_cn: 他用完厕所后冲水。
words.en: If you flush, your face goes red because you are hot or ill, or because you are feeling a strong emotion such as embarrassment or anger. To flush a toilet means to cause water to pass through it in order to clean it.

words.ex: He rubbed his backs after lifting the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完重箱子后揉了揉背部。
words.en: 1. The rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips. 2. To give support or one's approval to.

words.ex: He felt shame for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对母亲撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior.

words.tr: n. 洛厄尔（姓氏或地名）
words.ex: Lowell is a common surname in English-speaking countries.
words.ex_cn: n. 洛厄尔是英语国家中常见的姓氏。
words.en: Lowell is a surname of English origin, also used as a place name in various English-speaking regions.

words.tr: n. (child's word for) grandmother 祖母，奶奶
words.ex: Nana is making cookies for the children.
words.ex_cn: 奶奶正在为孩子们做饼干。
words.en: (child's word for) grandmother

words.ex: The old man dies peacefully in his sleep.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在睡梦中安详地去世了。
words.en: If someone dies, they stop living.

words.tr: adj. 五彩缤纷的；丰富多彩的；
words.ex: The children painted a colorful picture of the rainbow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们画了一幅五彩缤纷的彩虹画。
words.en: Something that is colorful has bright colors or a lot of different colors.

words.ex: He sleeps abnormally late on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他在周末反常地睡得很晚。
words.en: In a manner that deviates from what is normal or expected.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.tr:
n. V形物；钒（元素vanadium的符号）；（罗马数字）5
abbr. 对；相反；”versus“的缩写
words.ex: The bird flew in a v shape across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在天空中呈V形飞翔。
words.en: A variable in mathematics and programming, often representing an unknown quantity or a value that can change.

words.ex: The movie has many exciting scenes.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有很多激动人心的场景。
words.en: Scenes refer to the places where events or actions occur, or the views or sights that can be seen in a particular place.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.tr: n. 马里奥（男性名字，常用于意大利语名字）
words.ex: Mario plays video games every day.
words.ex_cn: 马里奥每天玩电子游戏。
words.en: A common male given name, of Italian origin, famously associated with the Nintendo video game character.

words.tr: n. 英语字母表的第四个字母
words.ex: The word 'dog' starts with the letter d.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'dog' 以字母 d 开头。
words.en: The fourth letter of the alphabet.

words.ex: He displayed his photos on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片展示在墙上。
words.en: If you display something, you show it to people, or put it in a place where people can see it easily.

words.tr: v. 拍打；掌掴（slap 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He slaps the table when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时拍桌子。
words.en: Strikes someone or something quickly and forcefully with the palm of the hand.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put into as much as can be held.

words.tr: n. 窃笑；暗笑（snicker 的复数）
words.ex: He ate a snickers bar after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后吃了一块士力架。
words.en: A light, half-suppressed laugh or chuckle.

words.tr: v. 接近；靠近；“approach”的现在分词； adj. 接近的；临近的；
words.ex: The train is approaching the station.
words.ex_cn: 火车正在接近车站。
words.en: Coming closer in distance or time.

words.ex: She bought a towel made of terry.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一条由毛圈织物制成的毛巾。
words.en: A type of fabric with loops that absorb water, used especially for making towels and robes.

words.ex: He is confronting his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他正在面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: Facing or dealing with something difficult or challenging directly.

words.ex: My boss gives me work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我的老板每天早上给我安排工作。
words.en: A boss is a person who is in charge of other people at work and tells them what to do.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr: n. 欢庆，庆祝活动，庆典( festivity的名词复数 ); 过节
words.ex: The town held festivities for the New Year.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇举行了新年庆祝活动。
words.en: Festivities refer to the celebrations or parties that happen during a special event or holiday.

words.ex: The cat sat in the doorway.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在门口。
words.en: A doorway is the space in a wall where a door opens and closes, or the covered area just outside a door.

words.tr:
n. 组；群；集团；
v. （使）形成组；
words.ex: The students are in a group of five.
words.ex_cn: 这些学生组成一个五人小组。
words.en: A group is a number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr: v. 显露；泄露；透露；“reveal”的现在分词； adj. 有启示作用的；
words.ex: The mirror revealed his true feelings.
words.ex_cn: 镜子显露了他真实的情感。
words.en: Providing interesting or significant information that was not previously known or realized.

words.tr: v. 剥皮；削皮（peel 的第三人称单数形式）；n. 果皮；蔬菜皮（peel 的复数形式）
words.ex: He peels the banana before eating it.
words.ex_cn: 他吃香蕉前先剥皮。
words.en: Outer layers or coverings, especially of fruit or vegetables.

words.tr:
n. 插图说明；标题；字幕
v. 加上说明；加上标题；加上字幕
words.ex: The photo has a caption that says 'Happy birthday'.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片有一个标题，写着‘生日快乐’。
words.en: A caption is a short piece of text under a picture in a book, magazine, or newspaper that describes the picture or explains what is happening in it.

words.tr: n. 标题；说明文字；字幕；标题，说明文字，字幕( caption的名词复数 ) v. 给（图片、照片等）加说明文字( c；
words.ex: The video has nice captions for each scene.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频每个场景都有很好的标题。
words.en: Textual representation of the speech or sound in a film, television program, or video.

words.ex: I ate two sandwiches for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了两个三明治。
words.en: A sandwich is two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: He feels pain in his bladder.
words.ex_cn: 他感到膀胱疼痛。
words.en: A bladder is a part of your body that is shaped like a bag and holds urine until it is passed out of the body.

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.tr:
n. 目标；目的；
v. 瞄准；以其为目标；
words.ex: His aim is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: An aim is a goal or purpose that you are trying to achieve. It can also refer to the act of directing a weapon or other object towards a target.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: He often goes to the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后常常去公园。
words.en: Many times; frequently.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.tr:
adj. 可充气的；可膨胀的
n. 可充气物品
words.ex: The children play with an inflatable ball in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩一个充气球。
words.en: An inflatable object is one that you fill with air or gas to make it expand and become larger or to make it float.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.tr: v. 呕吐（vomit 的 ing 形式）
words.ex: He was hospitalized due to severe vomiting.
words.ex_cn: 他因严重呕吐而住院。
words.en: The act of ejecting matter from the stomach through the mouth.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.ex: We have thanksgivings with family every November.
words.ex_cn: 我们每年十一月和家人一起过感恩节。
words.en: Expressions of gratitude, especially during the Thanksgiving holiday.

words.ex: I am thankful for my friend's help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激朋友的帮助。
words.en: If you are thankful for something, you are pleased and grateful for it.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with syphilis last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有梅毒。
words.en: Syphilis is a serious sexually transmitted disease caused by the bacterium Treponema pallidum, which can lead to serious complications if not treated.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.tr:
n. 抛射物；射弹；发射物；自动推进武器
adj. 发射的；射弹的；推进的
words.ex: The boy threw a projectile into the air.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把一个抛射物扔向空中。
words.en: A projectile is an object that is thrown or shot forwards, such as a bullet fired from a gun.

words.tr: v. 计划；“plan”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 计划了的；根据计划的；
words.ex: He planned a trip to the beach last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周计划了一次去海滩的旅行。
words.en: Something that is planned is arranged or prepared in advance.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.tr: v. 叮当作响；打击，撞击（车或头）；执拗地讲，反复地说; n. （非正式）凹痕；（头上）一击；（叮...
words.ex: The cat made a ding sound when it hit the bell.
words.ex_cn: 猫撞到铃铛时发出了‘叮’的一声。
words.en: A short, high-pitched sound, often indicating a notification or alert.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: The children laughed with merriment at the circus.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在马戏团里开心地大笑。
words.en: Merriment is the quality or state of being merry, characterized by joy and laughter.

words.ex: He lives in Washington.
words.ex_cn: 他住在华盛顿。
words.en: Washington refers to the capital city of the United States, the state of Washington in the United States, or George Washington, the first President of the United States.

words.tr: v. 识别；“spot”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有斑点的；有污点的；
words.ex: I spotted a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我认出树上有一只鸟。
words.en: Something that is spotted has a pattern of spots on it.

words.tr: v. 飞翔；飞行；“fly”的现在分词； n. 飞行； adj. 飞行的；迅速的；
words.ex: Birds are flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在天空中飞翔。
words.en: Moving or able to move through the air with wings; happening quickly or for a short time.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: The actual cost was lower than expected.
words.ex_cn: 实际成本比预期的低。
words.en: You use actual to emphasize that you are referring to something real or genuine.

words.tr:
n. 填充填料；填充物；馅儿
v. 塞；填充；“stuff”的现在分词
words.ex: She is making stuffing for the turkey.
words.ex_cn: 她正在为火鸡做填料。
words.en: Stuffing is a mixture of food that is used to fill something else, especially a mixture that is put inside a chicken, turkey, or other bird before it is cooked.

words.ex: I shall go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要去公园。
words.en: used to indicate future action or intention, or to express obligation or necessity

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.ex: He vividly described the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他鲜明地描述了日落。
words.en: In a way that produces powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind.

words.ex: He carved a big pumpkin for Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 他为万圣节雕刻了一个大南瓜。
words.en: A pumpkin is a large, round, orange vegetable with a thick skin.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.tr: v. 记得；回忆起；“remember”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I remembered my mother's birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我妈妈的生日。
words.en: Kept in one's memory; not forgotten.

words.ex: He has hemorrhoids after sitting too long.
words.ex_cn: 他坐得太久后长了痔疮。
words.en: Swollen and inflamed veins in the rectum and anus.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；一小杯液体
v. 合计
words.ex: The tot was playing with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 那个小孩正在玩他的玩具。
words.en: A tot can refer to a very young child or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to add up numbers or amounts to reach a total.

words.ex: He poured sauce on his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他把酱汁倒在意大利面上。
words.en: A sauce is a thick liquid which is served with other food.

words.tr:
n. 叉子；分岔；分支
v. 分岔；用叉子叉
words.ex: He picked up a fork to eat his pasta.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起叉子吃意大利面。
words.en: A fork is a tool used for eating or serving food, consisting of a handle with several narrow tines on one end. It can also refer to a division into two or more branches or directions.

words.tr: n. 越橘；小红莓；蔓越莓；蔓越橘
words.ex: He eats cranberry sauce with turkey at Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 他在感恩节吃火鸡配蔓越莓酱。
words.en: A cranberry is a small, red, acid berry used in cooking.

words.tr: n. <美口>庞大的数字，无法计算的大数字
words.ex: He has a zillion toys in his room.
words.ex_cn: 他房间里有无数的玩具。
words.en: A zillion is a very large number, but it is not a specific number. It is used to emphasize how large a number is.

words.ex: He likes math because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: Math is the study of numbers, quantities, and shapes.

words.ex: He looked through the keyhole to see who was outside.
words.ex_cn: 他通过锁孔往外看，想知道谁在外面。
words.en: A keyhole is the hole in a lock that you put a key in to lock or unlock it.

words.tr: n. 幼儿( tot的名词复数 ); 小杯的酒（尤指烈酒）; 少量酒 v. 合计，共计( tot的第
words.ex: The tots were playing in the sandbox.
words.ex_cn: 幼儿们在沙箱里玩耍。
words.en: Tots are very young children.

words.ex: He peeled a tater for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐削了一个土豆。
words.en: A potato, especially one cooked in its skin.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.ex: She spritzed some perfume on her wrist.
words.ex_cn: 她在手腕上喷了一些香水。
words.en: To spritz means to spray something lightly with a liquid, or a small amount of liquid that is sprayed.

words.tr: v. 放置；安放；下蛋；“lie”的过去式； adj. 外行的；非专业的；
words.ex: He lay the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: To put something down gently or carefully.

words.tr: n. 莱姆关节炎；欧滨麦（植物）
words.ex: Lyme disease is caused by bacteria transmitted through tick bites.
words.ex_cn: 莱姆病是由通过蜱虫叮咬传播的细菌引起的。
words.en: Lyme disease is an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Borrelia burgdorferi and transmitted to humans through the bite of infected black-legged ticks.

words.ex: The roads crosses near the park.
words.ex_cn: 道路在公园附近交叉。
words.en: To go from one side of something to the other; a mark or object formed by two lines crossing each other.

words.tr: n. 视频光盘（Video Disc）的缩写
words.ex: He uses vd to measure video quality.
words.ex_cn: 他使用vd来衡量视频质量。
words.en: A written abbreviation for 'versus', meaning 'against' in a legal or sporting context.

words.tr: n. 音调；语气；强健状况；色调；氛围；
words.ex: His tone sounded angry.
words.ex_cn: 他的音调听起来很生气。
words.en: The tone of a sound is its particular quality. In music, tone refers to the pitch of a note. In art, tone refers to the lightness or darkness of a color. In speech, tone refers to the quality of the voice which expresses the speaker's feelings or intentions.

words.ex: He runs faster than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟快。
words.en: Comparative of fast: moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.tr: v. 伪装; 假装( pretend的第三人称单数 ); （尤指儿童）（在游戏中）装扮; 自诩
words.ex: She pretends to be reading a book to avoid conversation.
words.ex_cn: 她假装在看书，以避免交谈。
words.en: If someone pretends to be something that they are not, they behave in a way that is intended to make people believe that they are that thing, usually in order to deceive someone.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.ex: He wears cologne every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都喷古龙水。
words.en: Cologne is a type of perfume that is not very strong and is often used by men.

words.tr:
n. 砍痕；伤痕；斜线号；削减
v. 砍；大幅度削减
words.ex: The tree has a deep slash on its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干上有一道深深的砍痕。
words.en: To cut something with a sharp object in a violent way; to reduce something by a large amount suddenly.

words.ex: He was officially appointed as the new manager.
