words.ex_cn: 他被正式任命为新经理。
words.en: In a formal or authoritative manner; according to the rules or laws.

words.ex: He put up posters on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他在墙上贴了海报。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.tr: adj. 烤的；有格子的; v. 炙烤（grill 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He ate grilled chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤鸡。
words.en: Cooked by direct exposure to radiant heat, as on a grill.

words.ex: They had a feast on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在元旦举办了一场盛宴。
words.en: A feast is a large and special meal, often to celebrate something.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: She tapped her fingers insistently on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她坚持不懈地用手指敲打着桌子。
words.en: If you say something insistently, you say it firmly and repeatedly, especially because you want to make your point clear.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.tr: n. 钱; 雄鹿( buck的名词复数 ); （英国十九世纪初的）花花公子; （用于某些表达方式）责
words.ex: He paid five bucks for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五美元买这杯咖啡。
words.en: Informal term for dollars or money.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr: v. 忧郁地闲荡；闷闷不乐
words.ex: He spent the whole weekend moping around the house after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他整个周末都在家里闷闷不乐地闲荡。
words.en: To mope means to be gloomily or listlessly idle; to move in a listless or aimless manner, especially from being unhappy or depressed.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.tr: v. 抵制；拒绝购买或参与（boycott 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: They are boycotting the store for unfair prices.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在抵制这家商店，因为它的价格不公平。
words.en: Refuses to buy, use, or participate in something as a protest.

words.ex: He lost his keys and can't get into the house.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了钥匙，进不了家门。
words.en: Keys are small pieces of shaped metal which you insert into a lock and turn in order to lock or unlock something such as a door or a drawer. They can also refer to the buttons on a computer keyboard or the answers to a test or puzzle.

words.tr: n. 山药; 甘薯; 薯蓣( yam的名词复数 ); 白薯
words.ex: He eats yams for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃山药。
words.en: Starchy root vegetable with sweet, orange flesh, commonly boiled or roasted; similar to a sweet potato.

words.tr: v. (非正式) 大吃山芋；胡吃海塞（yam的现在分词形式，yam指山芋）
words.ex: She is yamming loudly in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她正在厨房里大声地闲聊。
words.en: Eats or consumes something greedily or in large quantities.

words.tr: v. （非正式）从事亚马逊Mechanical Turk等平台上的微任务；做众包工作
words.ex: He is turking on a website to earn extra money.
words.ex_cn: 他正在一个网站上做众包任务来赚额外的钱。
words.en: Engages in tedious, repetitive, or menial work, often for low pay.

words.tr: v. 深思熟虑；反复考虑（mull 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is mulling over his job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在仔细考虑他的工作邀请。
words.en: Thinking deeply and at length about something, often with uncertainty.

words.tr: n. （非正式）千（kilo- 的缩写，常用于表示金额或数量，如 50k 表示 50,000）
words.ex: He is late because his bus is stuck in traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为他的公交车堵在路上了。
words.en: KE: Kelvin, the base unit of temperature in the SI system, or an abbreviation for Kenya.

words.ex: He played badly in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中表现得很差。
words.en: If something is done badly or goes badly, it is not successful or effective.

words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕味道很美味。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.tr: v. 打破；打碎；突击搜查
words.ex: The police are busting a drug ring in the city.
words.ex_cn: 警方正在城市中突击搜查一个毒品团伙。
words.en: To break, smash, or raid, especially in a vigorous or aggressive manner.

words.ex: She eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.ex: The fries are crispy and hot.
words.ex_cn: 薯条又脆又热。
words.en: Something that is crispy is pleasantly hard and dry, and makes a sharp sound when you break it or bite it.

words.ex: There are many kinds of apples in the store.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有各种各样的苹果。
words.en: Kinds refer to types or categories of things or people that share common characteristics.

words.tr: n. 跳舞；舞蹈； v. 跳舞；“dance”的现在分词；
words.ex: Dancing is her favorite hobby.
words.ex_cn: 跳舞是她最喜欢的爱好。
words.en: the activity of moving your body in time to music

words.tr: v. 削成碎片；“chip”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The dog chipped the ice with its teeth.
words.ex_cn: 狗用牙齿把冰削成了碎片。
words.en: Having a small piece broken off from the edge or surface.

words.ex: She washed the pots after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚饭后洗了罐子。
words.en: Containers made of various materials, typically round and deep, used for holding liquids or plants.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；烧伤；“burn”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The wood burnt in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 木头在火中燃烧了。
words.en: Damaged or injured by fire or heat.

words.tr: v. 需要； n. 需求；需要；“need”的复数；
words.ex: He needs help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.tr: v. 开始；“start”的现在分词； n. 开始；出发；
words.ex: He is starting his homework now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在开始做作业。
words.en: Starting refers to the act of beginning something, such as a process, activity, or journey.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；烧伤；“burn”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The wood burned in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头在壁炉里燃烧了。
words.en: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that it is burning. If something is burning, it is on fire.

words.tr: adv. 羞怯地；胆怯地；怯懦地
words.ex: He smiled sheepishly after forgetting his lines.
words.ex_cn: 他忘词后尴尬地笑了。
words.en: In a manner that shows embarrassment from shame or a lack of self-confidence.

words.tr:
adj. 令人激情澎湃的；激发感情的；活跃的；忙碌的
n. 酝酿；萌生
v. 搅拌；搅动；激起；“stir”的现在分词
words.ex: The stirring speech made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 那场令人激情澎湃的演讲让所有人都哭了。
words.en: If you describe something as stirring, you mean that it produces strong, positive emotions in people, such as a feeling of excitement or enthusiasm.

words.tr: adj. 即将开始的；新任的；
words.ex: The incoming class will start next week.
words.ex_cn: 即将开始的班级将在下周开课。
words.en: An incoming thing or person is arriving or being received.

words.ex: The children's laughter filled the room.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声充满了房间。
words.en: The sound of people laughing, especially when it is loud and continuous.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.ex: He eats peas with his dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时吃豌豆。
words.en: Peas are small, round, green seeds which are eaten as a vegetable. They are the seeds of a climbing plant.

words.ex: He chopped onions for the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他为汤切了洋葱。
words.en: Onions are round vegetables with a strong smell and flavor, used in cooking.

words.ex: He adds two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.tr:
n. 建模；造型；模特儿职业
v. 做模型；模仿；塑造；“model”的现在分词
words.ex: He is modeling a new bridge with computer software.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用计算机软件模拟一座新桥。
words.en: The act or profession of creating models, especially in fashion, art, or science.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.ex: My birthday is in December.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在十二月。
words.en: December is the twelfth and last month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars and the seventh and last of seven months to have a length of 31 days.

words.tr: v. 庆祝；庆贺； vt. 庆祝（现在进行时 ing形式） v. 庆祝，庆贺( celebrate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are celebrating his birthday with a cake.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在用蛋糕庆祝他的生日。
words.en: Marking a special occasion with enjoyment and festivities.

words.ex: He has asthma and cannot run fast.
words.ex_cn: 他有哮喘，不能跑快。
words.en: A respiratory condition marked by spasms in the bronchi of the lungs, causing difficulty in breathing. It usually results from an allergic reaction or other forms of hypersensitivity.

words.ex: The stewardess served drinks to the passengers.
words.ex_cn: 空乘小姐为乘客提供了饮料。
words.en: A stewardess is a woman whose job is to look after the passengers on a ship or an airplane.

words.tr: adj. 傲慢的；自鸣得意的；带讥讽的
words.ex: He gave a smirky smile when he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛时露出了得意的微笑。
words.en: Characterized by or showing a smug, derisive, or mocking smile.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场安全着陆。
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.ex: Thank you, sir.
words.ex_cn: 谢谢，先生。
words.en: A polite or formal way of addressing a man, especially one whose name you do not know or a man of higher rank or status.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: The tree casts a long shadow at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 夕阳下，树投下长长的影子。
words.en: A shadow is a dark shape on a surface that is made when something stands between a light and the surface.

words.ex: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节吃火鸡。
words.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated primarily in the United States and Canada as a day of giving thanks for the blessing of the harvest and of the preceding year.

words.tr: n. 滑雪（运动）； v. “ski”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves skiing in the mountains during winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在冬天去山上滑雪。
words.en: The activity or sport of moving over snow on skis.

words.ex: He normally goes to bed at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他通常晚上10点睡觉。
words.en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

words.tr: n. 滑雪板（ski 的复数）; v. 滑雪；给……装上滑橇（ski 的第三人称单数）
words.ex: He packed his skis and headed to the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他收拾好滑雪板，前往山区。
words.en: Skis are long, flat devices worn on the feet to travel over snow.

words.ex: His rude words raises anger in everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话引起了每个人的愤怒。
words.en: If you raise something, you move it to a higher position. If you raise the level of something, you increase it. If you raise money, you collect it from people. If you raise a child, you look after it until it is grown up.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.ex: We went to the beach during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假日去了海滩。
words.en: A holiday is a day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

words.tr:
n. 书；账簿；
v. 预订；
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 我睡觉前读了一本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard. Books contain information, stories, or poetry, for example.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.ex: He ate a bagel for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个贝果。
words.en: A bagel is a type of bread that is shaped like a ring and is boiled before it is baked.

words.tr: v. 挑选；采摘； adj. 采摘（pick 的过去式）；
words.ex: He picked the red apple from the basket.
words.ex_cn: 他从篮子里挑了那个红苹果。
words.en: To choose or select something from a group or to remove something from a place where it is attached.

words.ex: He loves paleontology and finds dinosaur bones.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱古生物学，寻找恐龙骨头。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with fossil animals and plants.

words.tr: n. 鱼鳃；鱼鳃（gill 的复数）；
words.ex: Fish use gills to breathe underwater.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用鱼鳃在水中呼吸。
words.en: The gills are the organs on the sides of fish and some amphibians that are used for breathing in water.

words.ex: The fetus is growing inside the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 胎儿正在母亲的子宫内成长。
words.en: An unborn or unhatched offspring of a mammal, in particular an unborn human more than eight weeks after conception.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.tr: adj. 多虱的；可鄙的；差劲的
words.ex: The dog had a lousy coat full of fleas.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的毛发多虱子。
words.en: If you describe something as lousy, you mean that it is of very bad quality or that you do not like it.

words.ex: We buy gifts for Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 我们为圣诞节买礼物。
words.en: Christmas is the period around the 25th of December when Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.tr: adj. 未出世的；未诞生的；未来的；
words.ex: The unborn baby moved gently in the womb.
words.ex_cn: 未出世的婴儿在子宫里轻轻蠕动。
words.en: Not yet born; still to be born.

words.tr:
v. 提供；
n. 提供；提议；报价；
words.ex: He offers help to his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他向同学提供帮助。
words.en: If you offer something to someone, you ask them if they would like to have it or use it.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.ex_cn: 猫靠近窗户。
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.tr: v. 蹲下；蹲伏（crouch 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The cat crouches behind the bush.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹲在灌木丛后面。
words.en: Bends the knees and lowers the body close to the ground.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: The room has acoustical panels to improve sound.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有声学面板来改善声音。
words.en: Relating to the science of sound, including its production, transmission, and effects.

words.tr: v. 吃草；随意翻阅；吃草( browse的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The cows are browsing in the meadow.
words.ex_cn: 牛正在草地上吃草。
words.en: The activity of looking through information or goods, especially on the internet, without a specific purpose or intention.

words.ex: I read three books last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周读了三本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard.

words.ex: He told the funniest joke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上讲了最搞笑的笑话。
words.en: Superlative form of 'funny', meaning the most amusing or humorous.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.tr: v. 借；借来；“borrow”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He borrowed a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 他从图书馆借了一本书。
words.en: Something that is borrowed is taken or received from someone else with the intention of returning it or its equivalent.

words.tr: n. 土豆；马铃薯；“potato”的复数；
words.ex: I bought five potatoes at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上买了五个土豆。
words.en: Potatoes are starchy tubers that grow underground and are widely eaten as a staple food in many parts of the world.

words.tr:
adj. 捣烂的
v. 把...捣成糊状；“mash”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He ate mashed potatoes for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了土豆泥。
words.en: Mashed is used to describe something that has been crushed or beaten into a soft, pulpy mass.

words.ex: She found lumps of sugar in the tea.
words.ex_cn: 她在茶里发现了几块糖。
words.en: A lump is a small, solid piece of something, often without a definite shape.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

words.ex: He didn't refer to the book during the talk.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中没有提到那本书。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them. If you refer to someone or something as a particular thing, you use a particular word, expression, or name to mention or describe them.

words.ex: The faculty of engineering has many labs.
words.ex_cn: 工程学院有许多实验室。
words.en: A faculty is a group of departments in a university or college that specialize in a particular subject or group of subjects, or the teachers in such a group.

words.ex: He won many awards for his science projects.
words.ex_cn: 他因科学项目赢得了许多奖项。
words.en: Prizes or other forms of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.ex: The monkey is eating a banana.
words.ex_cn: 猴子正在吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A monkey is a small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail, most kinds of which live in trees in tropical countries.

words.ex: He eats popcorn at the movie theater.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影院吃爆米花。
words.en: Popcorn is a variety of corn kernel which expands and puffs up when heated.

words.tr: v. 吃；喂；“feed”的现在分词； n. 饲养；给食；
words.ex: The baby is feeding on milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在喝奶。
words.en: The act of giving food to a person or an animal.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: He removes the trash every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都把垃圾拿走。
words.en: To remove something means to take it away or get rid of it.

words.ex: The elf lives in a small tree house.
words.ex_cn: 精灵住在一间小树屋里。
words.en: In folklore, an elf is a type of supernatural being in Germanic mythology and folklore. Elves are often depicted as youthful-seeming men and women of great beauty living in forests and other natural places, underground, or in wells and springs.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.tr: n. 工具；刀具；器具；“tool”的复数；
words.ex: He uses simple tools to fix the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他用简单的工具修理椅子。
words.en: Tools are objects such as hammers, screwdrivers, or saws that you use to help you do a particular type of work.

words.ex: He danced wildly at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上疯狂地跳舞。
words.en: In a very uncontrolled or enthusiastic way.

words.ex: Scientists study the stars and planets.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究恒星和行星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: The children are noisy in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在教室里很吵。
words.en: A noisy place is full of a lot of loud or unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: The max of water the bottle can hold is 500 ml.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子能装的水的最大量是500毫升。
words.en: The greatest quantity or the highest degree attainable or attained.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.tr: n. 线索；领先；领导；领导( lead的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The police found new leads after checking the security camera.
words.ex_cn: 警察在查看监控录像后找到了新的线索。
words.en: To guide or direct in a course; to be in charge or command of.

words.tr: n. 门眼；猫眼（用于窥视门外的装置）
words.ex: He looked through the spyhole to see who was at the door.
words.ex_cn: 他通过猫眼看了看谁在门口。
words.en: A small hole in a door for looking through without being seen.

words.ex: The paper was torn in half.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸被撕成了两半。
words.en: If you are torn between two or more things, you cannot decide which to choose, and so you feel anxious or troubled.

words.tr: adj. 泥泞的；模糊不清的；
words.ex: The road became muddy after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，这条路变得泥泞。
words.en: If something is muddy, it is covered in mud or full of mud. If you muddy something, you make it muddy or you make it less clear or more complicated.

words.tr: adj. (尤指头发或衣服)凌乱的，不整洁的
words.ex: Her hair was dishevelled after the wind blew.
words.ex_cn: 风刮过后，她的头发凌乱不堪。
words.en: Dishevelled means (especially of a person's hair, clothes, or appearance) untidy; disordered.

words.tr:
adj. 青肿的；瘀紫的
v. 挫伤；擦伤；（使）出现伤痕；“bruise”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She had a bruised arm after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后她的手臂青肿了。
words.en: If a part of your body is bruised, it has got a purple or brown mark on it because something has hit it and the blood vessels under the skin have been damaged.

words.tr:
n. 叮当声；广告歌
v. （使）发出叮当声
words.ex: The bells make a happy jingle in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天里，铃铛发出愉快的叮当声。
words.en: A jingle is a short, simple tune, often with words, that is used to advertise a product or service on the radio or television.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了外衣。
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.ex: The bells rang loudly in the church tower.
words.ex_cn: 教堂塔楼里的铃铛响得很响亮。
words.en: Bells are hollow objects made of metal or other hard material, typically in the shape of a deep inverted cup widening at the lip, that sounds a clear musical note when struck, especially by means of a clapper inside.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the whiteboard.
words.ex_cn: 老师在白板上写字。
words.en: A whiteboard is a shiny white board on which people can write or draw with special pens and then wipe off what they have written.

words.ex: He is decorating his new house with paint.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用油漆装修他的新房子。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.ex: She cried until her tears fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 她哭得眼泪掉到了地上。
words.en: Tears are the drops of salty liquid that come out of your eyes when you cry.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.tr: adj. 有微风的；轻松愉快的
words.ex: The park was breezy and full of people enjoying the weather.
words.ex_cn: 公园里微风习习，到处都是享受天气的人们。
words.en: If you describe something as breezy, you mean that it is light, informal, and cheerful.

words.tr: adj. 静止的；不动的；休眠的；
words.ex: The resting lake reflected the sky.
words.ex_cn: 静止的湖面倒映着天空。
words.en: In a state of rest; not active or engaged in activity.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: He walked quietly into the room.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地走进了房间。
words.en: In a manner that does not attract attention; silently or calmly.

words.ex: He explained the problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地解释了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, read, or understand.

words.tr: int. 啊（表示惊奇、喜悦、同意等）；
words.ex: Aah! That’s so beautiful!
words.ex_cn: 啊！这太美了！
words.en: used to express pleasure, satisfaction, surprise, or great joy

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.ex: The children screamed with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因喜悦而尖叫。
words.en: Joy is a feeling of great happiness.

words.tr: v. 猛地咬住；猛地咬住（ snap的过去式和过去分词 ）；
words.ex: The dog snapped at the mailman's leg.
words.ex_cn: 狗猛地咬住了邮递员的腿。
words.en: Broke suddenly and completely, often with a sharp sound; lost control of one's temper or emotions suddenly and violently.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr:
v. 处理；操纵；
n. 把手；柄；
words.ex: He can handle difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理难题。
words.en: To deal with or control a situation or problem.

words.tr: v. 误解；误会；“misunderstand”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He misunderstood her words.
words.ex_cn: 他误解了她的话。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as misunderstood, you mean that people do not understand them and have a wrong impression or idea of them.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.ex: The two countries made a pact to stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家达成了一项停止战斗的协议。
words.en: A pact is a formal agreement between two or more people, organizations, or governments to do a particular thing or to help each other.

words.ex: That guy is a funny dick.
words.ex_cn: 那个家伙是个有趣的家伙。
words.en: A man, especially one who is considered to be clever or resourceful.

words.ex: We wrote the dates on the calendar.
words.ex_cn: 我们把日期写在日历上。
words.en: Particular days of the month or year, often specified for events, meetings, or deadlines.

words.ex: There was a scramble for the last ticket.
words.ex_cn: 大家争相抢购最后一张票。
words.en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you. Scramble can also mean to compete or struggle with others for something that is in short supply.

words.ex: He feels pressures from school and family.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自学校和家庭的压力。
words.en: Pressures refer to the force or influence that is applied to someone or something, often causing stress or forcing them to act in a certain way. It can also denote the physical force exerted on an object by something in contact with it.

words.tr: adj. 不顾一切的；极度渴望的；绝望的；
words.ex: He made a desperate attempt to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾一切地试图救那个孩子。
words.en: If you are desperate, you are in such a bad situation that you are willing to try anything to change it.

words.tr: v. 抓住；抢夺；迅速获得
words.ex: He snatches the ball from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他从朋友手里抢过球。
words.en: To take or grasp something suddenly or quickly, often without permission.

words.ex: He asks questions in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上提问。
words.en: Requests information or expresses a question.

words.ex: He is a geek who loves coding.
words.ex_cn: 他是个热爱编程的极客。
words.en: A geek is someone who is very interested in a particular subject and knows a lot about it, especially a subject that is technical or scientific.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.tr:
v. 嘲笑；嘲弄；
adj. 仿制的；
words.ex: They mock him for his accent.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为他口音而嘲笑他。
words.en: To mock someone means to laugh at them, tease them, or make them look foolish, often by imitating their behavior or speech.

words.tr: v. 教；教导；“teach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My mom taught me how to cook.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈教我做饭。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of teach, which means to impart knowledge or instruct someone in a particular skill or subject.

words.tr: vt. 注视；注意；注视，注意（watch的过去式与过去分词形式）；
words.ex: He watched the bird fly away.
words.ex_cn: 他注视着鸟飞走。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: He enjoys juggling three balls in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里杂耍三个球。
words.en: The act of throwing and catching several objects continuously so that one or more stays in the air, often as a performance; or the act of trying to manage several activities at the same time.

words.tr:
v. 嗖嗖地移动；快速地做；匆匆地干
n. 嗖嗖声；能手
words.ex: The car whizzed past the traffic lights.
words.ex_cn: 汽车嗖嗖地从交通灯旁驶过。
words.en: If you describe someone as a whiz at something, you mean that they are extremely good at it.

words.ex: He showed great enthusiasm for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习英语表现出极大的热情。
words.en: Enthusiasm is a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.tr: interj. 哇（表示惊讶或赞叹）
words.ex: He is wa
words.ex_cn: 他正在wa
words.en: A word used to express hesitation or to introduce a question.

words.ex: She speaks English fluently.
words.ex_cn: v. 她英语说得很流利。
words.en: To say words in order to express thoughts, opinions, or feelings.

words.ex: He shouted loudly to get attention.
words.ex_cn: 他大声喊叫以引起注意。
words.en: In a way that produces or is capable of producing much noise; not quietly.

words.tr:
n. 试验；测验；
v. 试验；测试；
words.ex: The scientist ran a test to see if the drug works.
words.ex_cn: 科学家进行了一次试验，以查看这种药物是否有效。
words.en: A test is a series of questions or problems that is used to measure a person's ability or understanding of something.

words.ex: The game simulates real traffic conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏模拟了真实的交通状况。
words.en: To simulate is to create a model or representation of a situation, process, or system for the purpose of study, analysis, or training. It involves imitating the conditions of a real event or environment to understand its effects or to practice responses to it.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
words.ex_cn: 灰尘微粒漂浮在空气中。
words.en: A particle is a very small piece or amount of something.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.ex: The plants grow well under good conditions.
words.ex_cn: 植物在良好的条件下生长得很好。
words.en: The circumstances or factors affecting the way in which people live or work, especially with regard to their well-being.

words.tr: n. 加速器；促进剂；（汽车）油门
words.ex: Scientists use accelerators to study tiny particles.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用加速器来研究微小粒子。
words.en: Substances or devices that increase the speed or rate of something.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

words.ex: She walked with grace across the stage.
words.ex_cn: 她优雅地走过舞台。
words.en: Grace is the quality of being pleasant, polite, and dignified, or a period of time allowed for something to be done.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.tr: n. 便携式电脑；笔记本电脑；
words.ex: He uses a laptop to work from home.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔记本电脑在家工作。
words.en: A laptop is a computer which is small enough to be carried around easily and is designed for use outside an office.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算机做作业。
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.tr: v. 打扫；扫除；席卷；迅速蔓延
words.ex: The broom sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 扫帚每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean or clear a surface by brushing away dirt or litter; to move swiftly and forcefully.

words.tr: adj. 剩余的；剩下的； v. 依然不变；留下；“remain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The remaining cookies were shared among the children.
words.ex_cn: 剩下的饼干被孩子们分了。
words.en: The part that is still left after other parts have been used, taken away, or destroyed.

words.ex: The frog hopped over the stone.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙跃过了那块石头。
words.en: To move by jumping on one foot or to move quickly and lightly from one place to another.

words.tr: v. 扫；“sweep”的现在分词； adj. 全面的；
words.ex: He sweeping the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上扫地。
words.en: If you describe something as sweeping, you mean it is very extensive or has a very wide effect.

words.ex: I'm sorta tired after the long trip.
words.ex_cn: 长途旅行后我有点累了。
words.en: Sorta is an informal way of saying 'sort of', meaning to some extent or in some way.

words.ex: He is my fella from childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他是我从小的伙伴。
words.en: A fella is a man or boy, especially one who is considered to be ordinary or typical.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: Her performance was phenomenal.
words.ex_cn: 她的表现非常非凡。
words.en: If you describe something as phenomenal, you think it is extremely good or impressive.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: The snowstorm stopped all traffic yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天暴风雪让所有交通都停了。
words.en: A snowstorm is a very heavy fall of snow, usually with strong winds.

words.ex: They threw confetti at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼上撒了彩纸屑。
words.en: Small pieces of colored paper that are traditionally thrown over a bride and groom at a wedding.

words.ex: My grandfather tells stories every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父每天晚上都讲故事。
words.en: The father of one's father or mother.

words.tr:
n. 闪耀；闪烁；小发光物
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）
words.ex: The glitter of the stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星的闪耀照亮了夜空。
words.en: If something glitters, light comes from or is reflected off different parts of it.

words.tr: v. 使惊吓；使大吃一惊
words.ex: The loud noise startles the baby.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了婴儿。
words.en: To cause someone to feel sudden shock or alarm.

words.tr: v. 拍照；（使某物）发出； adv. 猛地咬住( snap的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He was snapping pictures of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他正在拍日落的照片。
words.en: The act of breaking or dividing something suddenly, often with a sharp sound.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: He ate an artichoke for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个洋蓟。
words.en: An artichoke is a type of thistle cultivated as a food. The edible portion of the plant consists of the flower buds before the flowers come into bloom.

words.tr:
v. 拍；掴；拍击
n. 拍；掴；拍击
words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: If you slap someone, you hit them with the palm of your hand.

words.ex: The helpers cleaned the room after the party.
words.ex_cn: 助手们在派对后打扫了房间。
words.en: People who assist or help others in various tasks or activities.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.ex: He is interested in political news.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治新闻感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to the government or public affairs of a country.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.tr:
adj. 愉快的；快乐的
v. 开玩笑；作乐
adv. 非常；很
words.ex: He is jolly at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上很快乐。
words.en: If you describe someone as jolly, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.tr: n. 摇摆；扭动；蠕动（复数形式，指多次轻微的扭动或摇摆）
words.ex: The baby wiggles when she hears music.
words.ex_cn: 当宝宝听到音乐时，她会扭动。
words.en: Moves or twists with short, quick, irregular movements.

words.tr: adj. 更年轻的；更年幼的；“young”的比较级；
words.ex: My younger brother likes to play soccer.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟喜欢踢足球。
words.en: A younger person is someone who is not as old as another person or who is in the earlier part of their life.

words.tr: v. （时间，顺序）排在……后面；按照……执行；跟着；密切注意；从事（职业）；
words.ex: The rain was followed by sunshine.
words.ex_cn: 雨过后是阳光。
words.en: To go or come after or behind someone or something; to act according to an instruction or example.

words.ex: Hannah is playing the piano after school.
words.ex_cn: 汉娜放学后在弹钢琴。
words.en: Hannah is a female given name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'grace' or 'favor'.

words.ex: Daryl is playing guitar in the park.
words.ex_cn: 达里尔正在公园里弹吉他。
words.en: A male given name, of English origin, meaning 'open' or 'clear'.

words.ex: He was born in January.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一月。
words.en: January is the first month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: He lives in Russia.
words.ex_cn: 他住在俄罗斯。
words.en: A country in Eastern Europe and Northern Asia, known for its vast territory and rich history.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr: v. 付费；付酬；“pay”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有报酬的；有偿的；付费的；
words.ex: He paid for the book with cash.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金支付了这本书的费用。
words.en: Having given money in exchange for goods or services.

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: His monthly expenses are too high.
words.ex_cn: 他的月支出太高了。
words.en: Expenses are the costs incurred in the process of doing something or the money spent on something.

words.ex: The doctor advised him to drink more water to help him urinate more frequently.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议他多喝水，以帮助他更频繁地排尿。
words.en: To urinate means to pass urine from the body.

words.tr: n. 英国警察（非正式用语）
words.ex: The bobby stopped the car to check the driver's license.
words.ex_cn: 那位警察拦下汽车检查司机的驾照。
words.en: A bobby is an informal term for a police officer in the UK.

words.ex: Gosh, I forgot my keys again!
words.ex_cn: 天哪，我又忘了带钥匙！
words.en: used to express surprise or emphasis

words.ex: She uses spatulas to flip pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 她用铲子翻煎饼。
words.en: Kitchen utensils with flat, broad blades used for lifting or turning food.

words.ex: The breakup of the team made everyone sad.
words.ex_cn: 团队的分裂让每个人都很难过。
words.en: The end of a relationship, partnership, or association.

words.ex: He sung a song for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲唱了一首歌。
words.en: The past participle of 'sing', which means to make musical sounds with the voice.

words.tr: n. 颤抖；颤抖的动作（shake 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: His hands showed shakes after the long run.
words.ex_cn: 他长跑后双手出现了颤抖。
words.en: Drinks made by mixing ingredients, often with a shaker.

words.ex: The book has a short introduction at the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 这本书开头有一段简短的引言。
words.en: The act of presenting something new to someone or something, or the process of making something known or familiar to people.

words.ex: The bell rang at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 铃在早上八点响了。
words.en: A bell is a device that makes a ringing sound and is used to give a signal or to attract attention.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.tr: adj. 膨胀的；肿胀的； v. “bloat”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The dog looked bloated after eating too much food.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗吃太多食物后看起来肚子膨胀。
words.en: If someone is bloated, they are swollen and round because they have eaten too much or are suffering from a medical condition.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He is methodical in organizing his work.
words.ex_cn: 他在安排工作时很有条理。
words.en: If you describe someone as methodical, you mean that they do things carefully, thoroughly, and in order.

words.ex: Farmers hops the hops in early autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民在初秋采摘葎草花。
words.en: Hops are the flowers of the hop plant Humulus lupulus. They are used primarily as a bittering, flavouring, and stability agent in beer, to which they impart a bitter, tangy flavour, though hops are also used for various purposes in other beverages and herbal medicine.

words.ex: The officer gave a clear order to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 军官向士兵下达了明确的命令。
words.en: An officer is a person in a position of authority in the armed forces, the police, or a government organization.

words.tr: n. 绅士；先生；有教养的人
words.ex: The gentleman smiled and held the door open.
words.ex_cn: 那位绅士微笑着为别人扶着门。
words.en: A gentleman is a man who is polite and well-educated, who has excellent manners and always behaves well.

words.ex: He is tearing the paper into pieces.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把纸撕成碎片。
words.en: Tearing refers to the act of pulling something apart or into pieces, often with force, or it can describe moving very quickly.

words.ex: The sweeper cleans the streets every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工每天早上清扫街道。
words.en: A sweeper is a person or device that cleans by sweeping.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.tr: adj. 失望的；沮丧的； v. “disappoint”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was disappointed when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格时感到很失望。
words.en: If you are disappointed, you are sad because something has not happened or because something is not as good as you had hoped.

words.tr: v. 整理; 使整洁( tidy的现在分词 ); 使整齐; 使有条理
words.ex: He is tidying his room every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在整理房间。
words.en: The process of making a room or area neat and orderly by arranging things properly.

words.tr: n. 手臂；武器；兵器；“arm”的复数；
words.ex: He raised his arms to wave at the plane.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂向飞机挥手。
words.en: Weapons, especially as used by the military.

words.ex: He felt so sad that he thought about suicide.
words.ex_cn: 他感到非常难过，以至于想到了自杀。
words.en: Suicide is the act of deliberately killing oneself.

words.ex: She loves to listen to old songs.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢听老歌。
words.en: A song is a short piece of music with words that are sung.

words.ex: The children built a snowman in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在院子里堆了一个雪人。
words.en: A snowman is a large shape which is made out of snow, especially by children, and is supposed to look like a person.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.ex: She greeted us with a cheery smile.
words.ex_cn: 她用愉快的微笑迎接我们。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as cheery, you mean that they are cheerful and happy.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.ex: This apple is sweeter than that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果比那个更甜。
words.en: Comparative form of 'sweet'; more pleasant, delightful, or charming.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；精明的；精明的(smart的比较级)；
words.ex: He is smarter than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他哥哥更聪明。
words.en: Having or showing a quick-witted intelligence.

words.tr: n. 时刻；机会( occasion的名词复数 )；
words.ex: We meet on special occasions.
words.ex_cn: 我们在特殊时刻见面。
words.en: Specific times or events suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The gentler wind made the trees sway softly.
words.ex_cn: 更温和的风让树木轻轻摇摆。
words.en: comparative form of gentle; more gentle in manner or character.

words.ex: He drank coffee from a large mug.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个大杯子里喝咖啡。
words.en: A mug is a large, deep cup with straight sides and a handle, used for hot drinks. It can also refer to someone's face or a foolish person. As a verb, it means to attack and rob someone violently in a public place.

words.ex: The rain brings cool air.
words.ex_cn: 雨带来了凉爽的空气。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.ex: He sips tea slowly every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢慢喝茶。
words.en: To drink something by taking small amounts into your mouth.

words.tr: n. 一瞥；扫视；匆匆一看
words.ex: He glances at the clock every few minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔几分钟就看一眼钟。
words.en: A glance is a quick look at something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.tr: v. 断裂；破裂；“crack”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有裂纹的；
words.ex: The glass cracked when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃掉到地上时裂开了。
words.en: If something is cracked, it has lines on its surface because it is damaged.

words.tr:
v. 抗议；
n. 抗议活动；
words.ex: The students protest against the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生们抗议新的校规。
words.en: A protest is the act of saying or showing publicly that you object to something.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.ex: Can you pass me that thingy on the table?
words.ex_cn: 你能把桌上那个小东西递给我吗？
words.en: A thingy is a small object or device whose name you do not know or cannot remember.

words.tr: v. 处理，解决；擒抱（橄榄球）
words.ex: He tackles every problem with care.
words.ex_cn: 他认真对待每一个问题。
words.en: To tackle means to deal with a problem or task, or in sports, to stop an opponent by grabbing them.

words.tr: n. 小笔记本；钱夹；袖珍本；财力
words.ex: He wrote the phone number in his pocketbook.
words.ex_cn: 他把电话号码写在了他的小笔记本里。
words.en: A pocketbook is a small book, especially one that can be carried in a pocket, or a woman's handbag.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.tr: n. （由条石砌成的）路缘；道牙；马路牙子
words.ex: The car hit the kerb and damaged the wheel.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞上了路缘，损坏了车轮。
words.en: The raised edge of a pavement or path, especially that bordering a road.

words.ex: There was a dip in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额有所下降。
words.en: To dip something means to put it into a liquid and then take it out again.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.tr: n. 出租车（cab 的复数形式）
words.ex: The tourists took cabs to the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 游客们坐出租车去了酒店。
words.en: Taxis for hire.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早到达了机场。
words.en: An airport is a place where aircraft regularly take off and land, with buildings for passengers to wait in.

words.ex: This necklace is precious to her.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链对她来说很珍贵。
words.en: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

words.tr:
adj. 第六的；六分之一的；
n. 第六；六分之一；
words.ex: He lives on the sixth floor.
words.ex_cn: 他住在第六层。
words.en: The sixth item in a series is the one that you count as number six.

words.tr: v. (kiss 的过去式和过去分词) 吻；亲吻
words.ex: He kissed her on the cheek.
words.ex_cn: 他亲了她的脸颊。
words.en: Past tense of 'kiss'; to have touched with the lips as a sign of affection.

words.ex: He gave the rope a sudden jerk to pull it up.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地一拉绳子，把它拉了上来。
words.en: If you jerk something or someone in a particular direction, or they jerk in a particular direction, they move a short distance very suddenly and quickly.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: The cat is catching a mouse.
words.ex_cn: 猫正在捉一只老鼠。
words.en: If an illness or a disease is catching, it can be passed from one person to another through touch or through the air. If a mood or an idea is catching, it spreads quickly from one person to another.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.tr: v. 打电话；“phone”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is phoning his mother now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在给妈妈打电话。
words.en: The act of making a telephone call.

words.tr: n. 跳蚤（flea 的复数形式）
words.ex: The dog has fleas on its fur.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的毛上有跳蚤。
words.en: Small, wingless, jumping insects that feed on the blood of mammals and birds.

words.ex: The baby needs clean diapers every few hours.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝每隔几个小时就需要干净的尿布。
words.en: A diaper is a piece of cloth or other absorbent material wrapped around a baby's bottom and between its legs to absorb and retain urine and feces.

words.ex: He often wanders around the city without any purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他经常毫无目的地在城市里闲逛。
words.en: To walk or move in a leisurely or aimless way; to move slowly away from a fixed point or place.

words.tr: n. 圣诞老人 (also Santa Claus)
words.ex: Santa brings gifts on Christmas Eve.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞老人在平安夜送礼物。
words.en: Santa Claus, or simply Santa, is a legendary figure originating in Western Christian culture who is said to bring gifts to the homes of well-behaved children on the night of Christmas Eve or during the early morning hours of Christmas Day.

words.ex: He threw the ball to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把球扔给了他的朋友。
words.en: To propel something with force through the air by a movement of the arm and hand.

words.tr: n. [生理]粪便；[生理]排泄物；糟粕（等于 feces）
words.ex: The dog left faeces on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上留下了粪便。
words.en: Waste matter discharged from the bowels after food has been digested; excrement.

words.tr: v. 营救，救援，使免遭损失( rescue的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: The firefighters rescued the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 消防员把猫从树上救了下来。
words.en: If you rescue someone, you save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.tr: n. 伯特利（圣经中的地名，意为“神的家”）
words.ex: Bethel is a small town in Alaska.
words.ex_cn: 贝塞尔是阿拉斯加的一个小镇。
words.en: A place of worship or religious retreat, especially in a biblical context.

words.ex: He is learning Sanskrit from an old teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向一位老教师学习梵语。
words.en: Sanskrit is an ancient Indo-Aryan language that is the classical language of India and of Hinduism.

words.tr: v. 拖拽；缓慢而费力地移动；
words.ex: He was dragging the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something or someone along with effort, often because they are heavy or because there is resistance.

words.tr:
n. 喜爱；赞同；
v. 赞成；偏爱；有利于；
words.ex: He has a favour for chocolate ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他特别喜欢巧克力冰淇淋。
words.en: If you regard something or someone with favour, you like or support them.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.tr: n. 泰河（苏格兰的一条河流）
words.ex: Tay is playing soccer with friends.
words.ex_cn: 泰伊正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A river in Scotland or a common surname.

words.ex: They are equals in skill; there is no par between them.
words.ex_cn: 他们在技能上是平等的；他们之间没有高低之分。
words.en: Par refers to the standard or average condition or degree, or the face value of a stock or bond.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.ex: He enjoys mingling at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在派对上与人交往。
words.en: To mix or combine, or to move around and talk to people at a social event.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.tr: n. 一种波浪形的发型；
words.ex: She got a marcel to look stylish at the party.
words.ex_cn: 她做了个波浪形发型，以便在派对上看起来时尚。
words.en: A marcel is a hairstyle characterized by deep, soft waves, typically created using a heated curling iron.

words.ex: The beach has sandy soil.
words.ex_cn: 这个海滩有含沙的土壤。
words.en: Covered with or consisting mostly of sand.

words.tr: adj. 已脱掉衣物的，裸露的 v. 脱衣服( undress的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: He was undressed when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响的时候，他没穿衣服。
words.en: If you are undressed, you are wearing no clothes or are wearing your night clothes. If something is undressed, it is not treated or prepared in any way.

words.tr: adv. 精神上；思想上；智力上；
words.ex: He is mentally strong despite his challenges.
words.ex_cn: 尽管面临挑战，他在精神上很坚强。
words.en: In a manner relating to the mind or mental processes.

words.tr: adj. 慌张的；不知所措的；紧张的； v. “fluster”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He got flustered when the teacher called on him.
words.ex_cn: 当老师点名让他回答时，他慌张了。
words.en: If you are flustered, you are agitated, confused, or nervous.

words.tr: v. 定居；安顿；解决；“settle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 定居的；稳定的；
words.ex: They settled in Canada last year.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年在加拿大定居了。
words.en: If you feel settled, you have become used to your new home, job, or situation, and you feel comfortable and happy about it.

words.tr: v. 加锁；“lock”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He locked the door before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前锁了门。
words.en: If something is locked, it is fastened or secured with a lock, or is in a position where it cannot be moved or opened.

words.tr: v. 舔；轻拍；快速移动（第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The dog licks its paw after eating.
words.ex_cn: 狗吃完后舔它的爪子。
words.en: Passes the tongue over something in a quick, light motion.

words.ex: The farm feeds the village with fresh milk.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场为村庄提供新鲜牛奶。
words.en: To give food to a person or an animal; to supply something to a machine or a system.

words.tr: n. 铸锭列车，锭模列车 v. 拖; （使…）在地上拖拉，慢吞吞地走，磨蹭( drag的第三人称单数
words.ex: He drags his feet when he walks.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时拖着脚。
words.en: To pull something along with effort or difficulty, especially along the ground.

words.tr: v. （使）留痕迹；做标记；评分；“mark”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 明显的；显著的；有记号的；
words.ex: The storm marked the old tree with deep scratches.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在那棵老树上留下了深深的划痕。
words.en: A marked change or difference is very obvious and easily noticed.

words.tr: v. 出现( emerge的第三人称单数 ); 露头; 形成; 事实
words.ex: A bird emerges from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树里飞出来。
words.en: If something emerges, it comes out from somewhere or comes into view.

words.tr:
adj. 偷偷摸摸的；暗中的
v. 溜；偷偷地做；“sneak”的现在分词
words.ex: She had a sneaking suspicion that he was lying.
words.ex_cn: 她有一种偷偷的怀疑，认为他在撒谎。
words.en: If you have a sneaking feeling about something, you have a slight suspicion or awareness of it, often without being able to explain why.

words.ex: He was knocking on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正在敲门。
words.en: The sound of someone hitting something, such as a door or window, with their knuckles or a hard object.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr:
adj. 受惊吓的
v. 使惊动；使惊愕；使吃惊；“startle”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was startled by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被巨大的噪音吓了一跳。
words.en: If something startles you, it surprises and frightens you slightly.

words.tr: n. 冲洗；脸红；v. 冲洗；使脸红
words.ex: The plumber is flushing the pipes to clean them.
words.ex_cn: n. 管道工正在冲洗管道以清洁它们。
words.en: 1. To cleanse or rinse with a liquid, especially water. 2. To become red in the face, typically as a result of embarrassment or heat.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.tr: n. 刮胡须； v. “shave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He does his shaving every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡须。
words.en: The act of removing hair from the face or body using a razor.

words.tr: n. 编织； v. “knit”的现在分词；
words.ex: She loves knitting sweaters for her family.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢为家人编织毛衣。
words.en: Knitting is the action or process of making garments or fabric by interlocking loops of wool or other yarn with knitting needles or on a machine.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr: v. 闲聊；闲谈； n. 聊天( chat的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are chatting about their weekend plans.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在闲聊关于周末的计划。
words.en: The act of talking in an informal and friendly way.

words.ex: She ate delicious Mexican food at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 她在餐厅吃了美味的墨西哥食物。
words.en: Relating to Mexico or its people.

words.ex: He bought a magazine at the newsstand.
words.ex_cn: 他在报摊上买了一本杂志。
words.en: A newsstand is a place where newspapers and magazines are sold, often located on the street or in a public area.

words.tr: n. 写作；文章； v. 写作；“write”的现在分词；
words.ex: His writing is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的写作清晰简洁。
words.en: The activity or skill of marking coherent words on paper and composing text.

words.tr: v. 访问；参观；“visit”的现在分词； adj. 客座的；
words.ex: He is visiting his grandmother every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末都去看望他的奶奶。
words.en: Visiting is the present participle of visit, which means to go to see someone or something in a particular place.

words.ex: The children played with colorful balloons at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上玩彩色气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.tr: n. 蒙太奇；画面剪辑；合成画；大杂烩
words.ex: The movie ends with a montage of old photos.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影以一组旧照片的蒙太奇结尾。
words.en: A montage is a technique in film editing in which a series of short shots are edited into a sequence to condense space, time, and information.

words.ex: He changed his job because of his background.
words.ex_cn: 他因为自己的背景换了工作。
words.en: The background is the situation that exists at a particular time, or the situation in which something happens, which helps to explain it.

words.tr: v. 喝；喝酒；“drink”的过去分词； adj. 喝醉的；
words.ex: He has drunk all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了所有的水。
words.en: If someone is drunk, they have consumed so much alcohol that it has affected their ability to think and speak clearly.

words.tr: n. 脑电波；大脑活动产生的电波
words.ex: The machine detects brainwaves when you sleep.
words.ex_cn: 当您睡觉时，这台机器会检测脑电波。
words.en: Electrical impulses in the brain, often measured to study brain activity.

words.ex: The flames lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 火焰照亮了夜空。
words.en: Flames refer to the visible, gaseous part of a fire. It can also mean to burn brightly or to show strong emotion.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr: n. 腹股沟；防波堤；折流坝
words.ex: He felt pain in his groin after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后感到腹股沟疼痛。
words.en: The groin is the area where the abdomen meets the thigh on either side of the body; also refers to an architectural element formed by the intersection of two vaults.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: He shuts the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: To close something, especially a door, window, or lid.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.

words.ex: He is busy with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: If you are busy, you are working hard or giving your attention to a particular activity.

words.tr:
adj. 喜气洋洋的；愉快的；耀眼的
v. 照耀；“beam”的现在分词
words.ex: She is beaming with joy after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 她赢得奖品后满脸喜悦。
words.en: If someone is beaming, they have a big smile on their face because they are happy, pleased, or proud about something.

words.ex: He has a sore tonsil.
words.ex_cn: 他的扁桃体发炎了。
words.en: Either of the two small, round pieces of tissue at the back of the throat that help to protect against infection.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.tr: n. 妈妈们（mom的复数形式）
words.ex: Moms love their children very much.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈们非常爱他们的孩子。
words.en: The plural form of 'mom', referring to multiple mothers.

words.ex: He is a kisser who loves to hug and kiss his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢拥抱和亲吻朋友的接吻的人。
words.en: Someone who kisses or the lips.

words.tr: v. 通过；递给；“pass”的现在分词； n. 流逝；通过； adj. 经过的；短暂的；过往的；
words.ex: He is passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他正在通过考试。
words.en: Going past or moving from one place to another; the act of passing something.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.tr:
adj. 弗洛伊德的
n. 弗洛伊德学的信奉者
words.ex: The psychologist used a Freudian approach to analyze the patient's dreams.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家使用佛洛伊德学派的方法来分析病人的梦境。
words.en: Relating to or influenced by Sigmund Freud or his methods of psychoanalysis.

words.tr:
n. 粪便；废话；质量差的东西
v. 排便
words.ex: The dog left crap on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上拉了粪便。
words.en: If you describe something as crap, you think that it is of very poor quality.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.tr: v. 砰地关上；猛地一动；抨击
words.ex: He slammed the door angrily.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地把门砰地关上。
words.en: If you slam a door or window, or if it slams, it shuts noisily and with great force.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.tr:
n. 草图；素描；概述
v. 草拟；速写；简述
words.ex: He made a quick sketch of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他快速画出了房子的草图。
words.en: A sketch is a simple, quickly-made drawing that does not have many details. It can also mean a short description or account of something.

words.ex: He etches a design on the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他在玻璃上刻了一个图案。
words.en: To etch means to cut into a surface, especially metal or glass, using acid or a sharp tool, in order to create a design or pattern.

words.tr: adj. 眩晕的; 糊里糊涂的; <非正>头昏眼花的; 轻度恶心的
words.ex: After a night of heavy drinking, he woke up feeling woozy.
words.ex_cn: 经过一夜的酗酒，他醒来时感觉头昏眼花。
words.en: If you feel woozy, you feel slightly weak, sick, or unsteady, often because you are very tired or have drunk too much alcohol.

words.ex: He lives in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦。
words.en: London is the capital city of England and the United Kingdom, known for its history, culture, and financial services.

words.tr: vt. 逮捕；拘留；阻止；“arrest”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被捕的；被拘留的；
words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest someone, they take them away to ask them about a crime that they might have committed.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: Tyler is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 泰勒正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A male given name of English origin, meaning 'tile maker' or 'roof tiler'.

words.ex: Nora is walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 诺拉正走路去学校。
words.en: A female given name of Latin origin, meaning 'honour'.

words.tr: n. 一种平纹织物；经纱加捻的织物
words.ex: He is a leno man who always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是微笑的 leno 男子。
words.en: A type of talk show format where guests are interviewed on a sofa.

words.ex: The jay flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 松鸦飞过了树。
words.en: A jay is a noisy bird with brightly colored feathers, known for its loud calls and chatter.

words.tr: adv. 以某种方式；不知何故；
words.ex: Somehow, he finished the race despite the injury.
words.ex_cn: 不知怎么的，他尽管受伤了还是完成了比赛。
words.en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

words.tr:
n. 击败对手的一击；引人注目的人或物
adj. 击倒的；淘汰制的；引人注目的；迷人的
words.ex: He won the match with a knockout in the first round.
words.ex_cn: 他在第一回合以击倒获胜。
words.en: A knockout is a situation in boxing where one fighter is knocked down and unable to get up before the referee counts to ten, resulting in the other fighter winning the match. It can also refer to something that is extremely attractive or impressive.

words.ex: The upside of working late is more money.
words.ex_cn: 加班的好处是能赚更多钱。
words.en: The upside is the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad.

words.tr: v. 忘记；遗忘；“forget”的过去式；
words.ex: I forgot my keys at home.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙忘在家里了。
words.en: If you forget something, you do not remember it.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.ex: He is a handsome boy.
words.ex_cn: 他是个英俊的男孩。
words.en: A handsome man is good-looking, usually in a way that is attractive to women. Something that is handsome is large in quantity or impressive in quality.

words.ex: The soldiers returned with gloria after winning the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在赢得战斗后带着荣耀归来。
words.en: n. High renown or honor won by notable achievements.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.tr:
n. 炸弹
v. 投弹于；轰炸
words.ex: The bomb exploded at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在中午爆炸了。
words.en: A bomb is a device which explodes and damages or destroys a large area.

words.ex: He wears a jockstrap while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他踢足球时穿着护裆。
words.en: A jockstrap is a piece of clothing worn by men to support their genitals during sports or other physical activity.

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.tr: n. 网球拍；喧闹；非法勾当；
words.ex: He bought a new racket for tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一副新的网球拍。
words.en: A racket is a piece of equipment used in sports such as tennis or badminton, consisting of a handle and a round or oval frame with a network of strings stretched across it. It can also refer to a loud, unpleasant noise or a dishonest or fraudulent scheme.

words.ex: My sisters play soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的姐妹们每个周末都踢足球。
words.en: Sisters are female siblings or members of a religious community of women.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 她通常走路去学校。
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: The team acted in unison to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 团队一致行动赢得了比赛。
words.en: If two or more people do something in unison, they do it together at the same time.

words.tr:
adj. 未做的；已解开的
v. 解开；撤销；毁掉；“undo”的过去分词
words.ex: His homework is undone.
words.ex_cn: 他的作业还没做。
words.en: If something is undone, it has not been finished or has not been done.

words.ex: Karen is talking on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 凯伦正在打电话。
words.en: A colloquial term for an entitled, often confrontational woman, typically perceived as demanding or unreasonable.

words.tr: v. 求爱；求婚；寻求支持
words.ex: He tried to woo her with flowers and chocolates.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和巧克力追求她。
words.en: If you woo someone, you try to persuade them to marry you or to have a relationship with you, or you try to gain their support or favor.

words.ex: He hired a massager to relax his sore muscles.
words.ex_cn: 他雇了一位按摩师来放松他酸痛的肌肉。
words.en: A person or device that massages, or a person who gives massages.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.ex: The teams worked together to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这些团队合作赢得了比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who work together on a particular task or project.

words.ex: He loves playing sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: Sports are physical activities or games, often competitive and organized, that involve skill and physical exertion.

words.ex: The reduction in cost helped the company save money.
words.ex_cn: 成本的减少帮助公司节省了资金。
words.en: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc., or the result of this.

words.ex: The bus fares are too high this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年公交车费太高了。
words.en: The money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi. Also, to get along in a specified way.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.tr: v. 辩论；辩论( debate的现在分词 )；
words.ex: They are debating about the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在辩论新法律。
words.en: to discuss a subject formally in a public meeting or in a parliament, especially in order to reach a decision

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.ex: He gave her a red heart on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送给她一颗红心。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps blood around your body. It is also used to refer to the central or most important part of something, or to the feelings and emotions of a person.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: She teaches math to young students.
words.ex_cn: 她教小孩子数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: He enjoys sculpting clay into animals.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢把黏土塑造成动物。
words.en: The art of shaping figures or designs in the round or in relief, as by chiseling marble, modeling clay, or casting in metal.

words.tr: abbr. 战俘；“prisoner of war”的缩写
words.ex: The POWs were released after the war ended.
words.ex_cn: 战俘们在战争结束后被释放。
words.en: used to represent the sound of an explosion or gunshot

words.tr: n. 渴望；热望；强烈的愿望； v. “crave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He has a craving for chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望吃巧克力。
words.en: A craving is a very strong desire for something.

words.ex: I occasionally walk my dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我偶尔在公园遛狗。
words.en: If something happens occasionally, it happens sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.tr: adj. 令人尴尬的；令人为难的； v. “embarrass”的现在分词；
words.ex: It was embarrassing when I tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 我在大家面前绊倒了，很尴尬。
words.en: Something that is embarrassing makes you feel shy or ashamed.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.ex: He bought condoms at the pharmacy.
words.ex_cn: 他在药店买了避孕套。
words.en: Sheaths used during sexual intercourse to prevent pregnancy or disease.

words.ex: He is a good son to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他是父母的好儿子。
words.en: A son is a male child in relation to his parents.

words.tr: n. 字母K的另一种拼写
