words.ex: He eats rice with chopsticks.
words.ex_cn: 他用筷子吃米饭。
words.en: Chopsticks are a pair of thin sticks which are used to eat food, especially in East Asia.

words.tr:
n. 轻拍；
v. 轻拍；
words.ex: He gave the dog a gentle pat on the head.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻拍了拍狗的头。
words.en: To gently touch someone or something with your hand flat.

words.tr: n. 眉毛( eyebrow的名词复数 )
words.ex: He raised his eyebrows when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息时抬起了眉毛。
words.en: The strip of hair growing above the eye on the forehead.

words.tr: adv. 充满深情地；亲切地
words.ex: She smiled affectionately at her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她亲切地对弟弟笑了笑。
words.en: In a way that displays fondness or tenderness.

words.tr: adj. 缠结的； v. “tangle”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The hair was tangled after the wind.
words.ex_cn: 头发被风吹得打结了。
words.en: If something is tangled, it is twisted together untidily and is difficult to unravel or separate.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr: n. 羊毛衫；开襟羊毛衫
words.ex: He wears a blue cardigan in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件蓝色开衫。
words.en: A cardigan is a type of knitted garment that has an open front, typically with buttons, and is worn over other clothes.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: She was wearing a variety of colorful scarves.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着各种颜色的围巾。
words.en: Lightweight, often decorative neckwear made from fabric like silk or wool.

words.ex: The main reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The most important part or aspect of something.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He has schizophrenia and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有精神分裂症，每天吃药。
words.en: A long-term mental disorder of a type involving a breakdown in the relation between thought, emotion, and behavior, leading to faulty perception, inappropriate actions and feelings, withdrawal from reality and personal relationships into fantasy and delusion, and a sense of mental fragmentation.

words.ex: Ursula loves to swim in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 乌苏拉喜欢在海洋里游泳。
words.en: A female given name of Latin origin, meaning 'little bear'.

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.tr: adj. 无法仿效的；不可比拟的
words.ex: Her inimitable style of writing has captured the hearts of many readers.
words.ex_cn: 她那独特的写作风格赢得了许多读者的心。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inimitable, you mean that they are so good or unusual that it is unlikely that anyone or anything else could be like them.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.tr: v. 旋转；纺纱；眩晕 n. 旋转；疾驰
words.ex: The dancer spins on one foot.
words.ex_cn: 舞者用一只脚旋转。
words.en: To turn or cause to turn rapidly around an axis; to draw out and twist fibers to form yarn or thread.

words.tr:
n. 状态；州；国家；
v. 陈述；说明；
adj. 国事礼仪（或规格）的；州的；
words.ex: The state of the car is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的状态非常差。
words.en: A state is a condition or way of being that something or someone is in. It can also refer to a nation or territory considered as an organized political community under one government.

words.ex: He has a slight cold.
words.ex_cn: 他有点轻微的感冒。
words.en: A slight change, difference, or action is not very great or important.

words.tr: adj. 冬天的；寒冷的；冷淡的
words.ex: The landscape was covered in a wintry blanket of snow.
words.ex_cn: 大地被一层冬日的雪毯覆盖。
words.en: Wintry weather is cold and has features that are typical of winter.

words.ex: The streets are busy with cars and people.
words.ex_cn: 街道上汽车和行人很多。
words.en: The streets refer to public roads in a city, town, or village, typically with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.ex: The snowplows cleared the roads after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雪犁在风暴后清除了道路。
words.en: Large vehicles with rotating blades or scoops used for clearing snow from roads and paths.

words.ex: My birthday is in February.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在二月。
words.en: February is the second month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.tr: v. 清除；“clear”的现在分词； n. 空旷地；
words.ex: They are clearing the leaves from the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在清除院子里的树叶。
words.en: A clearing is an open area in a forest where there are no trees or bushes.

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.ex: Douglas is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
words.ex_cn: 道格拉斯是英语国家中常见的名字。
words.en: Douglas is a male given name of Scottish origin, meaning 'dark river' or 'black stream'.

words.tr:
n. 视频；录像；
adj. 视频的；录像的；
words.ex: I watched a short video on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我看了一个YouTube上的短视频。
words.en: A recording of moving visual images made digitally or on videotape.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: She practiced her stepping for the dance competition.
words.ex_cn: 她为舞蹈比赛练习她的步伐。
words.en: The act of taking a step or steps; the manner in which one steps.

words.tr: v. 压碎；挤压；压制（squash 的现在分词）
words.ex: He is squashing the bug in the code.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修复代码中的错误。
words.en: Crushing or flattening something with weight or pressure, often with a squelching sound.

words.ex: He performs the task every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天执行这项任务。
words.en: To carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function; to present a form of entertainment such as a play, concert, or dance.

words.tr: n. 学习；学问； v. 学习；“learn”的现在分词；
words.ex: Learning takes time and practice.
words.ex_cn: 学习需要时间和练习。
words.en: The acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr:
n. 尿布
v. 用尿布衬上
words.ex: The baby needs a clean diaper.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝需要一块干净的尿布。
words.en: A diaper is a piece of soft cloth or paper which is fastened around a baby's bottom in order to absorb its waste.

words.tr: v. (羊) 叫；鸣叫；n. 羊的叫声
words.ex: The sheep bleats loudly in the field.
words.ex_cn: 羊在田野里大声咩咩叫。
words.en: Makes a characteristic bleating sound, like that of a sheep or goat.

words.tr: n. <美>外卖餐馆，外卖食品; （桥牌中）示意搭档改叫的叫牌 adj. 外卖的，供顾客带出外吃的
words.ex: I ordered pizza takeout for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我订了外卖披萨当晚餐。
words.en: Takeout refers to food that is prepared in a restaurant and is intended to be eaten elsewhere.

words.ex: He watches a sitcom every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看一部情景喜剧。
words.en: A sitcom is a genre of comedy centered on a fixed set of characters who carry over from episode to episode. Sitcoms usually take place in a common environment such as a home or workplace.

words.tr: adj. 区分的，分划的 v. 划分; 分( divide的现在分词 ); 分离; （使）产生分歧
words.ex: He is dividing the apples among his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把苹果分给他的朋友们。
words.en: To separate something into parts or sections, or to cause something to be separate.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.tr: adj. 蜿蜒的； v. “wind”的现在分词；
words.ex: The winding road goes through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条蜿蜒的道路穿过山脉。
words.en: A winding path, road, river, etc. repeatedly turns in different directions.

words.ex: The farm is supplying fresh milk to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场正在向城市供应新鲜牛奶。
words.en: To provide something that is needed or wanted, often in large quantities and over a long period of time.

words.tr: n. 一束（线或纱）；一群（飞行中的鸟）
words.ex: She pulled a skein of yarn from the basket.
words.ex_cn: 她从篮子里拉出一缕毛线。
words.en: A skein is a length of thread or yarn, loosely coiled and knotted, or a group of wild fowl in flight.

words.tr:
adj. 附近的；
adv. 在附近；
words.ex: There is a park nearby my house.
words.ex_cn: 我家附近有一个公园。
words.en: If something is nearby, it is only a short distance away.

words.tr:
adj. 手工的；体力的；
n. 说明书；
words.ex: He made a manual copy of the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他手工抄写了一封信。
words.en: A manual is a book which tells you how to do something or how a piece of machinery works.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.ex: She carefully wrote down the instructions.
words.ex_cn: 她仔细地记下了说明。
words.en: In a way that gives a lot of attention to what you are doing so that you do not have an accident, make a mistake, or damage something.

words.tr: n. 三人一组；三个一组；三重唱；三重奏；
words.ex: The trio sang a beautiful song together.
words.ex_cn: 这三人一组一起唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A trio is a group of three people who are performing together, especially in music.

words.tr: pron. 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己；
words.ex: The children cleaned the room themselves.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a group of people or things previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.

words.ex: The teacher helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person whose job is to teach in a school or college.

words.tr:
pron. 几个；一些；
adj. 不同的；
words.ex: I have several books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上放着几本书。
words.en: Several means a number of people or things that is more than a few but not a lot.

words.ex: Couples walk hand in hand in the park.
words.ex_cn: 情侣们在公园里手牵手散步。
words.en: Couples refers to two people who are married or in a romantic relationship together.

words.tr:
n. 烤肉；烘烤；
adj. 烤的；焙的；
v. 烤；烘烤；
words.ex: We had roast for dinner last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚我们吃了烤肉。
words.en: To cook food, such as meat, in an oven or over a fire.

words.ex: He sneezed and air came out of his nostril.
words.ex_cn: 他打了个喷嚏，空气从他的鼻孔里出来。
words.en: Either of the two external openings of the nose, which allow air to enter the lungs and smells to be detected.

words.ex: The children are merry on Christmas day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节那天很开心。
words.en: If you describe someone's character or behavior as merry, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.tr: v. 模仿( imitate的第三人称单数 ); 把…作为例子; 模仿（某人的讲话、举止）; 作滑稽
words.ex: The boy imitates his father's walk.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩模仿他父亲的走路方式。
words.en: If someone imitates another person, they copy the way they speak or behave, often in order to be funny.

words.tr: adv. 更确切地说；宁可；相当；
words.ex: I don't like coffee; rather, I prefer tea.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢咖啡；更确切地说，我更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use rather to indicate that something is true to a fairly great extent, especially when you are talking about something unpleasant or undesirable.

words.tr: adj. 了解情况的； v. 通知；告知；“inform”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an informed voter who reads the news daily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个了解情况的选民，每天阅读新闻。
words.en: If someone is informed, they know a lot about a particular subject or situation.

words.tr:
n. 狂乱；狂暴；狂怒
v. 使狂乱；使狂怒
words.ex: The crowd went into a frenzy when the singer appeared.
words.ex_cn: 当歌手出现时，人群陷入了狂热。
words.en: A frenzy is a state of uncontrolled excitement or wild behavior.

words.tr: n. 克莱斯勒（美国汽车品牌）
words.ex: He drives a Chrysler car to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆克莱斯勒汽车去上班。
words.en: An American automobile manufacturer, founded in 1925, known for producing luxury vehicles.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: The story is believable.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事令人信服。
words.en: If something is believable, it seems possible, real, or true.

words.tr: adj. 确定的； v. 向…保证；“assure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was assured that the package would arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他确定包裹明天会到。
words.en: If you are assured of something, you are certain to get it or achieve it.

words.ex: He apologized insincerely, without looking her in the eye.
words.ex_cn: adv. 他毫无诚意地道了歉，没有直视她的眼睛。
words.en: In a manner that is not sincere; not honestly or genuinely.

words.ex: She knit a warm scarf for her brother.
words.ex_cn: 她为她的弟弟织了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: If you knit something, especially an article of clothing, you make it from wool or a similar thread by using two knitting needles or a machine.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.tr:
adj. 闪烁的
v. 闪耀；闪烁；“twinkle”的现在分词
words.ex: The stars are twinkling in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中闪烁。
words.en: A very brief period of time; an instant.

words.ex: He smiled at the recollection of his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他回忆起童年时微笑了。
words.en: The act of remembering something or the ability to remember.

words.ex: The children believe in fairies.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们相信仙女。
words.en: Small, imaginary beings with magical powers, often represented as tiny, beautiful human-like creatures with wings.

words.ex: He spent all day doing paperwork.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都在处理文书工作。
words.en: Paperwork refers to the routine work involving written documents such as forms, reports, and letters, especially in an office setting.

words.ex: He used a stapler to attach the documents together.
words.ex_cn: 他用订书机将文件订在一起。
words.en: A stapler is a device used to fasten papers together by driving a metal staple through the sheets and folding the ends.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.ex: I will go to the park on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 我将在星期五去公园。
words.en: Friday is the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.tr:
v. 猛打；重击；草草放下
n. 重击；份额；一份
words.ex: He gave the ball a whack with his bat.
words.ex_cn: 他用球棒重重地击了一下球。
words.en: To hit someone or something very hard, typically with a loud noise.

words.ex: The red light indicates that the machine is on.
words.ex_cn: 红灯表明机器正在运行。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.ex: He wrote a memo to remind the team.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一封备忘录提醒团队。
words.en: A memo is a short official note that is sent by one person to another within the same company or organization.

words.tr: n. 果馅饼，（轧制钱币的）坯子
words.ex: He ate a piece of flan after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块焦糖布丁。
words.en: A sweet or savoury dish with a custard-like filling, often set in a pastry or sponge base.

words.ex: The monkeys are climbing the trees.
words.ex_cn: 猴子们正在爬树。
words.en: Monkeys are mammals of the order Primates, which includes lemurs, lorises, tarsiers, and apes, including humans. They are known for their intelligence and social behavior.

words.tr:
conj. 直到；
prep. 直到；
words.ex: He waited till the rain stopped.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到雨停。
words.en: Until a particular time or event.

words.tr: v. 表明；指出；“indicate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark clouds are indicating rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: Nina is walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 尼娜正走路去学校。
words.en: Nina is a female given name, often used in various cultures.

words.ex: The bookbinder carefully repaired the ancient manuscript.
words.ex_cn: n. 装订工人小心翼翼地修复了古代手稿。
words.en: A bookbinder is a person whose job is to fasten together the pages of books and put covers on them.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: He caught a swordfish at sea yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天在海上钓到了一把剑鱼。
words.en: A large, fast-swimming fish with a long, flat bill resembling a sword, found in warm seas.

words.tr: adj. 颤抖的；战栗的；令人不安的
words.ex: He was shuddering from the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 他因寒风而颤抖。
words.en: The act or state of trembling or shaking suddenly, often due to fear, cold, or emotion.

words.tr: v. 传播；扩散；展开；散布；“spread”的现在分词；
words.ex: The virus is spreading quickly in the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒正在这座城市迅速传播。
words.en: The act of extending over a larger or increasing area or scope; the diffusion or dissemination of something.

words.ex: He ate fries with ketchup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了配番茄酱的炸薯条。
words.en: Fries are thin strips of potato that are fried until they are crisp and golden brown.

words.ex: She has curly hair.
words.ex_cn: 她有一头卷发。
words.en: Having curls or a curved shape.

words.ex: The car fits fuel i perfectly.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车完美地适配了燃料 i。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object. If you are fitted for a piece of clothing, you try it on so that the person who is making it can see where it needs to be altered.

words.ex: She looked out the window wistfully, longing for freedom.
words.ex_cn: 她惆怅地望着窗外，渴望自由。
words.en: In a way that shows sadness or longing, often because you are thinking about something that is impossible or in the past.

words.tr: n. 震动； v. 摇动；“shake”的现在分词；
words.ex: The shaking of the ground scared the children.
words.ex_cn: 地面的震动吓到了孩子们。
words.en: The act of moving something quickly back and forth or up and down.

words.ex: He works remotely from home.
words.ex_cn: 他从家远程工作。
words.en: If something is done remotely, it is done from a distance, usually by means of technology.

words.ex: She wore the thinnest dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着最薄的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Superlative form of thin, meaning having the least thickness or the smallest circumference among a group.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.tr: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的； v. 结冰；冻结；“freeze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The weather is freezing today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气极冷。
words.en: If you say that something is freezing, you are emphasizing that it is very cold.

words.tr:
adj. 偏远的；久远的；
n. 遥控器；
words.ex: The village is in a remote area far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于远离城市的偏远地区。
words.en: Remote areas are far away from cities and places where most people live, and are therefore difficult to get to.

words.ex: He vaguely remembered the name.
words.ex_cn: 他模糊地记得这个名字。
words.en: If you describe something as vaguely, you mean that it is not clear, distinct, or definite.

words.tr: adj. 样子好看的；匀称的；线条优美的
words.ex: She has a very shapely figure.
words.ex_cn: 她有着非常匀称的身材。
words.en: Having an attractive shape; well-proportioned.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: He moved to the countryside when he was in his seventies.
words.ex_cn: 他在七十多岁时搬到了乡下。
words.en: The seventies refers to the decade from 1970 to 1979 or the age between 70 and 79 years old.

words.ex: The doctor checked the anus for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了肛门是否有感染的迹象。
words.en: The opening at the end of the digestive tract through which solid waste leaves the body.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: He is avoiding sugary drinks to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他正在避免喝含糖饮料以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something or someone, you keep away from them and do not let them affect you.

words.ex: He is flirting with the girl at the cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他正在咖啡馆里向那个女孩调情。
words.en: Flirting is behaving in a way that shows a sexual attraction for someone but is not meant to be taken seriously.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: I gotcha, thanks for explaining!
words.ex_cn: 我明白了，谢谢你解释！
words.en: Used to say that you have caught, understood, or tricked someone.

words.ex: He was dropping his keys on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把钥匙掉在地板上。
words.en: The act of falling or being allowed to fall vertically; the act of delivering something by parachute.

words.tr: adv. 茫然地；毫无表情地
words.ex: She stared blankly at the wall, lost in thought.
words.ex_cn: 她茫然地盯着墙，陷入了沉思。
words.en: If you look at someone blankly, you look at them without showing any recognition or understanding.

words.ex: He gave a dumb answer to the simple question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个简单的问题给出了一个愚笨的回答。
words.en: If someone is dumb, they are unable to speak. If you describe someone or something as dumb, you mean that they are stupid or silly.

words.tr: adj. 更安全的；“safe”的比较级；
words.ex: Wearing a helmet makes riding a bike safer.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔让骑自行车更安全。
words.en: comparative form of 'safe', meaning more protected from or not exposed to danger or risk; not likely to be harmed or lost.

words.ex: She added salts to the water to make it taste better.
words.ex_cn: 她往水里加了盐，让它味道更好。
words.en: Salts are chemical compounds formed from the reaction of an acid with a base. They are composed of positive ions (cations) and negative ions (anions) and are typically crystalline solids at room temperature.

words.tr: v. 仔细检查；审查；仔细检查( examine的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The doctor is examining the patient's arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生正在仔细检查病人的手臂。
words.en: To inspect or scrutinize carefully.

words.ex: She smiled delightedly when she got the gift.
words.ex_cn: 她收到礼物时高兴地笑了。
words.en: In a manner that shows great pleasure or joy.

words.ex: He was feeling particularly randy after a few drinks.
words.ex_cn: 几杯酒下肚后，他感觉特别性欲冲动。
words.en: If you describe someone as randy, you mean that they are sexually excited or eager for sexual activity.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.tr:
adj. 褐色的；棕色的；
n. 褐色；棕色；
words.ex: The brown dog slept on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 那只褐色的狗躺在地板上睡觉。
words.en: Brown is a color that is a mixture of red, yellow, and black. It is the color of earth, wood, and many other natural things.

words.ex: He stole a book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店偷了一本书。
words.en: The past tense of steal, which means to take something that does not belong to you without permission and without intending to return it.

words.tr: n. 舒适；给予援助或安慰的人或事；安慰( comfort的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The soft blanket and warm tea brought her many comforts.
words.ex_cn: 柔软的毯子和热茶给她带来了许多舒适。
words.en: Things that make life more pleasant or easier, especially in terms of physical well-being.

words.ex: He holds the railing while walking up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼梯时扶着栏杆。
words.en: A railing is a fence or barrier made of rails, especially one along the edge of a staircase, balcony, or other structure.

words.ex: The North Pole is covered with ice all year round.
words.ex_cn: 北极全年都被冰雪覆盖。
words.en: A pole is a long, thin, rounded piece of wood or metal, used especially for supporting things.

words.tr: n. 快速完成的事情；速成的东西
words.ex: He had a quickie lunch before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前匆匆吃了顿快餐。
words.en: A quickie is something that is done or made quickly and often not very thoroughly.

words.ex: Evelyn likes to read books every evening.
words.ex_cn: 伊芙琳喜欢每天晚上读书。
words.en: A female given name, often of English origin.

words.ex: The occurring was sudden and surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个事件发生得很突然，让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: To happen or take place; to be found or exist in a particular place or situation.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.tr: n. 斗争；奋斗；挣扎 v. 斗争；奋斗；挣扎
words.ex: He struggles with math homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都为数学作业发愁。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though other people or things may be making it difficult for you.

words.ex: The hospital recorded a high number of births last month.
words.ex_cn: n. 医院上个月记录了大量的出生。
words.en: The act or process of being born; the beginning of life.

words.ex: He sped up to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他加快速度赶公交车。
words.en: To urinate.

words.tr: v. 使不堪重负；压垮；使不知所措
words.ex: The noise overwhelms her.
words.ex_cn: 噪音让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: Overcomes or defeats completely, often by a sudden or intense force or emotion.

words.tr:
n. 同事；（组织的）会员；家伙；同胞；
adj. 同类的；同事的；
words.ex: He works as a fellow with Dr. Smith in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 他在实验室里与史密斯博士一起工作，是他的同事。
words.en: A fellow is a man or boy. In British English, a fellow is also a member of certain academic societies.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.ex: The com is growing fast in this city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的商业正在快速增长。
words.en: A term used to refer to a company or business, often in the context of commerce or trade.

words.tr:
n. 膨胀；凸出部分；暴涨
v. 膨胀；凸出；急增
words.ex: The balloon begins to bulge when filled with air.
words.ex_cn: 气球充气时开始鼓起来。
words.en: If something bulges, it sticks out or swells in a rounded shape.

words.ex: The sky becomes dark at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚来临时，天空变得黑暗。
words.en: To come, change, or grow to be (as specified); to undergo a change or development.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.tr: n. 试验；检测；考试；测验； v. 试验；测试；“test”的现在分词；
words.ex: The testing of the new car took three months.
words.ex_cn: 新车的试验花了三个月。
words.en: The process of subjecting something to a test to determine its qualities or performance.

words.ex: He is supposedly coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 据推测他明天来。
words.en: If you say that something is supposedly the case, you mean that people say it is the case but you do not think it is necessarily true.

words.ex: She is erasing the mistakes from her paper.
words.ex_cn: 她正在从她的论文中擦掉错误。
words.en: To remove something completely, especially something written or recorded.

words.tr: v. 表现；行动；“act”的现在分词； n. 演戏；演技；
words.ex: He is acting bravely in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中表现得很勇敢。
words.en: Acting is the activity or profession of performing in plays, films, or television productions.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.tr: n. 同伴; 密友( buddy的名词复数 ); 弟兄; （用于称呼男子，常带怒气）<美俚>家伙 v
words.ex: They were buddies from childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他们是从小一起长大的伙伴。
words.en: A buddy is a close friend or companion, often used in informal contexts.

words.ex: Good parenting helps children grow happily.
words.ex_cn: 良好的育儿有助于孩子快乐成长。
words.en: Parenting is the activity of bringing up and looking after children.

words.ex: Lesbians often face discrimination in many parts of the world.
words.ex_cn: n. 女同性恋者在世界许多地方经常面临歧视。
words.en: Lesbians are women who are sexually attracted to other women.

words.ex: All the dads were proud of their children at the school play.
words.ex_cn: 所有的父亲在学校演出时都为他们的孩子感到骄傲。
words.en: The plural form of 'dad', referring to more than one father.

words.tr: n. 拉玛泽分娩法（一种通过呼吸和放松技巧来减轻分娩疼痛的方法）
words.ex: She took Lamaze classes to prepare for childbirth.
words.ex_cn: 她参加了拉玛泽课程以准备分娩。
words.en: Lamaze is a method of childbirth that involves breathing and relaxation techniques to manage pain during labor.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.ex: Shirley is a popular name for girls.
words.ex_cn: 雪莉是一个很受女孩欢迎的名字。
words.en: Shirley is a female given name.

words.ex: Laverne is walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 拉弗恩正走向学校。
words.en: A fictional character, the main protagonist of the 1970s American sitcom *Laverne & Shirley*.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.tr: adv. 胜利地；耀武扬威地；得意扬扬地
words.ex: He walked triumphantly off the stage.
words.ex_cn: 他得意地走下舞台。
words.en: In a manner that expresses joy or satisfaction over a success or victory.

words.ex: He flipped the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子快速翻转了煎饼。
words.en: To flip something means to turn it over quickly one or more times, or to make something do this.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: n. 妈妈们（mommy的复数形式）
words.ex: The mummies are sleeping in the old tombs.
words.ex_cn: 木乃伊躺在古老的墓穴里睡觉。
words.en: Informal term for mothers.

words.tr: v. 支持；“support”的现在分词； adj. 支持的；
words.ex: He is supporting his friend during the hard time.
words.ex_cn: 他正在支持他的朋友度过艰难时期。
words.en: Providing support or help.

words.tr: n. 木乃伊（mummy 的复数形式）
words.ex: The museum has ancient mummies from Egypt.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有来自埃及的古代木乃伊。
words.en: Preserved bodies of ancient Egyptian dead.

words.tr: n. 练习；锻炼；行使；“exercise”的复数； v. 使用；
words.ex: He does morning exercises every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做晨练。
words.en: Physical or mental activity that you do to stay healthy or become stronger.

words.tr: n. 教练；长途客运汽车；“coach”的复数； v. 培训；
words.ex: The coaches helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 教练们帮助球队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a sport. Coaches are also the vehicles that carry passengers over long distances.

words.tr: n. 呼吸； v. 呼吸；“breathe”的现在分词；
words.ex: Deep breathing helps you relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于你放松。
words.en: The process of taking air into the lungs and expelling it; a sign of life.

words.ex: This is a basic math skill.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个基本的数学技能。
words.en: You use basic to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or necessary, and on which others depend.

words.ex: The doctor explained the anatomy of the vagina.
words.ex_cn: 医生解释了阴道的解剖结构。
words.en: The vagina is the muscular tube leading from the external genitals to the cervix of the uterus in women and most female mammals.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.tr: n. 围裙( apron的名词复数 ); 停机坪，台口（舞台幕前的部份）
words.ex: The women wear white aprons while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 这些妇女在做饭时穿着白色围裙。
words.en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you wear over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.

words.tr: n. 米诺特（人名或地名，无常用释义）
words.ex: The minot is a small fish found in rivers.
words.ex_cn: minot 是一种生活在河流中的小鱼。
words.en: A small amount or a little.

words.ex: Michael likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 迈克尔喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: Michael is a male given name, derived from the Hebrew name מִיכָאֵל (Mikha'el), meaning 'Who is like God?'.

words.tr: n. 字母J；[数] 一（在某些数学符号中）
words.ex: The letter J is the tenth letter in the alphabet.
words.ex_cn: J是字母表中的第十个字母。
words.en: The tenth letter of the alphabet.

words.ex: He errred when he solved the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时犯了错。
words.en: To make a mistake or be incorrect.

words.ex: The room is slightly warmer than before.
words.ex_cn: 房间比以前稍微暖和一点。
words.en: To a small degree; not considerably.

words.ex: He recoiled when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，他退缩了。
words.en: If something makes you recoil, you move your body quickly away from it because it frightens, offends, or hurts you.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.tr: v. 忘记；“forget”的过去分词； adj. 被忘却的；
words.ex: The keys were forgotten on the table.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙被忘在桌子上。
words.en: If something is forgotten, it has been left behind or not remembered by someone.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: He felt animosity toward his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他对邻居感到敌意。
words.en: Animosity is a strong feeling of dislike and anger towards someone.

words.ex: He held her tenderly in his arms.
words.ex_cn: 他温柔地把她抱在怀里。
words.en: In a gentle, loving, or kind manner.

words.ex: She squeezes the lemon to get the juice.
words.ex_cn: 她挤压柠檬以获取果汁。
words.en: To press something firmly, especially from all sides in order to change its shape, reduce its size, or remove liquid from it.

words.ex: He rubbed his chin when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 他思考时摸了摸下巴。
words.en: The part of the face below the mouth and above the neck.

words.ex: His concerns about the exam made him nervous.
words.ex_cn: 他对考试的担心让他感到紧张。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you; something that concerns you is something that you think is important and that you are interested in.

words.tr: v. 摇摆；摇动（waggle 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The bee waggles to tell others where the flowers are.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂摇摆身体来告诉其他蜜蜂花在哪里。
words.en: Moves in an unsteady, playful way.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.tr: v. 摇晃行走；蹒跚；使摇晃（第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He staggers after drinking too much beer.
words.ex_cn: 他喝太多啤酒后摇摇晃晃。
words.en: Walks or moves unsteadily, as if about to fall.

words.tr:
adj. 认命的；顺从的；勉强接受的
v. 辞职；“resign”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was resigned to losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他认命地接受了输掉比赛的结果。
words.en: If you are resigned to an unpleasant situation or fact, you accept it without complaining because you realize that you cannot change it.

words.ex: He is literally the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他确实是队里最好的球员。
words.en: In a literal manner or sense; exactly.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: He walked backwards to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他向后走到门边。
words.en: If you move or look backwards, you move or look in the direction that your back is facing.

words.tr: adj. 兴奋期待的；急切期待的
words.ex: The children were agog at the magic show.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对魔术表演感到无比惊奇。
words.en: If you are agog, you are very eager or excited to see or hear something.

words.ex: She fetches the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都去拿报纸。
words.en: To go and bring back something; to sell for a particular price.

words.tr: adj. <美俚>渐渐松驰的，渐渐不行了的，渐渐变懒的 v. 滑脱; 滑( slip的现在分词 );
words.ex: The rope is slipping out of my hand.
words.ex_cn: 绳子从我手中滑脱。
words.en: Moving or falling out of place; declining in quality or performance.

words.ex: He gave an ultimatum: leave now or stay forever.
words.ex_cn: 他发出最后通牒：现在走，或者永远留下。
words.en: An ultimatum is a final demand or statement of terms, the rejection of which will result in retaliation or a breakdown in relations.

words.ex: The boat sinks slowly in the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水中慢慢下沉。
words.en: A sink is a large fixed container in a kitchen, with taps to supply water. It is mainly used for washing dishes. As a verb, to sink means to go down below the surface of something, especially a liquid, or to move to a lower level.

words.ex: She was saddened by the news of her friend's illness.
words.ex_cn: 她对朋友生病的消息感到难过。
words.en: Made to feel sorrow or grief.

words.tr: adj. 清音的；未说出的；未出声的; v. 使变成无声；使清音化（unvoice 的过去分词）
words.ex: The consonants in the word 'cat' are unvoiced.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cat' 中的辅音是清音的。
words.en: If a sound is unvoiced, it is produced without the vocal cords vibrating.

words.tr: v. 延伸；伸展；拉紧； n. 一片；一段时间；一段时间( stretch的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The cat stretches its body in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 猫在阳光下伸展身体。
words.en: To stretch is to extend one's body or limbs to their full extent, typically so as to tighten the muscles. It can also refer to extending over a large or increasing area.

words.tr: v. (scamper 的现在分词) 轻快地跑来跑去；蹦蹦跳跳地跑
words.ex: The mice are scampering across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠在地板上跑来跑去。
words.en: Running quickly and playfully.

words.tr: adj. 生病的；坏的；不舒服的；
words.ex: He is ill and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are ill, you are suffering from a disease or a health problem.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.tr: v. 考虑；深思；凝视；思考…的可能性
words.ex: He contemplates quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑辞去工作。
words.en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

words.tr: v. 希望，期望；希望，盼望，期待；希望，期望( hope的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: I hoped she would come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 我希望她会来参加派对。
words.en: If you hope that something is true, or if you hope for something, you want it to be true or to happen, and you usually believe that it is possible or likely.

words.ex: She smiled prettily at the compliment.
words.ex_cn: 她对着赞美漂亮地笑了笑。
words.en: In a pretty manner; attractively.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.ex: She helps her brother with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 她帮弟弟做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of their work or by giving them advice or money.

words.ex: Geoffrey is walking to school.
words.ex_cn: 杰弗里正走路去学校。
words.en: Geoffrey is a male given name of Germanic origin, meaning 'peaceful territory'.

words.tr: adj. 注意力分散的； v. “distract”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was distracted by the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他被巨大的噪音分散了注意力。
words.en: If you are distracted, you are not able to concentrate because you are worried or thinking about something else.

words.tr: v. 攀爬；费力地攀登（clamber 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The boy clambers up the tree.
words.ex_cn: 男孩爬上了树。
words.en: Climbs something steep or awkwardly using hands and feet.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.ex: He sadly said goodbye to his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他伤心地跟他的狗说了再见。
words.en: In a manner that expresses sorrow or unhappiness.

words.ex: He gets massages every week to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都做按摩来放松。
words.en: Massages refer to the action of rubbing and kneading of the body with the hands, especially to relieve tension or pain.

words.tr: v. 丢弃；抛；“throw”的过去分词；
words.ex: He threw away the old book and was thrown it into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书丢进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you throw something, you send it through the air using your hand or arm.

words.ex: The children felt delight when they saw the toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到玩具时感到高兴。
words.en: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

words.tr: n. 舞台造型；戏剧性的场面
words.ex: He drew a tableau of the scene on paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画出了那个场景的图示。
words.en: A tableau is a group of models or motionless figures representing a scene from a story or from history; a picturesque grouping of persons or objects; a striking or artistic grouping.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr: n. 麻刺感; adj. 挠痒痒的; v. 感到刺痛，受到刺激；（刺痛从身体部位）生发，产生（tin...
words.ex: He felt a tingling in his fingers after the cold wind.
words.ex_cn: 他在冷风后手指感到麻刺感。
words.en: A tingling is a slight stinging or prickling feeling, often caused by cold or excitement.

words.ex: He gave a thoughtful answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个深思的答案。
words.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.tr: v. 恢复；重新获得；复原；
words.ex: He will recover from the illness soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会从疾病中恢复。
words.en: If you recover from an illness or an injury, you become well again. If you recover something that has been lost or stolen, you find it or get it back.

words.tr: v. 竖起（耳朵等）；翘起（尾巴等）；歪戴（帽子等）
words.ex: He is cocking the gun carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他正在小心地扳动枪的击锤。
words.en: To tilt or turn something, especially a part of the body, in a particular direction.

words.tr: n. 角；角度；角落；看问题的角度；“angle”的复数；
words.ex: The triangle has three angles.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三个角。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees. It can also refer to a particular way of approaching something or a point of view.

words.ex: He buys new watches every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都会买新手表。
words.en: If you watch someone or something, you look at them, usually for a period of time, and pay attention to what is happening.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.tr: v. 打包；挤满；n. 包；群
words.ex: He packs his bag every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上收拾他的包。
words.en: To fill a suitcase or bag with clothes and other items needed for travel; to fill a space or container tightly with something.

words.tr: v. 使变硬；使坚强；使冷酷
words.ex: The milk hardens when it gets cold.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶变冷时会变硬。
words.en: To make or become hard or harder; to make or become more severe, strict, or unyielding.

words.ex: He mouthed the words silently.
words.ex_cn: 他默默地说了那些话。
words.en: Having a mouth of a specified kind; spoken or uttered.

words.tr: v. 跛行，一瘸一拐地走
words.ex: He limps because of his injured leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因为受伤的腿而一瘸一拐地走。
words.en: To walk with difficulty, typically because of a damaged or stiff leg or foot.

words.ex: The sun shone brightly through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光明亮地照进窗户。
words.en: In a manner that is full of light or shining strongly; in a way that is cheerful and lively.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.ex: He discreetly left the room without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他谨慎地离开了房间，没有说再见。
words.en: If you do something discreetly, you do it in a way that is not likely to be noticed or to offend or embarrass people.

words.tr: n. 有纸夹的笔记板；剪贴板
words.ex: He attached the document to the clipboard for easy access.
words.ex_cn: 他将文件附在剪贴板上以便于访问。
words.en: A clipboard is a flat board with a clip at the top used to hold papers, or a temporary storage area in a computer's memory where data is kept while it is being moved or copied.

words.tr: v. 系上；附加；使相关；使依附；隶属于；“attach”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 附属的；附加的；依恋的；
words.ex: He attached the leash to the dog's collar.
words.ex_cn: 他把狗绳系在狗的项圈上。
words.en: If you say that one thing is attached to another, you mean that the two things are connected, either physically or because they are related in some way.

words.tr: v. 减少；降低；跌落；削弱；
words.ex: He lowers the volume when the baby sleeps.
words.ex_cn: 当宝宝睡觉时，他把音量调低。
words.en: Makes something less in amount, degree, or value.

words.tr: v. （通过努力等）赢得；（在…中）获胜，赢，战胜（对手）；
words.ex: He wins the race with hard training.
words.ex_cn: 他通过刻苦训练赢得了比赛。
words.en: To achieve victory in a contest, conflict, game, or bet; to gain something desired or beneficial through effort or good fortune.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

words.tr: adv. 极其丑陋地；可怕地
words.ex: The old house was hideously decorated with dark colors and strange statues.
words.ex_cn: 那所老房子用深色和奇怪的雕像装饰得极其丑陋。
words.en: In a hideous manner; extremely ugly or unpleasant.

words.ex: He glowered at the boy who broke his vase.
words.ex_cn: 他怒视着打碎他花瓶的那个男孩。
words.en: If you glower at someone or something, you look at them in an angry way.

words.ex: The rainwater drains into the street.
words.ex_cn: 雨水排入街道。
words.en: If you drain something, you remove the liquid from it, usually by pouring it away or by allowing it to flow away. If something drains, the liquid flows away from it.

words.tr: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的； v. “dare”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a daring jump off the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他大胆地从桥上跳了下去。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as daring, you mean that they are willing to do things which might be dangerous or which might shock or anger other people.

words.tr: v. 扭动；挣扎；不安地蠕动（第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The worm squirms in the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这条蠕虫在泥土里扭动。
words.en: Makes small, twisting movements, often to escape.

words.ex: The formation of clouds happens when water vapor cools.
words.ex_cn: 云的形成发生在水蒸气冷却时。
words.en: The process of forming or making something, or the way something is formed or made.

words.ex: His words stirs strong emotions.
words.ex_cn: 他的话激起了强烈的情感。
words.en: To mix or cause to mix by moving around with a tool such as a spoon; to cause to feel an emotion, especially a strong one.

words.tr: adj. 愚笨的；癫狂的；痴傻的
words.ex: He wore a daft hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶傻气的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as daft, you mean that they are silly, foolish, or crazy.

words.tr: v. 批准；认可；通过；赞成(连of)
words.ex: My mom will approve my new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈会同意我买新手机。
words.en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

words.tr:
v. 发出砰的一声
n. 重击声；砰的一声
words.ex: The book fell to the floor with a thud.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到地板上，发出一声闷响。
words.en: A thud is a dull sound, such as that which a heavy object makes when it hits something soft.

words.ex: The squishy sponge soaked up all the water.
words.ex_cn: 湿软的海绵吸干了所有的水。
words.en: Something that is squishy is soft and easy to squash.

words.tr: v. 渗出（ooze 的 ing 形式）；渗透
words.ex: The wound was oozing blood.
words.ex_cn: 伤口在渗血。
words.en: If a liquid oozes from something or if something oozes a liquid, the liquid flows out slowly and in small quantities.

words.ex: The farmers work on their lands every day.
words.ex_cn: 农民们每天在他们的土地上劳作。
words.en: Lands refer to the solid surface of the earth that is not covered by water. It can also mean to come down through the air and rest on the ground or another surface.

words.ex: The soldiers defend their country from enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫自己的国家免受敌人入侵。
words.en: To defend means to protect someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism. It can also involve arguing in support of someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: The bright colors are attracting birds.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的颜色正在吸引鸟类。
words.en: If something attracts people or animals, it has features that cause them to come to it.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.tr: n. 俏皮话；妙语；诙谐语
words.ex: His speech was filled with witticisms that kept the audience laughing.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲中充满了妙语，让观众笑声不断。
words.en: A witticism is a clever and amusing remark.

words.ex: The snake is hissing loudly.
words.ex_cn: 这条蛇正在嘶嘶作响。
words.en: The sound made by a snake, steam, etc., or by people to show disapproval.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.ex: He gathers old coins in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间收集旧硬币。
words.en: To gather means to come together, or to bring things together in one place. It can also mean to collect information or to understand something from what you see or hear.

words.tr: adj. 键控的；有键的；定在某调的
words.ex: The piano was keyed to a lower pitch.
words.ex_cn: 这架钢琴的音调被调低了。
words.en: Adjective: Fitted with or operated by a key. Verb: Fasten or adjust with a key or in a particular way; excite or stimulate.

words.ex: He consults his doctor every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都去看医生。
words.en: To seek information or advice from someone, especially a professional or expert.

words.ex: The university sent out admissions letters last week.
words.ex_cn: 大学上周发出了录取通知书。
words.en: The process or fact of entering or being allowed to enter a place, organization, or institution.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；烦闷的；厌倦的； v. 钻孔；“bore”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt bored during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: If you are bored, you feel tired and impatient because you have lost interest in something or because you have nothing to do.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.tr: v. 收到；接收；“receive”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被广为接受的；
words.ex: I received a letter from my friend yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天收到了朋友的一封信。
words.en: Generally accepted or believed to be true.

words.ex: He was realising his mistake too late.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到自己的错误时已经太晚了。
words.en: to become aware of or understand something; to achieve something you wanted

words.tr: adj. 疏忽的；粗心的；不在意的
words.ex: He was negligent in doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做作业时很疏忽。
words.en: If you say that someone is negligent, you mean that they do not take enough care over something that they are responsible for.

words.tr: v. 不顾( ignore的第三人称单数 ); [法律]驳回（诉讼）; 对…不予理会; 佯装未见
words.ex: He ignores his phone when he works.
words.ex_cn: 他工作时无视他的手机。
words.en: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.ex: His attempts to cheat failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.tr: v. 参观；游览；访问；探望；访问( visit的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: They visited the museum last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place for a short period of time, especially as a tourist or as part of an official duty.

words.tr: adv. 由衷地；真诚地；真正地；
words.ex: I genuinely appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我由衷地感谢你的帮助。
words.en: If you describe something as genuine, you mean that it is real and exactly what it appears to be.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: The train is departing from platform 3.
words.ex_cn: 火车正在从3号站台出发。
words.en: To leave, especially to start a journey.

words.ex: The shop welcomes many customers every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天欢迎许多顾客。
words.en: People or organizations that buy goods or services from a store or business.

words.ex: He walked directly to the school.
words.ex_cn: 他直接走向学校。
words.en: If you do something directly, you do it without any delay or without involving anyone else.

words.tr: v. 使变亮；照亮；增强（brighten 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The sun brightens the sky every morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳每天早晨照亮天空。
words.en: Becomes lighter or more cheerful.

words.ex: She took a forkful of salad and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 她叉了一叉沙拉，笑了。
words.en: n. the amount that a fork can hold

words.tr: v. 跛行; 一瘸一拐地走( limp的现在分词 ); 困难地航行; 磕磕绊绊
words.ex: He was limping because of an injury to his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因为腿部受伤而一瘸一拐地走。
words.en: If someone is limping, they are walking in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

words.ex: The memory of the accident still haunts him.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故的记忆仍然长期困扰着他。
words.en: If something unpleasant haunts you, you keep thinking or worrying about it over a long period of time. A place that is haunted is believed to be visited regularly by a ghost.

words.tr: n. 幽默文章；滑稽漫画（常用复数形式，指报纸或杂志中的幽默版块）
words.ex: He reads the funnies every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上看漫画版。
words.en: Informal term for funny things or jokes.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.tr: v. 使平滑；使顺利（smooth 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: He smooths the paper with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手把纸抚平。
words.en: Makes something smooth or even.

words.ex: The flower has five pink petals.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有五片粉红色的花瓣。
words.en: The petals of a flower are the thin, usually brightly colored parts that surround the reproductive organs.

words.ex: He is identifying the wrong answers on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他正在识别试卷上的错误答案。
words.en: To recognize or establish the identity of someone or something.

words.ex: He is hopeful about passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己通过考试抱有希望。
words.en: If you are hopeful, you are fairly confident that something that you want to happen will happen.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.ex: He alternately sings and dances on stage.
words.ex_cn: 他在舞台上交替地唱歌和跳舞。
words.en: If something happens alternately, it happens first in one way, then in another way that is the opposite of the first, and then in the first way again, and so on.

words.tr: v. 忽略；疏忽( neglect的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is neglecting his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他正在忽略他的作业。
words.en: Paying little or no attention to; disregarding.

words.tr: n. 图画；绘画；制图； v. 提取；吸引；画；“draw”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child made a drawing of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A drawing is a picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.

words.tr: v. 发出短促的吱吱声（chitter 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The birds chitters in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在早晨叽叽喳喳叫。
words.en: Makes a series of short, sharp sounds, like a bird or insect.

words.ex: The children are playing busily in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里忙碌地玩耍。
words.en: If you do something busily, you do it in a very active way, often because you have a lot to do.

words.tr:
n. 企图；试图；
v. 企图；试图；
words.ex: His attempt to cheat on the test failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图在考试中作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr: v. （忙乱地）扒寻，摸索；（为了找到或抓牢）抓，摸；（动物）用爪子乱抓，挣扎；乱涂；在……上乱扒；...
words.ex: He scrabbled through the drawer to find his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他忙乱地在抽屉里翻找他的钥匙。
words.en: If you scrabble for something, you make hurried movements with your fingers to try to get hold of it.

words.tr:
n. 恳求；答辩状；诉状
adj. 恳求的
v. 恳求；辩护；答辩；以…为理由；“plead”的现在分词
words.ex: Her pleading eyes begged for mercy.
words.ex_cn: 她恳求的眼神乞求着怜悯。
words.en: Pleading is the act of making an emotional appeal or a legal argument in court.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful gown to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件漂亮的礼服去参加婚礼。
words.en: A gown is a long, loose piece of clothing worn on formal occasions or by people in particular professions.

words.tr: n. 搅动；煽动；激动；不安
words.ex: The agitation of the water made the dirt rise.
words.ex_cn: 水的搅动使灰尘浮起。
words.en: Agitation is a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.

words.tr: n. 重复乐段；一小段讲话
words.ex: He plays a loud riff on his guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他用吉他弹奏一段响亮的旋律。
words.en: A riff is a short, repeated tune in jazz or popular music, or the act of playing such a tune.

words.tr: v. 猛冲；猛投；猛烈碰撞
words.ex: The car hurtled down the hill.
words.ex_cn: 汽车飞速冲下山坡。
words.en: If someone or something hurtles somewhere, they move there very quickly, often in a uncontrolled way.

words.ex: She was frantic to catch the last bus.
words.ex_cn: 她急忙赶着赶最后一班公交车。
words.en: If someone is frantic, they are behaving in a wild and desperate way, often because they are frightened or worried.

words.ex: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 给汤里加一点盐。
words.en: If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly and suddenly. A dash is a straight, horizontal line used in writing, for example to separate two main clauses whose meanings are closely connected.

words.tr: adj. 爱发号施令的；多管闲事的
words.ex: The officious clerk refused to help unless I filled out another form.
words.ex_cn: 那位爱多管闲事的职员拒绝帮忙，除非我再填一份表格。
words.en: If you describe someone as officious, you are critical of them because they are eager to tell people what to do when you think they should not.

words.ex: It is your duty to finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 完成你的作业是你的职责。
words.en: A duty is a task or action that someone is required to perform.

words.ex: The company adopts new technologies to improve efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 公司采用新技术以提高效率。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow an idea, method, or course of action. It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr: vt. 盘（腿）；盘（头发）；使有褶裥；使折叠；收拢（tuck 的过去分词）; vi. 缝褶裥；折叠...
words.ex: She tucked her hair behind her ears.
words.ex_cn: 她把头发挽到耳后。
words.en: If you tuck something somewhere, you put it there so that it is safe, comfortable, or neat.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；“operate”的现在分词； adj. 运行的；
words.ex: The machine is operating smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转得很顺畅。
words.en: Operating refers to the action of functioning or working, especially in a business or medical context.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；麻醉药
adj. 麻醉的
words.ex: The doctor gave her an anaesthetic before the operation.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给她打了麻醉剂。
words.en: A substance that causes insensitivity to pain, used especially in surgery.

words.tr: n. 诺亚（男子名，也指《圣经》中的诺亚方舟故事中的主人公）
words.ex: Noah built a big boat to save animals.
words.ex_cn: 诺亚造了一条大船来拯救动物。
words.en: A male given name, from the Hebrew 'Noach', meaning 'rest' or 'comfort'.

words.ex: The doctors helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生们帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is a person who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr: v. 学习；“learn”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有学问的；
words.ex: He learned to read when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时学会了阅读。
words.en: A learned person has gained a lot of knowledge by studying.

words.tr:
n. 北方；
adj. 北方的；
adv. 在北方；
words.ex: The wind is coming from the north.
words.ex_cn: 风从北方吹来。
words.en: The direction that is on your left when you are facing the rising sun.

words.tr: adj. 关心的；有同情心的；
words.ex: She is a caring teacher who helps her students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位关心学生的老师。
words.en: If someone is caring, they are affectionate, helpful, and sympathetic.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.ex_cn: 亚马逊河位于美洲。
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零。
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.ex: Good relationships need trust and communication.
words.ex_cn: 良好的关系需要信任和沟通。
words.en: The way in which two or more people or things are connected.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.tr: v. 影响；“affect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 染病的；受感动的；
words.ex: The rain affected the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨影响了比赛。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as affected, you disapprove of the fact that they behave in an unnatural way that is intended to impress other people.

words.tr:
adj. 类人猿的；像猴的
n. 类人猿；猴
words.ex: The simian climbed quickly up the tree.
words.ex_cn: 那只猿猴迅速爬上了树。
words.en: Relating to, resembling, or being a monkey or ape.

words.tr: abbr., n.abbr. 娑罗双树（Saltree）；盐（salt）; n. （Sal）(西、葡、土)萨尔；（柬）...
words.ex: The sal tree grows in the forests of India.
words.ex_cn: 娑罗双树生长在印度的森林中。
words.en: A misspelling of 'salt', a white crystalline substance used for seasoning and preservation.

words.ex: He averred that he was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 他断言自己是无辜的。
words.en: To state or assert to be the case.

words.tr: int. 是的；对的；嗯（用于口语中）
words.ex: He said yeh to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友说了‘嗯’。
words.en: Informal variant of 'yeah', used to express agreement or affirmation.

words.tr: n. 番红花粉；藏红花粉；
words.ex: She added a pinch of saffron to the rice.
words.ex_cn: 她往米饭里加了一小撮番红花粉。
words.en: Saffron is a very expensive spice that is used to color and flavor food. It is made from the dried stigmas of the saffron crocus.

words.ex: He gave her a light pinch on the arm.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻捏了她的胳膊一下。
words.en: To pinch someone or something means to squeeze them tightly between your thumb and finger, or between two surfaces, especially in a way that causes pain.

words.ex: Mitchell is playing soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 米切尔放学后去踢足球。
words.en: A common surname or given name.

words.ex: She eats chickpea salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 她午餐吃鹰嘴豆沙拉。
words.en: A chickpea is a type of legume that is widely used in cooking, known for its nutty flavor and grainy texture.

words.ex: She blesses her children every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上为孩子们祝福。
words.en: If someone is blessed with a particular good quality or skill, they have that good quality or skill.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.tr: adj. 严肃的；认真的；诚挚的
words.ex: Ernest is a kind man who helps his neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 欧内斯特是个善良的人，他帮助邻居。
words.en: A serious, sincere person or quality; earnestness.

words.ex: The wine is stored in the cellars to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄酒储存在地窖里以保持凉爽。
words.en: A cellar is a room below ground level in a house, often used for storing wine or other goods.

words.tr: n. 一堆；桩( pile的名词复数 )；
words.ex: There are piles of books on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上有一堆书。
words.en: A large quantity of something laid or lying in a mass or heap; hemorrhoids.

words.tr:
n. 异教徒；无宗教信仰者
adj. 异教的；异教徒的；无宗教信仰的
words.ex: He lived in a pagan village long ago.
words.ex_cn: 他很久以前住在一个异教村庄里。
words.en: A pagan is someone who worships many gods or no god, especially one who belongs to a religion that existed before Christianity.

words.ex: The child obeys his mother.
words.ex_cn: 孩子听从妈妈的话。
words.en: If you obey a person, a command, or an instruction, you do what you are told to do.

words.ex: He smiled, and the corners of his mouth turned up.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着，嘴角上扬。
words.en: The place or angle where two sides or edges meet; a difficult situation.

words.ex: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。
words.en: The hard parts inside a human or animal that make up its skeleton.

words.tr: v. 暴露；揭开；除去覆盖物
words.ex: She was baring her soul to the therapist.
words.ex_cn: 她向治疗师敞开心扉。
words.en: To uncover or expose something, often by removing a covering or barrier.

words.tr: n. 圣餐桌，供桌，祭坛( altar的名词复数 )
words.ex: People light candles on altars.
words.ex_cn: 人们在祭坛上点蜡烛。
words.en: An altar is a structure upon which offerings such as sacrifices are made for religious purposes. Altars are usually found at shrines, and they can be located in temples, churches, and other places of worship.

words.ex: He is attempting to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他正在尝试解决这道数学题。
words.en: to make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.ex: The bridge crosses the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥横跨河流。
words.en: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.ex: He fends off the dog with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子赶走狗。
words.en: Defends or protects against something, often in a physical or metaphorical sense.

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.tr: v. 阻塞；阻碍；“block”的现在分词；
words.ex: The fallen tree is blocking the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树堵住了道路。
words.en: The act of obstructing or impeding the progress or movement of something or someone.

words.tr: v. 站立；“stand”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He stood by the door waiting for his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他站在门口等他的朋友。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of stand.

words.tr: n. 朋友（西班牙语复数形式，常用于英语中指朋友或伙伴）
words.ex: My amigos and I play soccer every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的朋友们每周末都踢足球。
words.en: Friends or companions, especially in Spanish-speaking contexts.

words.ex: His anger grew when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他的愤怒增加了。
words.en: A strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.

words.tr: v. 宠坏；搞糟；变质；“spoil”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被宠坏的；
words.ex: Her parents spoiled her with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母用太多玩具宠坏了她。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a child, as spoiled, you mean that they behave badly because they are given everything they want. Spoiled food or drink has decayed and is not fit to be eaten or drunk.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.ex: He is a freshman at university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学的一名新生。
words.en: A freshman is a student in the first year of high school, college, or university.

words.ex: The officer held a billy in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 警官手里拿着一根警棍。
words.en: A male given name.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.tr: v. 需要；必须；“need”的现在分词
words.ex: The project is needing more resources to be completed on time.
words.ex_cn: v. 这个项目需要更多资源才能按时完成。
words.en: Requiring something because it is essential or very important.

words.ex: The soil has rich humus.
words.ex_cn: 这种土壤富含腐殖质。
words.en: A dark, rich, fertile soil formed by the decomposition of plant and animal matter.

words.ex: He put the food on a clean dish.
words.ex_cn: 他把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A dish is a shallow container used for cooking or serving food.

words.tr:
n. 下降
v. 降低；减少；“lower”的现在分词
words.ex: The temperature is lowering slowly.
words.ex_cn: 温度正在缓慢下降。
words.en: The act of moving something to a lower position or reducing something in amount, degree, or quality.

words.ex: The man was punished for fraud.
words.ex_cn: 这个人因欺骗而受到惩罚。
words.en: Fraud is the crime of gaining money or financial benefits by a trick or by lying.

words.tr: v. 填充；装满；充满；“fill”的现在分词； n. 填充；
words.ex: He is filling the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把水倒入瓶子中。
words.en: A filling is a small amount of metal or plastic that a dentist puts in a hole in a tooth to prevent further decay.

words.tr: v. 跌倒；下降；砍伐；“fall”的过去式；
words.ex: He fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔了下来。
words.en: To cut down (a tree); to knock down (a person or animal); the skin of an animal with the hair or wool still on it; fierce or cruel.

words.ex: The sun's rays warmed the floor.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在地板上，暖洋洋的。
words.en: Beams of light or heat emanating from the sun or other sources.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；触动；“touch”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He touched the warm cup with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手摸了摸温热的杯子。
words.en: If you are touched by something, it affects you emotionally, often making you feel grateful or sympathetic.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: The princess lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 公主住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A princess is a female member of a royal family, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a king and queen, or the wife of a prince.

words.tr: n. 高架铁路；地铁（elevated railroad 或 elevated railway 的缩写）
words.ex: The el runs above the city streets.
words.ex_cn: 高架铁路在城市街道上方运行。
words.en: A Spanish word meaning 'the', used as a definite article in Spanish grammar.

words.tr: n. 威廉斯堡（美国弗吉尼亚州东南部城市）
words.ex: Williamsburg is a historic city in Virginia.
words.ex_cn: n. 威廉斯堡是弗吉尼亚州的一个历史城市。
words.en: A historic city in southeastern Virginia, USA, known for its well-preserved colonial architecture and as the capital of Virginia from 1699 to 1780.

words.ex: The old house has a colonial style.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子具有殖民地风格。
words.en: Colonial means relating to a system or period of colonization, or to the people who live in a colony.

words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The star around which the earth orbits, providing light and warmth.

words.ex: She ate a prune for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一颗梅干作为健康零食。
words.en: To prune means to cut off some of the branches of a tree or bush to make it grow better. It can also mean to reduce the extent of something by removing superfluous or unwanted parts.

words.tr: adj. 干的；干燥的； v. 变干；“dry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She ate dried fruit for a snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃干果当零食。
words.en: If something is dried, it has had all the moisture removed from it, often to preserve it.

words.tr: adj. 该死的，可恶的（用于加强语气）
words.ex: This is freaking amazing!
words.ex_cn: 这简直太棒了！
words.en: used to emphasize something, especially to express anger or annoyance

words.tr: v. 挤出，榨出；挤压，捏；挤入，塞入；
words.ex: She squeezed the lemon to get the juice.
words.ex_cn: 她挤了柠檬以榨出汁液。
words.en: To press something firmly, especially from all sides in order to change its shape, reduce its size, or remove liquid from it.

words.ex: He clenched his fist when he got angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时握紧了拳头。
words.en: A hand with the fingers clenched in the palm, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.tr: adv. 无意地；不知不觉地
words.ex: He unconsciously tapped his foot while waiting.
words.ex_cn: 他等的时候无意识地敲着脚。
words.en: If you do something unconsciously, you do it without being aware of it.

words.tr: adj. 装有弹簧的; v. 蹦跳；突然弹起；突然启动；惊起（猎鸟）；给……装上软垫；（米料）翘曲；...
words.ex: The chair had a sprung seat for added comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子有一个装有弹簧的座位，以增加舒适度。
words.en: Sprung is the past tense and past participle of spring, which means to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction, often by jumping.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.tr: adj. 非常兴奋的；极为激动的； v. “thrill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was thrilled when he won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 当他赢得奖品时，他非常兴奋。
words.en: If someone is thrilled, they are extremely pleased about something.

words.ex: She was hugging her friend tightly.
words.ex_cn: 她紧紧地拥抱着她的朋友。
words.en: The act of holding someone tightly in one's arms, typically to express affection.

words.tr: adj. 高兴的；愉快的；快乐的； v. “delight”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She was delighted to see her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她见到朋友很高兴。
words.en: If you are delighted, you are extremely pleased and happy about something.

words.ex: Betty likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 贝蒂喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A female given name, often a diminutive form of Elizabeth.

words.ex: He is nutsy about basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对篮球着迷。
words.en: Informal term for crazy or eccentric.

words.tr: n. 统计；统计数据；统计资料
words.ex: He checks the stat after the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛后查看统计数据。
words.en: A stat is a piece of numerical information obtained from a study of a quantity, especially one that is used to support an argument or to inform decision-making.

words.tr:
adj. 在（或向）市郊住宅区的；城镇非中心区的
adv. 离开市中心；往（去或在）城镇非中心区
n. 住宅区；城镇非中心区
words.ex: He lives in an uptown apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在靠近公园的市郊住宅区的公寓里。
words.en: Uptown refers to the residential area of a city or town, away from the central business district.

words.ex: He is mirroring her movements exactly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在完全模仿她的动作。
words.en: The act of copying or imitating someone's behavior or actions.

words.ex: He picked up the receiver to answer the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起听筒接电话。
words.en: A receiver is a person who receives something or a device that receives signals and converts them into sound or pictures.

words.tr: v. 做口型；不出声地说
words.ex: She was mouthing the words to the song silently.
words.ex_cn: 她无声地对着歌曲做口型。
words.en: The act of forming words with the lips without making any sound.

words.ex: He is clasping his hands tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他正紧紧地握着双手。
words.en: Holding or grasping something firmly or closely.

words.tr:
n. 胸；怀；（女性的）乳房
adj. 亲密的；知心的
words.ex: She held the baby close to her bosom.
words.ex_cn: 她把婴儿紧紧抱在胸前。
words.en: Your bosom is the front part of your chest, especially the part that is covered by your clothes and where your breasts are.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的； 心情焦躁的；易怒的
words.ex: He gets uptight when people are late.
words.ex_cn: 当别人迟到时，他会变得紧张。
words.en: If you say that someone is uptight, you mean that they are very tense, nervous, or angry about something.

words.tr: v. 感到愤恨；怨恨（resent 的现在分词）
words.ex: He is resenting the extra work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在抱怨额外的工作。
