words.ex_cn: v. 她解决了她两个朋友之间的争端。
words.en: To settle means to resolve a dispute or to establish a permanent residence.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr:
v. 投掷；抛；“cast”的现在分词
n. 铸件
words.ex: He was casting a stone into the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把一块石头扔进湖里。
words.en: The process of selecting actors for a play or film; the process of making objects by pouring liquid material into a mold.

words.ex: The zookeeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员每天早上给狮子喂食。
words.en: A zookeeper is a person who manages and takes care of the animals in a zoo.

words.tr: n. 抹布( wipe的名词复数 ); （湿）纸巾 v. 拭; 拭去; 擦( wipe的第三人称单数
words.ex: He wipes his hands on a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦手。
words.en: To remove or clean something by rubbing it with a cloth or similar material.

words.ex: She gave the furniture a thorough dusting.
words.ex_cn: 她彻底地给家具除尘。
words.en: The act of removing dust or applying a fine powder.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: Thy book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 你的书在桌子上。
words.en: Used as the possessive form of 'thou', equivalent to 'your' in modern English.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.tr:
adj. 舞台上的；台上演出的
adv. 在舞台上
words.ex: The actor looked nervous onstage.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在舞台上显得很紧张。
words.en: When someone is onstage, they are performing or speaking in front of an audience in a theatre or concert hall.

words.ex: He wears hats every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都戴帽子。
words.en: Hats are head coverings, often worn for protection against the elements, for ceremonial reasons, for safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: The vigilante group took the law into their own hands.
words.ex_cn: 这个义务警员团体自己动手执法。
words.en: A vigilante is a person who tries in an unofficial way to prevent crime, or to catch and punish someone who has committed a crime, especially because they do not think that official organizations, such as the police, are controlling crime effectively.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.tr: n. 大众汽车（德国汽车品牌）
words.ex: He drives a Volkswagen to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: Volkswagen is a German automobile manufacturer headquartered in Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany. It designs, manufactures and distributes passenger and commercial vehicles, motorcycles, engines, and turbomachinery, and offers related services including financing, leasing and fleet management.

words.ex: The popes of the Renaissance were great patrons of the arts.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴时期的教皇是艺术的重要赞助人。
words.en: The plural form of 'pope', referring to the head of the Roman Catholic Church.

words.tr: n. 斯大林（苏联领导人）
words.ex: Stalin led the Soviet Union during World War II.
words.ex_cn: 斯大林在二战期间领导苏联。
words.en: Joseph Stalin was a Soviet revolutionary and political leader who governed the Soviet Union from the mid-1920s until his death in 1953. He is known for his role in the development of the Soviet Union into a major world power and for his authoritarian leadership style.

words.ex: He lives in Switzerland.
words.ex_cn: 他住在瑞士。
words.en: A country in central Europe known for its mountains, neutrality, and high standard of living.

words.ex: He wore a thick joseph to keep warm in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件厚实的连帽大氅来保暖过冬。
words.en: A male given name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'God will add' or 'He will increase'.

words.ex: She is starring in a new movie this summer.
words.ex_cn: 她今年夏天将在一部新电影中担任主角。
words.en: To have a leading role or roles in a movie, play, or other performance.

words.tr: n. 小提琴家; 拉提琴的人; 爱玩乐的人，游手好闲的人; (账目等的弄虚作假
words.ex: He was a skilled fiddler, playing at local pubs every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他是个技艺高超的小提琴家，每周末都在当地酒吧演奏。
words.en: A fiddler is someone who plays the violin, especially in folk music. It can also refer to someone who is dishonest or who cheats people.

words.tr: v. 大声地嚼；格格地咬，啮；（变得）焦急; n. 冠军；咀嚼，咀嚼声; n. （Champ）（美、...
words.ex: The dog champed noisily on its bone.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗大声地嚼着它的骨头。
words.en: To champ means to chew noisily or to bite upon something impatiently. As a noun, it refers to a champion, someone who has surpassed all rivals in a competition.

words.tr: n. 宝贝；婴儿；年轻女子
words.ex: The babes were playing in the park.
words.ex_cn: n. 婴儿们在公园里玩耍。
words.en: Babes is a term used to refer to young children, especially babies, or to young women in an affectionate or informal way.

words.tr: n. 球果；圆锥体( cone的名词复数 )；
words.ex: Pine trees drop cones in the fall.
words.ex_cn: 松树在秋天掉落球果。
words.en: Cones are geometric shapes that taper smoothly from a flat base to a point called the apex or vertex. In biology, cones refer to the cone cells in the retina of the eye which are responsible for color vision.

words.ex: He had a mop of curly hair that always looked messy.
words.ex_cn: 他有一头乱蓬蓬的卷发，总是看起来很凌乱。
words.en: A mop is a tool for cleaning floors, consisting of a bundle of thick strings or a sponge attached to a long handle. As a verb, it means to clean or wipe something with a mop.

words.tr: n. 街区；积木；砖；块；大楼；大厦；障碍物；“block”的复数； v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: He lives in the next blocks near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园旁边的街区。
words.en: Blocks can refer to solid pieces of material with flat surfaces, or to the act of preventing something from happening or moving.

words.ex: We walked on the beach at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时漫步在海滩上。
words.en: A beach is a landform along the coast of an ocean, sea, lake, or river. It usually consists of loose particles, which are often composed of rock, such as sand, gravel, shingle, pebbles, or cobblestones.

words.ex: The children love to see animals at the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在动物园看动物。
words.en: Animals are living creatures such as dogs, lions, and dolphins. They are not plants, and they can usually move around and react to their surroundings.

words.tr: adj. 被逼入绝境的；有角的
words.ex: The cat was cornered by the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫被狗逼到了角落。
words.en: Having corners or angles; forced into a position from which escape is difficult.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.ex: The boy picked up the objects on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩捡起了地上的物品。
words.en: Objects are physical things that you can see and touch. In grammar, an object is a noun, pronoun, or noun phrase that receives the action of a verb or is affected by it.

words.tr: n. 操纵；处理； v. 处理；操纵；“handle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The handling of the machine requires training.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的操纵需要培训。
words.en: The act of managing or dealing with something.

words.tr: n. 角( horn的名词复数 ); 号; 角质; （蜗牛等的）触角
words.ex: The bull raised its horns and charged.
words.ex_cn: 公牛抬起角冲了过去。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part that grows from the head of some animals, or a device that makes a loud noise as a warning or signal.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.ex_cn: 兔子跳过了小篱笆。
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.ex: The company reported big gains this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年获得了丰厚的收益。
words.en: Gains refer to the profits or benefits obtained from something, especially in business or financial contexts.

words.ex: The blind man walks with a white cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位失明的男人用白色手杖走路。
words.en: Unable to see; lacking the sense of sight.

words.ex: The hunter kills the deer for food.
words.ex_cn: 猎人杀死鹿作为食物。
words.en: To cause the death of a living thing; to put an end to something.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.tr:
n. 颜色；
v. 着色；
words.ex: The sky has a blue colour.
words.ex_cn: 天空有一种蓝色。
words.en: Colour is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.tr: vi. 试听（audition的现在分词形式）
words.ex: He is auditioning for a role in a play.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为一部戏剧的角色试镜。
words.en: Participating in a trial performance for a role or job.

words.ex: I look at old photos to remember my childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 我看着老照片来回忆我的童年记忆。
words.en: Memories are things that you remember about the past.

words.ex: They act like fools at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他们在派对上表现得像个傻瓜。
words.en: A fool is a person who lacks good sense or judgment; a silly person.

words.tr: n. 阿姆斯特丹（荷兰首都）
words.ex: We visited Amsterdam last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天去了阿姆斯特丹。
words.en: Amsterdam is the capital and most populous city of the Netherlands, known for its artistic heritage, elaborate canal system, and narrow houses with gabled facades.

words.ex: The cows were slaughtered early in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 这些牛在清晨被屠宰了。
words.en: To kill animals for food or to kill people in a violent way.

words.ex: The dictator ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位独裁者统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A dictator is a ruler who has complete power in a country, especially when this power has been obtained by force and is used unfairly or cruelly.

words.tr: n. 堆，顶; 警察( cop的名词复数 )
words.ex: The cops arrived at the scene quickly.
words.ex_cn: 警察迅速到达了现场。
words.en: A misspelling of 'cops' (police officers) or 'cops' (to capture).

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.tr: adj. 被抓住的；被持有的
words.ex: He is holding a book in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手里拿着一本书。
words.en: Holden is the past participle of 'hold', meaning to have or keep in one's grasp or control.

words.ex: He stayed neutral in the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持中立。
words.en: If you say that someone is neutral, you mean that they do not support or help either side in a disagreement, competition, or war.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.tr: v. 安静；使沉默（hush 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The crowd hushes when the teacher enters.
words.ex_cn: 当老师进来时，人群安静下来。
words.en: The third-person singular present tense of 'hush', meaning to make or become silent.

words.tr: adj. 不协调的；缺乏考虑的
words.ex: He is uncoordinated and drops things often.
words.ex_cn: 他动作不协调，经常掉东西。
words.en: If you describe someone as uncoordinated, you mean that their movements are not smooth or controlled.

words.tr: n. 骑马；乘车； v. 骑；乘坐；“ride”的现在分词；
words.ex: He enjoys riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity or sport of riding horses.

words.ex: He rode the horse on horseback.
words.ex_cn: 他骑在马背上。
words.en: If you do something on horseback, you do it while riding a horse.

words.ex: The students in my classes are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 我班上的学生都很友好。
words.en: A group of students who are taught together at school, college, or university.

words.tr: v. 花费；度过；“spend”的现在分词； n. 花费；开销；
words.ex: He is spending money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他正在花钱买书。
words.en: Spending refers to the act of using money to buy or pay for something.

words.tr: n. 凯尔特人（复数）；凯尔特语（复数）；（常指）波士顿凯尔特人队（NBA球队）
words.ex: The Celtics won the basketball game last night.
words.ex_cn: 凯尔特人队昨晚赢了篮球比赛。
words.en: Refers to the Boston Celtics, a professional basketball team in the NBA, or more broadly to people or things associated with them.

words.ex: He lives in Boston.
words.ex_cn: 他住在波士顿。
words.en: Boston is the capital and largest city of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts in the United States.

words.ex: He went to the embassy to get a visa.
words.ex_cn: 他去大使馆办理签证。
words.en: An embassy is a group of officials who represent their country in a foreign country, or the building where they work.

words.tr: v. 撞坏；猛撞；撞毁；猛冲直撞；（使）猛撞， （使）撞毁( crash的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: The car crashed into a tree.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车撞到了一棵树上。
words.en: Failed or collapsed suddenly, often with destructive results.

words.ex: She put the pillows on the bed.
words.ex_cn: 她把枕头放在床上。
words.en: A pillow is a rectangular cloth bag stuffed with feathers, foam rubber, or other soft materials, used to support the head when lying down.

words.ex: He pays his bills every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五支付账单。
words.en: A bill is a written statement of money that you owe for goods or services.

words.tr: v. 应付；“deal”的现在分词； n. 交易；
words.ex: He is dealing with a difficult boss.
words.ex_cn: 他正在应付一个难搞的老板。
words.en: Dealing refers to the way in which someone behaves towards other people or the way in which someone does business.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: He was shunned by his colleagues after the scandal.
words.ex_cn: v. 在丑闻之后，他被同事们回避了。
words.en: If you shun someone or something, you deliberately avoid them or keep away from them.

words.tr: n. 生活必需品；日用品；生活必需品，日用品（注意复数）；
words.ex: The family bought supplies like food, water, and soap.
words.ex_cn: 这家人买了食物、水和肥皂等生活必需品。
words.en: Supplies are the things that are needed for a particular purpose or that are used or consumed in a particular situation.

words.tr: n. 商店；“store”的复数； v. 贮藏；
words.ex: There are many stores on this street.
words.ex_cn: 这条街上有很多商店。
words.en: A place where merchandise is offered for sale; also, the act of keeping something for future use.

words.ex: The company's sales increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 该公司上个月的销售额增加了。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: He felt intimidated by the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 他害怕那只大狗。
words.en: If you feel intimidated, you feel frightened or nervous because you are not confident in a situation.

words.ex: He buys bread every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上买面包。
words.en: To acquire something by paying money for it.

words.tr: n. 宾夕法尼亚州（美国州名）
words.ex: Pennsylvania is known for its historical significance in the United States.
words.ex_cn: 宾夕法尼亚州以其在美国历史上的重要性而闻名。
words.en: A state in the northeastern United States, known for its significant role in the founding of the United States, with a diverse economy including agriculture, manufacturing, and services.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: He showed great spirit when he tried again after failing.
words.ex_cn: 他在失败后再次尝试时展现了极大的精神。
words.en: The part of a person that includes their mind, feelings, and character rather than their body.

words.tr: adj. 令人震惊的；使大吃一惊的； v. “astound”的现在分词；
words.ex: The magician's trick was astounding.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师的魔术令人震惊。
words.en: If something is astounding, it is so surprising or so impressive that it is difficult to believe.

words.tr: int. 用于引起注意或表示问候
words.ex: He said yo to his friend on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上对朋友喊了声‘喂’。
words.en: used to get someone's attention or as a greeting

words.ex: He closed the gate before it rained.
words.ex_cn: 下雨前他关上了门。
words.en: A gate is a structure like a door which is used at the entrance to a field, a garden, or the grounds of a building.

words.ex: The paint made a swirly pattern on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 油漆在纸上形成了旋涡状的图案。
words.en: Having a twisting or spiraling shape or pattern.

words.tr:
n. 火焰
v. 燃烧；爆发；面红
words.ex: The candle flame flickered in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的火焰在风中摇曳。
words.en: A flame is a hot bright stream of burning gas that comes from something that is burning.

words.tr: n. 冲击；主力；首当其冲
words.ex: The farmers bore the brunt of the drought.
words.ex_cn: 农民们承受了干旱的主要打击。
words.en: The main force or impact of something, especially something unpleasant.

words.ex: He has lotsa friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校有很多朋友。
words.en: Informal, colloquial term for 'lots of'.

words.tr: v. 表示厌恶或不满的感叹词
words.ex: He yukked at the sight of the spoiled food.
words.ex_cn: v. 他看到变质的食物时发出了厌恶的声音。
words.en: v. An exclamation expressing disgust or dissatisfaction.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.tr: n. 疯狂；疯癫；愚蠢的行为；
words.ex: His madness led him to jump off the building.
words.ex_cn: 他的疯狂让他从大楼上跳了下去。
words.en: Madness is a state of being mentally ill, especially severely. It can also refer to a state of wild or chaotic activity.

words.ex: The child hugged his teddy before sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 孩子睡觉前抱着他的泰迪玩具熊。
words.en: A teddy is a child's toy bear, which is usually made of soft furry material.

words.tr: n. 打呵欠 adj. 张着大嘴的，打哈欠的 v. 打呵欠( yawn的现在分词 ); 张开，裂开
words.ex: He was yawning during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中打哈欠。
words.en: If you describe a gap or a difference as yawning, you mean that it is very large and often frightening.

words.ex: The child is curious about the stars.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对星星感到好奇。
words.en: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.tr: n. 斯克兰顿（美国宾夕法尼亚州城市名）
words.ex: He lives in Scranton with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在斯克兰顿。
words.en: A city in northeastern Pennsylvania, USA, known for its industrial history and as the setting for the TV show 'The Office'.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet improves your safety.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔能提高你的安全。
words.en: Safety refers to the condition of being protected from or unlikely to cause danger, risk, or injury.

words.ex: The cows are eating grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛正在田野里吃草。
words.en: Cows are large female animals kept on farms for their milk or meat.

words.tr:
n. 兽医；
v. 审查；
words.ex: The vet checked the dog's health.
words.ex_cn: 兽医检查了狗的健康状况。
words.en: A vet is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals. As a verb, to vet means to examine something or someone carefully to make sure they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He steals cookies from the jar.
words.ex_cn: 他从罐子里偷饼干。
words.en: To take something without permission and with the intention of keeping it.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.tr: v. （动物）交配；（非正式）用力颠簸；（俚语）性交
words.ex: The dog is humping the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗在蹭枕头。
words.en: The present participle of 'hump', meaning to engage in sexual intercourse or, more generally, to move with a heavy, awkward gait.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.ex: The docile dog followed its owner quietly.
words.ex_cn: 这只温顺的狗安静地跟着主人。
words.en: A docile person or animal is quiet, not aggressive, and easily controlled.

words.ex: The violent storm destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场暴力的风暴摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If someone is violent, or if they do something that is violent, they use physical force or weapons to hurt, injure, or kill other people.

words.ex: He showed maturity when he apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他为自己的错误道歉时，表现出了成熟。
words.en: Maturity is the state of being fully developed or grown, or the time when a financial arrangement becomes ready to be paid.

words.tr: n. 动物园（zoo 的复数形式）
words.ex: Children love visiting zoos to see animals.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢去动物园看动物。
words.en: A zoo is a place where many different species of animals are kept so that people can look at them or study them.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.ex: He lives in Miami with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在迈阿密。
words.en: A city in southeastern Florida, known for its beaches and as a center of Latin American culture.

words.tr: v. 使（自己）致力于；应用；应用( apply的现在分词 )；
words.ex: He is applying himself to learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他正致力于学习英语。
words.en: If you apply something such as a rule, system, or skill, you use it or put it into practice in a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: The stealer took his phone from the table.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从桌子上拿走了他的手机。
words.en: A stealer is someone who steals something.

words.ex: The cheerleader waves the flag and shouts loudly.
words.ex_cn: 啦啦队队员挥舞着旗帜大声喊叫。
words.en: A cheerleader is a person who leads the cheering for a team at a sports event.

words.ex: I eat yoghurt for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上吃酸奶当早餐。
words.en: Yoghurt is a slightly sour thick liquid made by adding bacteria to milk, often eaten with fruit or as part of a meal.

words.tr: n. 容器；集装箱；“container”的复数；
words.ex: The boxes are containers for the toys.
words.ex_cn: 这些盒子是装玩具的容器。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.tr: n. 支柱；撑条；支架（strut 的复数形式）；v. 趾高气扬地走（strut 的第三人称单数形式）
words.ex: The old house struts when the wind blows.
words.ex_cn: 当风吹过时，老房子会发出嘎吱声。
words.en: A structural support, typically a metal bar or beam, used to hold something in place or to provide rigidity, often in engineering or construction contexts.

words.ex: He listens to music with his old walkman.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的旧随身听听音乐。
words.en: A Walkman is a small portable cassette player, radio, or CD player with headphones, used especially for listening to music while on the move.

words.ex: She put on red lipstick before the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在派对前涂了红色口红。
words.en: Lipstick is a colored substance in the form of a stick, used for coloring the lips.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: He used a beeper to stay in touch with his team.
words.ex_cn: 他使用传呼机与团队保持联系。
words.en: A beeper is a small device you carry that makes a noise to tell you when someone is trying to contact you.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: She waited eagerly for the results.
words.ex_cn: 她渴望地等待着结果。
words.en: If you do something eagerly, you do it with enthusiasm and excitement because you really want to do it.

words.ex: We sang songs using karaoke at the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们在聚会上用卡拉OK录音唱歌。
words.en: A form of entertainment in which people sing popular songs without the original vocals, typically following the lyrics on a video screen.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.tr:
n. 乌木；黑檀
adj. 乌黑的；黑檀的
words.ex: The table is made of ebony.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用乌木做的。
words.en: Ebony is a very hard, heavy, and dark-colored wood, used especially for making furniture and musical instruments.

words.tr:
adj. 下意识的；潜意识的；
n. 潜意识；下意识；
words.ex: He made a subconscious decision to help her.
words.ex_cn: 他下意识地决定帮助她。
words.en: The subconscious is the part of your mind that contains feelings and thoughts that you are not directly aware of but that can influence your behavior and emotions.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.tr: adj. 无礼的；莽撞的；俏皮的
words.ex: The saucy girl laughed at the teacher's joke.
words.ex_cn: 那个调皮的女孩笑着听了老师讲的笑话。
words.en: If you describe someone as saucy, you mean that they are cheerful, confident, and like to make jokes, especially of a sexual nature.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.ex: The pirates stole gold from the ship.
words.ex_cn: 海盗从船上偷了黄金。
words.en: Pirates are people who attack and rob ships at sea.

words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: Has clothing or accessories on one's body; endures or tolerates.

words.ex: The Tyrannosaurus rex was one of the largest land carnivores of all time.
words.ex_cn: 雷克斯暴龙是有史以来最大的陆地食肉动物之一。
words.en: A tyrannosaurus is a very large, carnivorous dinosaur that lived in the Cretaceous period.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.ex: The doctor checked her boob for any lumps.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了她的乳房是否有肿块。
words.en: A boob is someone who is considered to be silly or stupid. It can also refer to making a foolish mistake.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.tr: v. 牵涉；使参与；使专心于；
words.ex: The accident involves two cars.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故牵涉到两辆车。
words.en: If a situation, event, or activity involves something, that thing is a part of it or a result of it.

words.ex: He has a black moustache.
words.ex_cn: 他有一撮黑色的胡子。
words.en: A moustache is the hair that grows on a man's upper lip.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.tr: adj. 更强壮的；更强烈的；“strong”的比较级；
words.ex: He became stronger after exercising every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天锻炼后变得更强壮了。
words.en: Comparative of strong; having more physical power or higher degree of intensity.

words.tr: n. 玛格丽特鸡尾酒（一种以龙舌兰酒为基酒的鸡尾酒，常加入柠檬汁和橙味利口酒）
words.ex: They drink margaritas at the beach party.
words.ex_cn: 他们在海滩派对上喝玛格丽特鸡尾酒。
words.en: A cocktail made from tequila, lime juice, and triple sec, typically served with a salt-rimmed glass.

words.tr: adj. 强烈的; 强壮的; 强的( strong的最高级 ); 坚强的
words.ex: He is the strongest man I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 他是我见过的最强壮的人。
words.en: Having the greatest power, intensity, or durability; the most robust or effective.

words.tr: n. 护林员；公园看管人；突击队员；
words.ex: The ranger walked through the forest to check for fires.
words.ex_cn: 护林员在森林里巡逻，检查是否有火灾。
words.en: A ranger is someone whose job is to look after a forest or a large park.

words.ex: The stegosaurus had plates on its back.
words.ex_cn: 剑龙的背上长有板状结构。
words.en: A herbivorous dinosaur with distinctive plates along its back and spikes on its tail.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.ex: The paleontologist found a dinosaur bone in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 古生物学家在沙漠中发现了一块恐龙骨头。
words.en: A paleontologist is a scientist who studies fossils to understand the history of life on Earth.

words.tr: adj. 令人不快的；讨厌的
words.ex: The food was icky and I couldn't eat it.
words.ex_cn: 这食物令人不快，我吃不下。
words.en: Something that is icky is unpleasant, disgusting, or makes you feel slightly sick.

words.tr: adj. 逗人笑的； v. “amuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an amusing performance.
words.ex_cn: 小丑的表演很逗人笑。
words.en: Something that is amusing makes you laugh or smile.

words.ex: My brother's son is my nephew.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟的儿子是我的侄子。
words.en: A nephew is a son of one's sibling or sibling-in-law.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: He calls 911 for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 他有紧急情况时拨打911。
words.en: Emergencies are serious, unexpected, and often dangerous situations requiring immediate action.

words.tr: int. 唉（表示惊讶、痛苦、遗憾等）
words.ex: Ay, I lost my keys again!
words.ex_cn: 唉，我又把钥匙弄丢了！
words.en: Used to express various emotions such as surprise, pain, or regret.

words.ex: The goat eats grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在田野里吃草。
words.en: A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and some have long hair.

words.ex: He used the opener to open the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 他用开瓶器打开了瓶子。
words.en: An opener is a device or tool used to open something, such as a bottle or can, or the first event in a series of events.

words.ex: He told a biblical story to the children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个圣经故事。
words.en: Relating to or contained in the Bible.

words.ex: There are thirteen apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有十三个苹果。
words.en: The number 13, which is one more than twelve and one less than fourteen.

words.ex: Texas and California are two large states.
words.ex_cn: 德克萨斯州和加利福尼亚州是两个大的州。
words.en: The term 'states' refers to the political organization of a body of people under a single government, or the condition of a system or matter at a given time.

words.ex: The felon went to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 这名重罪犯因偷窃而入狱。
words.en: A felon is someone who is guilty of committing a felony, which is a serious crime such as murder or rape.

words.tr: adj. 光亮的；闪耀的；锃亮的；有光泽的；
words.ex: The shiny coin caught her eye.
words.ex_cn: 那枚光亮的硬币引起了她的注意。
words.en: Something that is shiny has a bright, smooth surface that reflects light.

words.ex: Joan walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 琼每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A female given name, often a diminutive of Jane or Joan.

words.ex: Mr. Collins teaches English at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 柯林斯先生在当地学校教英语。
words.en: Refers to Collins, a major British publisher of dictionaries and reference books, often used to denote authoritative language definitions.

words.ex: Chad is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 查德正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A large, landlocked country in north-central Africa, bordered by Libya, Sudan, and Nigeria.

words.tr: adj. 每二百年发生一次的；
words.ex: The bicentennial celebration marked 200 years since the country's founding.
words.ex_cn: 二百年庆典纪念了该国建国200周年。
words.en: A bicentennial is the two-hundredth anniversary of a significant event.

words.tr: n. 彼特里（人名，常见于考古学领域，如英国考古学家弗雷德里克·皮特里 Frederick Petrie）
words.ex: Petrie is a name, not a common English word.
words.ex_cn: Petrie 是一个名字，不是常见的英语单词。
words.en: A surname, notably associated with Flinders Petrie, a British Egyptologist and pioneer of systematic methodology in archaeology.

words.tr:
n. 图钉
v. 用图钉固定
words.ex: He used a thumbtack to pin the note to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他用图钉把便条钉在了布告板上。
words.en: A thumbtack is a short pin with a broad flat top, used especially for putting up notices.

words.ex: He uses a nail remover to take off polish.
words.ex_cn: 他用指甲卸甲液来去掉指甲油。
words.en: A substance or device used to remove something, such as a stain or a piece of furniture.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.ex: The barber knows his clients well.
words.ex_cn: 这位理发师很了解他的客户。
words.en: A client is someone who receives services from a professional person or organization in return for payment.

words.ex: He is likely to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能赢得比赛。
words.en: If something is likely, it will probably happen or is expected.

words.tr: n. 盛大演出；盛大活动；铺张华丽的娱乐表演
words.ex: The concert was a spectacular extravaganza.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会是一场壮观的华丽表演。
words.en: An extravaganza is a very elaborate and expensive entertainment or production.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: The company hires new employees every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年夏天都会雇用新员工。
words.en: To employ someone for wages or to pay for the use of something.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.tr: v. 了解; 懂，理解( understand的第三人称单数 ); 默认; 听说
words.ex: He understands the basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他理解基本的数学。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: n. 烘干机；吹风机；干燥剂（dryer 的复数形式）
words.ex: The hair dryers are too loud.
words.ex_cn: 吹风机太吵了。
words.en: Appliances used to remove moisture from clothes, hair, or other items.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fades over time.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色随着时间的推移逐渐褪色。
words.en: If something fades, it gradually becomes less bright, less strong, or less noticeable.

words.ex: He is SW at math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面很厉害。
words.en: Southwest; the direction between south and west.

words.tr: n. 期中考试；期中测验
words.ex: He is preparing for his midterms this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周正在为期中考试做准备。
words.en: Elections for U.S. federal offices held in the middle of a president's four-year term, often shifting control of Congress.

words.tr:
adj. 该死的；可恶的；糟透的
v. 咒骂（某人下地狱）
words.ex: It's a damn good idea.
words.ex_cn: 这是个该死的好主意。
words.en: If you say that someone is damned if they do something, you mean that they will be in a very difficult situation if they do it.

words.ex: U is a heavy metal used in nuclear power.
words.ex_cn: 铀是一种用于核能的重金属。
words.en: The 21st letter of the English alphabet.

words.tr: n. 右派分子；右翼人士
words.ex: He is a rightie who writes with his right hand.
words.ex_cn: 他是个右撇子，用右手写字。
words.en: A colloquial term for a right-wing person, often used in a slightly derogatory or informal context.

words.tr:
adj. 巨型的；特大的
n. 大型喷气式客机
words.ex: He bought a jumbo burger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐买了一个超大汉堡。
words.en: If you describe something as jumbo, you mean that it is very large.

words.tr: vt. 判断；审判（judge 的现在分词）；vi. 判断（judge 的现在分词）； vi. 判断；评判；
words.ex: He is judging the competition fairly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在公平地评判比赛。
words.en: The act of making a decision or forming an opinion about something, often in a critical or analytical manner.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: There is a rumour that he will quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 有一个传言说他要辞职。
words.en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.tr: n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
words.ex: Hard labor helps build strong character.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动有助于培养坚强的品格。
words.en: Work, especially physical work; to work hard.

words.tr:
n. 刻度盘；
v. 拨；
words.ex: He looked at the clock's dial to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他看着钟的刻度盘来查看时间。
words.en: A dial is the face of a clock or watch, or a similar control on a piece of equipment, which shows you the time or other information. As a verb, to dial means to call a telephone number by pressing the buttons on a telephone.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.ex: Nathan is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 内森是我最好的朋友。
words.en: Nathan is a male given name derived from the Hebrew name נָתָן (Natan), meaning 'He has given' or 'gift of God'.

words.ex: Frankly, I don't like this idea.
words.ex_cn: 坦率地说，我不喜欢这个想法。
words.en: In a frank manner; honestly or directly.

words.ex: The children are playing on the hills.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在小山上玩耍。
words.en: Hills are areas of land that are higher than the land surrounding them but smaller and less steep than mountains.

words.tr: v. 提及；参考；涉及（refer 的现在分词）
words.ex: He is referring to the book for help.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参考那本书来寻求帮助。
words.en: A common misspelling of 'referring', meaning to mention or allude to something.

words.tr: n. 圣徒们（Santos 是西班牙语/葡萄牙语中“圣徒”的复数形式，常用于地名或人名，如巴西足球俱乐部 Santos）
words.ex: Santos is a city in Brazil.
words.ex_cn: 桑托斯是巴西的一个城市。
words.en: A common Spanish and Portuguese surname, also referring to a city in Brazil or various places in Latin America.

words.ex: The gardener did a graft on the apple tree.
words.ex_cn: 园丁在苹果树上进行了嫁接。
words.en: Graft can refer to the act of joining parts from different plants so that they grow as one plant, or to the act of transferring living tissue from one part of the body to another. It can also refer to the practice of using one's position to gain money or advantages dishonestly.

words.ex: The congressman spoke to the people in his town.
words.ex_cn: 这位国会议员向他所在城镇的人们发表了讲话。
words.en: A congressman is a member of the United States Congress, especially of the House of Representatives.

words.ex: He was forced to withdraw money at gunpoint.
words.ex_cn: 他在枪口的胁迫下被迫取钱。
words.en: The end of a gun barrel, especially as a means of coercion or threat.

words.ex: The police caught the men who committed crimes.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了那些犯下罪行的人。
words.en: Crimes are illegal actions or activities for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.ex: He strictly follows the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他严格遵守规则。
words.en: In a manner that involves rigid enforcement or that demands complete conformity or exactness.

words.ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
words.en: In or to some place.

words.tr: v. 使恐惧；使惊恐（terrorise 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The children were terrorised by the loud thunder.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们被巨大的雷声吓坏了。
words.en: The past tense and past participle of 'terrorise', meaning to cause someone to feel extreme fear or intimidation.

words.tr: v. 举行；持有；抓住；保存；容纳；“hold”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school held a science fair last week.
words.ex_cn: 学校上周举行了一场科学展览会。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; keep fast; grasp; to have or possess, as something in one's power or control.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.ex_cn: 休息后他会继续走路。
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: The janitor cleans the school every night.
words.ex_cn: 门卫每天晚上打扫学校。
words.en: A janitor is a person whose job is to take care of a building, especially by cleaning it.

words.ex: The newborn baby slept quietly in its mother's arms.
words.ex_cn: 新生的婴儿安静地躺在母亲的怀里。
words.en: A newborn baby or animal has recently been born.

words.tr: adj. 无味的；格调低的；粗俗的
words.ex: The soup is tasteless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这汤淡而无味，很无聊。
words.en: If you describe something such as a remark, joke, or gesture as tasteless, you mean that it is offensive, usually because it involves sex or death and is inappropriate in the circumstances.

words.tr:
v. 评论；表达意见；
n. 评论；意见；
words.ex: He commented on the movie last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚对这部电影发表了评论。
words.en: A comment is something that you say which expresses your opinion of something or which gives an explanation of it.

words.ex: The dog accompanies her every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上都陪伴她。
words.en: To go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort; to be present or occur at the same time as something else.

words.ex: He fastened the ties around his neck.
words.ex_cn: 他把领结系在脖子上。
words.en: Ties refer to the connections or relationships between people, groups, or things, as well as the narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck, typically by men, under the collar of a shirt.
